question: dark-mode-dashboard
prompt: Design a sleek admin dashboard UI with light and dark mode toggle, featuring an AI analytics graph. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark" />
  <title>Neuralytics — AI Admin Dashboard</title>
  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    :root {
      --bg: #f4f6fa;
      --surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
      --surface-solid: #ffffff;
      --surface-soft: #f7f8fc;
      --border: #e7e9f1;
      --text: #171927;
      --muted: #74798b;
      --primary: #6d5dfc;
      --primary-dark: #5745ef;
      --primary-soft: rgba(109, 93, 252, 0.12);
      --cyan: #3fd8e5;
      --green: #24b47e;
      --red: #ee5a72;
      --orange: #f3a83b;
      --shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(38, 38, 68, 0.08);
      --sidebar-width: 248px;
      --header-height: 84px;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] {
      --bg: #0d0f17;
      --surface: rgba(22, 25, 38, 0.84);
      --surface-solid: #161926;
      --surface-soft: #1c2030;
      --border: #292d40;
      --text: #f3f4fa;
      --muted: #969caf;
      --primary: #8a7dff;
      --primary-dark: #9c91ff;
      --primary-soft: rgba(138, 125, 255, 0.14);
      --cyan: #52dce8;
      --green: #43d39e;
      --red: #ff7189;
      --orange: #f7ba5c;
      --shadow: 0 20px 55px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      color: var(--text);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 82% 4%, rgba(109, 93, 252, 0.11), transparent 28%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 48% 100%, rgba(63, 216, 229, 0.06), transparent 30%),
        var(--bg);
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
    }

    button,
    input {
      font: inherit;
    }

    button {
      color: inherit;
    }

    svg {
      display: block;
    }

    .app {
      min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .sidebar {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0 auto 0 0;
      z-index: 30;
      width: var(--sidebar-width);
      padding: 27px 18px 22px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 11px;
      padding: 0 10px 29px;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 760;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      position: relative;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--primary), var(--cyan));
      box-shadow: 0 9px 24px rgba(109, 93, 252, 0.28);
    }

    .brand-mark::before,
    .brand-mark::after {
      position: absolute;
      content: "";
      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .brand-mark::before {
      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
      left: 5px;
      top: 6px;
    }

    .brand-mark::after {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      right: 5px;
      bottom: 6px;
    }

    .nav-label {
      margin: 8px 12px 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: 0.13em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .nav {
      display: grid;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .nav-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 13px;
      min-height: 46px;
      padding: 0 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 590;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: 0.2s ease;
    }

    .nav-item:hover {
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--surface-soft);
    }

    .nav-item.active {
      color: var(--primary);
      background: var(--primary-soft);
    }

    .nav-item svg {
      width: 19px;
      height: 19px;
      stroke-width: 1.8;
    }

    .nav-badge {
      min-width: 21px;
      margin-left: auto;
      padding: 3px 6px;
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--primary);
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .sidebar-footer {
      position: absolute;
      right: 18px;
      bottom: 22px;
      left: 18px;
    }

    .upgrade {
      padding: 17px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0, rgba(63, 216, 229, 0.2), transparent 50%),
        var(--surface-soft);
    }

    .upgrade strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .upgrade p {
      margin-bottom: 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .upgrade button {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 9px;
      color: #fff;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), #8e75ff);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .main {
      min-height: 100vh;
      margin-left: var(--sidebar-width);
    }

    .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 20;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: var(--header-height);
      padding: 0 34px;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 78%, transparent);
      border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 74%, transparent);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .menu-button,
    .icon-button {
      display: grid;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--surface);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: 0.2s ease;
    }

    .menu-button {
      display: none;
    }

    .menu-button:hover,
    .icon-button:hover {
      color: var(--primary);
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, var(--border));
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .menu-button svg,
    .icon-button svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
    }

    .topbar-title h1 {
      font-size: 20px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      letter-spacing: -0.035em;
    }

    .topbar-title p {
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .topbar-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 11px;
    }

    .search {
      position: relative;
      width: min(260px, 22vw);
    }

    .search svg {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 13px;
      width: 17px;
      height: 17px;
      color: var(--muted);
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .search input {
      width: 100%;
      height: 40px;
      padding: 0 40px;
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      outline: none;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--surface);
      transition: 0.2s ease;
    }

    .search input::placeholder {
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .search input:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
    }

    .shortcut {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      right: 10px;
      padding: 2px 5px;
      color: var(--muted);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 5px;
      font-size: 10px;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
    }

    .notification {
      position: relative;
    }

    .notification::after {
      position: absolute;
      top: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      content: "";
      border: 2px solid var(--surface-solid);
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--red);
    }

    .theme-toggle .sun,
    [data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .moon {
      display: none;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .sun {
      display: block;
    }

    .profile {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding-left: 2px;
    }

    .avatar {
      display: grid;
      width: 39px;
      height: 39px;
      place-items: center;
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, #f09b79, #8d65e9);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 750;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(109, 93, 252, 0.18);
    }

    .profile-copy {
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .profile-copy strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .profile-copy span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .content {
      width: min(1500px, 100%);
      margin: auto;
      padding: 28px 34px 38px;
    }

    .welcome {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .welcome h2 {
      font-size: clamp(23px, 2.2vw, 31px);
      letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    }

    .welcome p {
      margin-top: 7px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .date-filter {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 10px 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: var(--surface);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 620;
    }

    .date-filter svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
    }

    .metrics {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 17px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .card {
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: var(--surface);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      transition: border-color 0.25s ease, background 0.3s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
    }

    .metric {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 142px;
      padding: 19px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .metric:hover {
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 30%, var(--border));
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .metric::after {
      position: absolute;
      right: -32px;
      bottom: -44px;
      width: 105px;
      height: 105px;
      content: "";
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--accent-soft);
      filter: blur(3px);
    }

    .metric-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 17px;
    }

    .metric-icon {
      display: grid;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      place-items: center;
      color: var(--accent);
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: var(--accent-soft);
    }

    .metric-icon svg {
      width: 19px;
      height: 19px;
    }

    .trend {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 3px;
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .trend.down {
      color: var(--red);
    }

    .trend svg {
      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
    }

    .metric h3 {
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      font-size: 25px;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }

    .metric p {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .dashboard-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.85fr) minmax(280px, 0.75fr);
      gap: 18px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .analytics {
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 21px 21px 16px;
    }

    .card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .title-wrap {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .ai-chip {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      color: var(--primary);
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--primary-soft);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .ai-chip i {
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--primary-soft);
    }

    .card-header h3 {
      font-size: 15px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .card-header p {
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .range-switch {
      display: flex;
      padding: 3px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: var(--surface-soft);
    }

    .range-switch button {
      padding: 6px 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .range-switch button.active {
      color: var(--primary);
      background: var(--surface-solid);
      box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(20, 20, 50, 0.08);
    }

    .chart-summary {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 11px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .chart-summary strong {
      font-size: 27px;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
    }

    .chart-summary span {
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .chart-wrap {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 280px;
      user-select: none;
    }

    #analyticsChart {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: visible;
    }

    .grid-line {
      stroke: var(--border);
      stroke-width: 1;
    }

    .axis-label {
      fill: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .line-main {
      fill: none;
      stroke: var(--primary);
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
      stroke-width: 3;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 5px 5px rgba(109, 93, 252, 0.18));
    }

    .line-forecast {
      fill: none;
      stroke: var(--cyan);
      stroke-dasharray: 7 7;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-width: 2.5;
    }

    .chart-point {
      fill: var(--surface-solid);
      stroke: var(--primary);
      stroke-width: 3;
      cursor: pointer;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
    }

    .chart-point:hover {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .hover-zone {
      fill: transparent;
      cursor: crosshair;
    }

    .chart-tooltip {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 4;
      min-width: 112px;
      padding: 9px 11px;
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--surface-solid);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translate(-50%, -115%);
      transition: opacity 0.12s ease;
    }

    .chart-tooltip.visible {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .chart-tooltip small {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
    }

    .chart-tooltip strong {
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .legend {
      display: flex;
      gap: 18px;
      padding-top: 4px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .legend span {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .legend i {
      width: 17px;
      height: 3px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--primary);
    }

    .legend span:last-child i {
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        var(--cyan) 0 5px,
        transparent 5px 8px
      );
    }

    .insights {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-height: 100%;
      padding: 21px;
    }

    .insight-hero {
      position: relative;
      margin: 2px 0 17px;
      padding: 18px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 15px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(109, 93, 252, 0.16), rgba(63, 216, 229, 0.09)),
        var(--surface-soft);
    }

    .insight-hero::after {
      position: absolute;
      top: -32px;
      right: -25px;
      width: 90px;
      height: 90px;
      content: "";
      border: 18px solid rgba(109, 93, 252, 0.09);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .sparkle {
      display: grid;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      place-items: center;
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--cyan));
    }

    .sparkle svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
    }

    .insight-hero strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .insight-hero p {
      max-width: 92%;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .insight-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .insight-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 11px;
      padding: 10px 7px;
      border-radius: 11px;
      transition: background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .insight-item:hover {
      background: var(--surface-soft);
    }

    .signal {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      margin-top: 4px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 14%, transparent);
    }

    .signal.warning {
      background: var(--orange);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--orange) 14%, transparent);
    }

    .signal.info {
      background: var(--cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 14%, transparent);
    }

    .insight-item strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .insight-item p {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .ask-ai {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: auto;
      padding-top: 17px;
    }

    .ask-ai input {
      min-width: 0;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 0 11px;
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      outline: none;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--surface-soft);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .ask-ai input:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary);
    }

    .ask-ai button {
      display: grid;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      place-items: center;
      color: #fff;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: 0.2s ease;
    }

    .ask-ai button:hover {
      background: var(--primary-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .ask-ai button svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
    }

    .bottom-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.35fr) minmax(280px, 0.65fr);
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 18px;
    }

    .table-card,
    .sources-card {
      padding: 21px;
    }

    .table-wrap {
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    th,
    td {
      padding: 12px 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-size: 10px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    th {
      padding-top: 3px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    tbody tr:last-child td {
      border-bottom: 0;
    }

    .campaign {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      color: var(--text);
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .campaign-icon {
      display: grid;
      width: 29px;
      height: 29px;
      place-items: center;
      color: var(--campaign-color);
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--campaign-color) 12%, transparent);
    }

    .campaign-icon svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
    }

    .status {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      color: var(--green);
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 11%, transparent);
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .status::before {
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      content: "";
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: currentColor;
    }

    .source {
      margin-bottom: 17px;
    }

    .source:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .source-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .source-head span {
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .progress {
      height: 7px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--surface-soft);
    }

    .progress i {
      display: block;
      width: var(--value);
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: var(--color);
      animation: grow 0.8s ease both;
    }

    @keyframes grow {
      from { width: 0; }
    }

    .overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 25;
      display: none;
      background: rgba(7, 8, 13, 0.48);
      backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
    }

    .toast {
      position: fixed;
      right: 24px;
      bottom: 24px;
      z-index: 100;
      padding: 13px 16px;
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--surface-solid);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      font-size: 12px;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transform: translateY(12px);
      transition: 0.25s ease;
    }

    .toast.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    @media (max-width: 1180px) {
      .metrics {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }

      .dashboard-grid,
      .bottom-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .insights {
        min-height: 410px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      .sidebar {
        transform: translateX(-100%);
      }

      .sidebar.open {
        transform: translateX(0);
      }

      .overlay.open {
        display: block;
      }

      .main {
        margin-left: 0;
      }

      .menu-button {
        display: grid;
      }

      .topbar {
        height: 72px;
        padding: 0 18px;
      }

      .topbar-title {
        margin-right: auto;
        margin-left: 12px;
      }

      .topbar-title p,
      .search,
      .profile-copy {
        display: none;
      }

      .content {
        padding: 24px 18px 30px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 560px) {
      .welcome {
        align-items: flex-start;
        flex-direction: column;
      }

      .metrics {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      }

        align-self: stretch;
      }

      .range-switch button {
        flex: 1;
      }

        height: 240px;
      }

      .profile {
        display: none;

    themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {

        labels: ["Mar 1", "Mar 9", "Mar 17", "Mar 25", "Apr 2", "Apr 10", "Apr 18", "Apr 26", "May 4", "May 12", "May 20", "May 31"],
        total: "$241,680",
        trend: "↑ 16.2% vs last quarter"
      },
      365: {
        values: [24, 28, 35, 39, 37, 47, 54, 58, 64, 61, 74, 85],
        labels: ["Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May"],
        total: "$926,410",
        trend: "↑ 24.7% year over year"
      }
    };

    function smoothPath(points) {
      if (points.length < 2) return "";
      let path = `M ${points[0].x} ${points[0].y}`;
      for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
        const current = points[i];
        const next = points[i + 1];
        const midX = (current.x + next.x) / 2;
        path += ` C ${midX} ${current.y}, ${midX} ${next.y}, ${next.x} ${next.y}`;
      }
      return path;
    }

    function renderChart(range = 30) {
      const data = chartData[range];
      const width = 900;
      const height = 300;
      const left = 42;
      const right = 24;
      const top = 18;
      const bottom = 36;
      const chartWidth = width - left - right;
      const chartHeight = height - top - bottom;
      const min = 20;
      const max = 100;

      const actualCount = Math.max(4, data.values.length - 3);
      const points = data.values.map((value, index) => ({
        x: left + (index / (data.values.length - 1)) * chartWidth,
        y: top + ((max - value) / (max - min)) * chartHeight,
        value,
        label: data.labels[index]
      }));

      const actualPoints = points.slice(0, actualCount);
      const forecastPoints = points.slice(actualCount - 1);

      const actualPath = smoothPath(actualPoints);
      const forecastPath = smoothPath(forecastPoints);
      const baseline = height - bottom;
      const areaPath = `${actualPath} L ${actualPoints.at(-1).x} ${baseline} L ${actualPoints[0].x} ${baseline} Z`;

      const yTicks = [100, 80, 60, 40, 20];
      const grid = yTicks.map(value => {
        const y = top + ((max - value) / (max - min)) * chartHeight;
        return `
          <line class="grid-line" x1="${left}" y1="${y}" x2="${width-right}" y2="${y}" />
          <text class="axis-label" x="4" y="${y + 4}">$${value}k</text>
        `;
      }).join("");

      const visibleLabelIndexes = [...new Set([0, Math.floor((points.length - 1) / 3), Math.floor((points.length - 1) * 2 / 3), points.length - 1])];
      const xLabels = visibleLabelIndexes.map(index => `
        <text class="axis-label" x="${points[index].x}" y="${height - 9}" text-anchor="${index === 0 ? "start" : index === points.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}">
          ${points[index].label}
        </text>
      `).join("");

      const interactivePoints = points.map((point, index) => `
        <circle class="chart-point" data-index="${index}" cx="${point.x}" cy="${point.y}" r="5" />
        <rect class="hover-zone" data-index="${index}"
          x="${point.x - chartWidth / points.length / 2}" y="${top}"
          width="${chartWidth / points.length}" height="${chartHeight}" />
      `).join("");

      chart.innerHTML = `
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="areaGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="var(--primary)" stop-opacity=".28"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="var(--primary)" stop-opacity="0"/>
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        ${grid}
        ${xLabels}
        <path d="${areaPath}" fill="url(#areaGradient)" />
        <path class="line-main" d="${actualPath}" />
        <path class="line-forecast" d="${forecastPath}" />
        <line x1="${forecastPoints[0].x}" y1="${top}" x2="${forecastPoints[0].x}" y2="${baseline}"
          stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-opacity=".25" stroke-dasharray="3 5" />
        ${interactivePoints}
      `;

      document.getElementById("chartTotal").textContent = data.total;
      document.getElementById("chartTrend").textContent = data.trend;

      chart.querySelectorAll(".hover-zone").forEach(zone => {
        zone.addEventListener("mouseenter", event => showTooltip(event, points));
        zone.addEventListener("mousemove", event => showTooltip(event, points));
        zone.addEventListener("mouseleave", hideTooltip);
      });
    }

    function showTooltip(event, points) {
      const index = Number(event.target.dataset.index);
      const point = points[index];
      const rect = chartWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = (point.x / 900) * rect.width;
      const y = (point.y / 300) * rect.height;

      tooltip.querySelector("small").textContent = point.label;
      tooltip.querySelector("strong").textContent = `$${point.value}.0K revenue`;
      tooltip.style.left = `${Math.max(60, Math.min(rect.width - 60, x))}px`;
      tooltip.style.top = `${Math.max(52, y)}px`;
      tooltip.classList.add("visible");

      chart.querySelectorAll(".chart-point").forEach((circle, i) => {
        circle.style.opacity = i === index ? "1" : "0";
      });
    }

    function hideTooltip() {
      tooltip.classList.remove("visible");
      chart.querySelectorAll(".chart-point").forEach(circle => {
        circle.style.opacity = "";
      });
    }

    document.getElementById("rangeSwitch").addEventListener("click", event => {
      const button = event.target.closest("button");
      if (!button) return;
      document.querySelectorAll("#rangeSwitch button").forEach(item => item.classList.remove("active"));
      button.classList.add("active");
      renderChart(Number(button.dataset.range));
    });

    function showToast(message) {
      toast.textContent = message;
      toast.classList.add("show");
      clearTimeout(showToast.timer);
      showToast.timer = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove("show"), 2400);
    }

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-toast]").forEach(element => {
      element.addEventListener("click", () => showToast(element.dataset.toast));
    });

    document.getElementById("askAI").addEventListener("submit", event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const input = event.currentTarget.querySelector("input");
      if (!input.value.trim()) {
        showToast("Enter a question for the AI assistant");
        input.focus();
        return;
      }
      showToast("AI is analyzing your question...");
      input.value = "";
    });

    document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if ((event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === "k") {
        event.preventDefault();
        document.querySelector(".search input").focus();
      }
      if (event.key === "Escape") toggleMenu(false);
    });

    renderChart(30);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="dark">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Nexus AI Admin Dashboard</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-primary: #0b0f1a;
            --bg-secondary: #111827;
            --bg-card: #151e2f;
            --bg-hover: #1a2438;
            --bg-active: #1e2a42;
            --border-color: #1e2d45;
            --text-primary: #e8edf5;
            --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
            --text-muted: #64748b;
            --accent: #6366f1;
            --accent-light: #818cf8;
            --accent-glow: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35);
            --accent-secondary: #06b6d4;
            --accent-tertiary: #f59e0b;
            --success: #10b981;
            --danger: #ef4444;
            --warning: #f59e0b;
            --chart-grid: #1e2d45;
            --shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            --sidebar-width: 250px;
            --sidebar-collapsed: 72px;
            --radius: 14px;
            --radius-sm: 8px;
            --transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            --font: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
            --toggle-bg: #334155;
            --toggle-dot: #e2e8f0;
            --scrollbar-thumb: #2a3a55;
            --scrollbar-track: transparent;
            --card-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        }

        [data-theme="light"] {
            --bg-primary: #f4f6fb;
            --bg-secondary: #ffffff;
            --bg-card: #ffffff;
            --bg-hover: #f0f4f9;
            --bg-active: #e8edf5;
            --border-color: #dde3ed;
            --text-primary: #1a2333;
            --text-secondary: #4b5568;
            --text-muted: #8a94a6;
            --accent: #6366f1;
            --accent-light: #4f46e5;
            --accent-glow: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2);
            --accent-secondary: #0891b2;
            --accent-tertiary: #d97706;
            --chart-grid: #e5eaf2;
            --shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            --shadow-sm: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
            --toggle-bg: #cbd5e1;
            --toggle-dot: #ffffff;
            --scrollbar-thumb: #c8d0dc;
            --card-border: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            transition: background var(--transition), color var(--transition);
            display: flex;
            min-height: 100vh;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            letter-spacing: 0.01em;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: var(--scrollbar-track);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--scrollbar-thumb);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        /* ============ SIDEBAR ============ */
        .sidebar {
            width: var(--sidebar-width);
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            transition: width var(--transition), background var(--transition), border-color var(--transition);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .sidebar-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 20px 18px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            min-height: 64px;
            transition: border-color var(--transition);
        }

        .logo-icon {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-secondary));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            font-size: 18px;
            animation: logoPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes logoPulse {
            0%,
            100% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-glow);
            }
            50% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 28px var(--accent-glow), 0 0 40px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
            }
        }

        .logo-text {
            font-size: 19px;
            font-weight: 700;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-light), var(--accent-secondary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            white-space: nowrap;
            opacity: 1;
            transition: opacity 0.2s;
        }

        .sidebar.collapsed .logo-text {
            opacity: 0;
            width: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-link span {
            opacity: 0;
            width: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-section-title {
            opacity: 0;
            height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }
        .sidebar.collapsed {
            width: var(--sidebar-collapsed);
        }
        .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-link {
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 12px;
        }

        .sidebar-nav {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 16px 12px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        .sidebar-section-title {
            font-size: 11px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 12px 12px 6px;
            font-weight: 600;
            white-space: nowrap;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .sidebar-link {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 11px 14px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            cursor: pointer;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 13.5px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            white-space: nowrap;
            position: relative;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
            border: none;
            background: none;
            width: 100%;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .sidebar-link:hover {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .sidebar-link.active {
            background: var(--bg-active);
            color: var(--accent-light);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .sidebar-link.active::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 3px;
            height: 22px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .sidebar-link .icon {
            font-size: 18px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: 22px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .sidebar-link .badge {
            margin-left: auto;
            font-size: 11px;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-weight: 600;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .badge-primary {
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .badge-danger {
            background: var(--danger);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .badge-success {
            background: var(--success);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-link .badge {
            display: none;
        }
        .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-link .icon {
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        /* ============ MAIN CONTENT ============ */
        .main-content {
            flex: 1;
            margin-left: var(--sidebar-width);
            padding: 0;
            transition: margin-left var(--transition);
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }
        .main-content.sidebar-collapsed {
            margin-left: var(--sidebar-collapsed);
        }

        .top-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            padding: 16px 28px;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 50;
            transition: background var(--transition), border-color var(--transition);
        }

        .hamburger-btn {
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            transition: all 0.2s;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .hamburger-btn:hover {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border-color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .header-search {
            flex: 1;
            max-width: 420px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 9px 14px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }
        .header-search:focus-within {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-glow);
        }
        .header-search .search-icon {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 15px;
        }
        .header-search input {
            flex: 1;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            outline: none;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 13.5px;
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .header-search input::placeholder {
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .header-actions {
            margin-left: auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .theme-toggle {
            width: 52px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            background: var(--toggle-bg);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
            transition: background var(--transition);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .theme-toggle::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 3px;
            left: 3px;
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--toggle-dot);
            transition: transform var(--transition), background var(--transition);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        }
        [data-theme="light"] .theme-toggle::after {
            transform: translateX(24px);
        }
        .theme-toggle:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .theme-toggle .sun-icon,
        .theme-toggle .moon-icon {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-size: 13px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 1;
            transition: opacity 0.2s;
        }
        .theme-toggle .sun-icon {
            left: 6px;
            opacity: 0;
        }
        .theme-toggle .moon-icon {
            right: 6px;
            opacity: 1;
        }
        [data-theme="light"] .theme-toggle .sun-icon {
            opacity: 1;
        }
        [data-theme="light"] .theme-toggle .moon-icon {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .notification-btn,
        .profile-btn {
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 17px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            transition: all 0.2s;
            position: relative;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .notification-btn:hover,
        .profile-btn:hover {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border-color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .notification-btn .notification-dot {
            position: absolute;
            top: 7px;
            right: 7px;
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;
            background: var(--danger);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        .profile-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-secondary));
            color: #fff;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 13px;
            border: none;
        }
        .profile-btn:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--accent-glow);
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
        }

        /* ============ DASHBOARD CONTENT ============ */
        .dashboard-content {
            padding: 28px;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .page-title-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 12px;
        }
        .page-title {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        .page-subtitle {
            font-size: 13.5px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .btn {
            padding: 10px 18px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-family: var(--font);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .btn:hover {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            border-color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .btn-primary {
            background: var(--accent);
            border-color: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: var(--accent-light);
            border-color: var(--accent-light);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* Stats Cards */
        .stats-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }
        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 20px;
            transition: all var(--transition);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }
        .stat-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            border-color: var(--border-color);
        }
        .stat-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        .stat-card:nth-child(1)::after {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-secondary));
        }
        .stat-card:nth-child(2)::after {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-secondary), #34d399);
        }
        .stat-card:nth-child(3)::after {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-tertiary), #fb923c);
        }
        .stat-card:nth-child(4)::after {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--success), #34d399);
        }

        .stat-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .stat-label {
            font-size: 12.5px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 500;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }
        .stat-icon {
            width: 34px;
            height: 34px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 16px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .stat-icon.indigo {
            background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-light);
        }
        .stat-icon.cyan {
            background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-secondary);
        }
        .stat-icon.amber {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-tertiary);
        }
        .stat-icon.green {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
            color: var(--success);
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            display: flex;
            align-items: baseline;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .stat-change {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 3px;
        }
        .stat-change.up {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
            color: var(--success);
        }
        .stat-change.down {
            background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
            color: var(--danger);
        }

        /* Charts Row */
        .charts-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr;
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }
        .chart-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 20px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            transition: all var(--transition);
        }
        .chart-card:hover {
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            border-color: var(--border-color);
        }
        .chart-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .chart-title {
            font-size: 15.5px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .chart-title small {
            display: block;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 400;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }
        .chart-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: 14px;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .legend-dot {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin-right: 5px;
        }
        .legend-dot.indigo {
            background: var(--accent);
        }
        .legend-dot.cyan {
            background: var(--accent-secondary);
        }
        .legend-dot.amber {
            background: var(--accent-tertiary);
        }

        canvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            border-radius: 8px;
        }

        .chart-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 260px;
        }

        /* Donut chart area */
        .donut-wrapper {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .donut-legend-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            font-size: 13px;
        }
        .donut-legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .donut-legend-item .value {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-left: auto;
            padding-left: 12px;
        }

        /* Bottom row */
        .bottom-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        /* Table */
        .table-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 20px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            transition: all var(--transition);
        }
        .table-card:hover {
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            border-color: var(--border-color);
        }
        .table-wrapper {
            overflow-x: auto;
            margin-top: 12px;
        }
        table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 13px;
        }
        th {
            text-align: left;
            padding: 10px 12px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 11px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        td {
            padding: 11px 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        tr:last-child td {
            border-bottom: none;
        }
        tr:hover td {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .status-pill {
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .status-pill.online {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
            color: var(--success);
        }
        .status-pill.training {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-tertiary);
        }
        .status-pill.idle {
            background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .status-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: inline-block;
        }
        .status-pill.online .status-dot {
            background: var(--success);
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--success);
        }
        .status-pill.training .status-dot {
            background: var(--accent-tertiary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-tertiary);
        }
        .status-pill.idle .status-dot {
            background: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* Activity feed */
        .activity-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 20px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            transition: all var(--transition);
        }
        .activity-card:hover {
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            border-color: var(--border-color);
        }
        .activity-list {
            list-style: none;
            margin-top: 12px;
        }
        .activity-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 12px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }
        .activity-item:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }
        .activity-avatar {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .activity-avatar.a {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #4f46e5);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .activity-avatar.b {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-secondary), #0e7490);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .activity-avatar.c {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--success), #059669);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .activity-avatar.d {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-tertiary), #ea580c);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .activity-text {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            flex: 1;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .activity-text strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .activity-time {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            white-space: nowrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* AI insight banner */
        .ai-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-secondary));
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 18px 22px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px var(--accent-glow);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .ai-banner::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            right: -10%;
            width: 200px;
            height: 200px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .ai-banner-icon {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 20px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        }
        .ai-banner-text {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .ai-banner-text h4 {
            font-size: 14.5px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }
        .ai-banner-text p {
            font-size: 12.5px;
            opacity: 0.9;
        }
        .ai-banner-close {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 18px;
            cursor: pointer;
            opacity: 0.7;
            padding: 4px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .ai-banner-close:hover {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .charts-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .bottom-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .sidebar {
                transform: translateX(-100%);
                width: var(--sidebar-width);
            }
            .sidebar.mobile-open {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            .sidebar.collapsed {
                width: var(--sidebar-width);
                transform: translateX(-100%);
            }
            .sidebar.collapsed.mobile-open {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            .main-content {
                margin-left: 0 !important;
            }
            .dashboard-content {
                padding: 16px;
            }
            .top-header {
                padding: 12px 16px;
                gap: 10px;
            }
            .header-search {
                max-width: none;
            }
            .stats-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
                gap: 10px;
            }
            .stat-card {
                padding: 14px;
            }
            .stat-value {
                font-size: 22px;
            }
            .page-title {
                font-size: 20px;
            }
            .ai-banner {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
                padding: 16px;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .stats-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }
            .header-search input {
                font-size: 12px;
            }
            .header-actions {
                gap: 6px;
            }
            .theme-toggle {
                width: 44px;
                height: 24px;
            }
            .theme-toggle::after {
                width: 18px;
                height: 18px;
            }
            [data-theme="light"] .theme-toggle::after {
                transform: translateX(20px);
            }
            .notification-btn,
            .profile-btn {
                width: 32px;
                height: 32px;
                font-size: 14px;
            }
        }

        /* Animations */
        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(16px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }
        .stat-card,
        .chart-card,
        .table-card,
        .activity-card,
        .ai-banner {
            animation: fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out forwards;
        }
        .stat-card:nth-child(1) {
            animation-delay: 0.05s;
        }
        .stat-card:nth-child(2) {
            animation-delay: 0.1s;
        }
        .stat-card:nth-child(3) {
            animation-delay: 0.15s;
        }
        .stat-card:nth-child(4) {
            animation-delay: 0.2s;
        }
        .charts-row .chart-card:nth-child(1) {
            animation-delay: 0.25s;
        }
        .charts-row .chart-card:nth-child(2) {
            animation-delay: 0.3s;
        }
        .bottom-row .table-card {
            animation-delay: 0.35s;
        }
        .bottom-row .activity-card {
            animation-delay: 0.4s;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- ============ SIDEBAR ============ -->
    <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
        <div class="sidebar-header">
            <div class="logo-icon">⚡</div>
            <span class="logo-text">Nexus AI</span>
        </div>
        <nav class="sidebar-nav">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title">Main Menu</div>
            <button class="sidebar-link active">
                <span class="icon">📊</span>
                <span>Dashboard</span>
            </button>
            <button class="sidebar-link">
                <span class="icon">🤖</span>
                <span>AI Models</span>
                <span class="badge badge-primary">12</span>
            </button>
            <button class="sidebar-link">
                <span class="icon">📈</span>
                <span>Analytics</span>
            </button>
            <button class="sidebar-link">
                <span class="icon">💾</span>
                <span>Datasets</span>
                <span class="badge badge-success">5</span>
            </button>

            <div class="sidebar-section-title">System</div>
            <button class="sidebar-link">
                <span class="icon">⚙️</span>
                <span>Settings</span>
            </button>
            <button class="sidebar-link">
                <span class="icon">🔔</span>
                <span>Notifications</span>
                <span class="badge badge-danger">3</span>
            </button>
            <button class="sidebar-link">
                <span class="icon">📄</span>
                <span>Reports</span>
            </button>
            <button class="sidebar-link">
                <span class="icon">👥</span>
                <span>Team</span>
            </button>
        </nav>
    </aside>

    <!-- ============ MAIN CONTENT ============ -->
    <main class="main-content" id="mainContent">
        <!-- Top Header -->

    </main>

    <script>
        (function() {
            // ============ THEME TOGGLE ============
            const html = document.documentElement;
            const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');

            function setTheme(theme) {
                html.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
                localStorage.setItem('nexus-theme', theme);
                updateChartsTheme();
            }

            function getTheme() {
                const saved = localStorage.getItem('nexus-theme');
                if (saved) return saved;
                return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches ? 'light' : 'dark';
            }

            // Initialize theme
            setTheme(getTheme());

            themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const current = html.getAttribute('data-theme');
                setTheme(current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
            });

            // ============ SIDEBAR TOGGLE ============
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            const mainContent = document.getElementById('mainContent');
            const hamburgerBtn = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
            let sidebarCollapsed = false;
            let mobileOpen = false;

            function isMobile() {
                return window.innerWidth <= 768;
            }

            function updateSidebarState() {
                if (isMobile()) {
                    sidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                    mainContent.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                    if (mobileOpen) {
                        sidebar.classList.add('mobile-open');
                    } else {
                        sidebar.classList.remove('mobile-open');
                    }
                } else {
                    sidebar.classList.remove('mobile-open');
                    if (sidebarCollapsed) {
                        sidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                        mainContent.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                    } else {
                        sidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                        mainContent.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                    }
                }
            }

            hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (isMobile()) {
                    mobileOpen = !mobileOpen;
                } else {
                    sidebarCollapsed = !sidebarCollapsed;
                }
                updateSidebarState();
            });

            // Close mobile sidebar when clicking outside
            document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (isMobile() && mobileOpen && !sidebar.contains(e.target) && !hamburgerBtn.contains(e.target)) {
                    mobileOpen = false;
                    updateSidebarState();
                }
            });

            window.addEventListener('resize', updateSidebarState);
            updateSidebarState();

            // ============ AI BANNER DISMISS ============
            const aiBanner = document.getElementById('aiBanner');
            const aiBannerClose = document.getElementById('aiBannerClose');
            aiBannerClose.addEventListener('click', () => {
                aiBanner.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
                aiBanner.style.opacity = '0';
                aiBanner.style.transform = 'translateY(-10px)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    aiBanner.style.display = 'none';
                }, 300);
            });

            // ============ CHART THEME COLORS ============
            function getChartColors() {
                const isDark = html.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
                return {
                    grid: isDark ? '#1e2d45' : '#e5eaf2',
                    text: isDark ? '#64748b' : '#8a94a6',
                    textBold: isDark ? '#e8edf5' : '#1a2333',
                    indigo: '#6366f1',
                    cyan: '#06b6d4',
                    amber: '#f59e0b',
                    red: '#ef4444',
                    green: '#10b981',
                    fillIndigo: isDark ? 'rgba(99,102,241,0.15)' : 'rgba(99,102,241,0.1)',
                    fillCyan: isDark ? 'rgba(6,182,212,0.12)' : 'rgba(6,182,212,0.08)',
                    fillAmber: isDark ? 'rgba(245,158,11,0.1)' : 'rgba(245,158,11,0.07)',
                };
            }

            // ============ MAIN LINE CHART ============
            const mainChartCanvas = document.getElementById('mainChart');
            let mainChartCtx = mainChartCanvas.getContext('2d');

            function drawMainChart() {
                const colors = getChartColors();
                const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                const container = mainChartCanvas.parentElement;
                const containerWidth = container.offsetWidth;
                const containerHeight = 280;
                mainChartCanvas.width = containerWidth * dpr;
                mainChartCanvas.height = containerHeight * dpr;
                mainChartCanvas.style.width = containerWidth + 'px';
                mainChartCanvas.style.height = containerHeight + 'px';
                mainChartCtx.scale(dpr, dpr);

                const width = containerWidth;
                const height = containerHeight;
                const padding = { top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 36, left: 50 };
                const chartW = width - padding.left - padding.right;
                const chartH = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;

                // Data
                const labels = ['Day 1', 'Day 5', 'Day 10', 'Day 15', 'Day 20', 'Day 25', 'Day 30'];
                const inferenceData = [2800, 3100, 2950, 3600, 3900, 4200, 4800];
                const latencyData = [45, 42, 38, 35, 33, 31, 28];
                const accuracyData = [94.2, 94.8, 95.1, 95.8, 96.3, 96.9, 97.2];

                const maxVal = 5000;
                const maxLatency = 50;
                const maxAccuracy = 100;

                function getX(i) { return padding.left + (i / (labels.length - 1)) * chartW; }

                function getY(val, max) { return padding.top + chartH - (val / max) * chartH; }

                // Clear
                mainChartCtx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

                // Grid lines
                mainChartCtx.strokeStyle = colors.grid;
                mainChartCtx.lineWidth = 0.5;
                mainChartCtx.setLineDash([3, 5]);
                for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
                    const y = padding.top + (i / 5) * chartH;
                    mainChartCtx.beginPath();
                    mainChartCtx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
                    mainChartCtx.lineTo(padding.left + chartW, y);
                    mainChartCtx.stroke();
                }
                mainChartCtx.setLineDash([]);

                // X-axis labels
                mainChartCtx.fillStyle = colors.text;
                mainChartCtx.font = '11px "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif';
                mainChartCtx.textAlign = 'center';
                labels.forEach((label, i) => {
                    mainChartCtx.fillText(label, getX(i), height - 12);
                });

                // Y-axis labels
                mainChartCtx.textAlign = 'right';
                for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
                    const val = Math.round(maxVal - (i / 5) * maxVal);
                    const y = padding.top + (i / 5) * chartH;
                    mainChartCtx.fillText(val.toLocaleString(), padding.left - 10, y + 4);
                }

                // Accuracy is drawn on secondary scale (right)
                mainChartCtx.textAlign = 'left';
                for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
                    const val = Math.round(maxAccuracy - (i / 4) * maxAccuracy);
                    const y = padding.top + (i / 4) * chartH;
                    mainChartCtx.fillText(val + '%', padding.left + chartW + 10, y + 4);
                }

                // Helper to draw smooth area with gradient
                function drawArea(data, max, color, fillColor) {
                    mainChartCtx.beginPath();
                    data.forEach((val, i) => {
                        const x = getX(i);
                        const y = getY(val, max);
                        if (i === 0) mainChartCtx.moveTo(x, y);
                        else mainChartCtx.lineTo(x, y);
                    });
                    // Complete area to bottom
                    mainChartCtx.lineTo(getX(data.length - 1), padding.top + chartH);
                    mainChartCtx.lineTo(getX(0), padding.top + chartH);
                    mainChartCtx.closePath();

                    const gradient = mainChartCtx.createLinearGradient(0, padding.top, 0, padding.top + chartH);
                    gradient.addColorStop(0, fillColor);
                    gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
                    mainChartCtx.fillStyle = gradient;
                    mainChartCtx.fill();
                }

                // Helper to draw line
                function drawLine(data, max, color, lineWidth) {
                    mainChartCtx.beginPath();
                    data.forEach((val, i) => {
                        const x = getX(i);
                        const y = getY(val, max);
                        if (i === 0) mainChartCtx.moveTo(x, y);
                        else mainChartCtx.lineTo(x, y);
                    });
                    mainChartCtx.strokeStyle = color;
                    mainChartCtx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 2.5;
                    mainChartCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
                    mainChartCtx.lineCap = 'round';
                    mainChartCtx.stroke();
                }

                // Helper to draw dots
                function drawDots(data, max, color) {
                    data.forEach((val, i) => {
                        const x = getX(i);
                        const y = getY(val, max);
                        mainChartCtx.beginPath();
                        mainChartCtx.arc(x, y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        mainChartCtx.fillStyle = color;
                        mainChartCtx.fill();
                        mainChartCtx.strokeStyle = colors.textBold;
                        mainChartCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;
                        mainChartCtx.stroke();
                    });
                }

                // Draw inference area (main metric)
                drawArea(inferenceData, maxVal, colors.indigo, colors.fillIndigo);
                drawLine(inferenceData, maxVal, colors.indigo, 3);
                drawDots(inferenceData, maxVal, colors.indigo);

                // Draw latency line (scaled separately - use maxLatency for actual values but draw on same chart scale
                // using maxVal for proportional display)
                const latencyMapped = latencyData.map(l => (l / maxLatency) * maxVal);
                drawLine(latencyMapped, maxVal, colors.cyan, 2.5);
                drawDots(latencyMapped, maxVal, colors.cyan);

                // Draw accuracy line (scaled to maxVal using maxAccuracy)
                const accuracyMapped = accuracyData.map(a => (a / maxAccuracy) * maxVal);
                drawLine(accuracyMapped, maxVal, colors.amber, 2);
                drawDots(accuracyMapped, maxVal, colors.amber);
            }

            // ============ DONUT CHART ============
            const donutCanvas = document.getElementById('donutChart');
            let donutCtx = donutCanvas.getContext('2d');

            function drawDonutChart() {
                const colors = getChartColors();
                const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                const size = 200;
                donutCanvas.width = size * dpr;
                donutCanvas.height = size * dpr;
                donutCanvas.style.width = size + 'px';
                donutCanvas.style.height = size + 'px';
                donutCtx.scale(dpr, dpr);

                const cx = size / 2;
                const cy = size / 2;
                const outerRadius = 80;
                const innerRadius = 48;

                const data = [
                    { value: 42, color: colors.indigo, label: 'NLP' },
                    { value: 28, color: colors.cyan, label: 'Vision' },
                    { value: 18, color: colors.amber, label: 'Predictive' },
                    { value: 12, color: colors.red, label: 'Other' },
                ];

                const total = data.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0);
                let startAngle = -Math.PI / 2;

                // Draw segments
                data.forEach((segment) => {
                    const sliceAngle = (segment.value / total) * Math.PI * 2;
                    const endAngle = startAngle + sliceAngle;

                    donutCtx.beginPath();
                    donutCtx.arc(cx, cy, outerRadius, startAngle, endAngle);
                    donutCtx.arc(cx, cy, innerRadius, endAngle, startAngle, true);
                    donutCtx.closePath();
                    donutCtx.fillStyle = segment.color;
                    donutCtx.fill();

                    // Hover effect shadow
                    donutCtx.shadowColor = segment.color;
                    donutCtx.shadowBlur = 0;

                    startAngle = endAngle;
                });

                // Inner circle shadow for depth
                donutCtx.beginPath();
                donutCtx.arc(cx, cy, innerRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                donutCtx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
                donutCtx.shadowBlur = 10;
                donutCtx.fillStyle = colors.textBold === '#e8edf5' ? '#151e2f' : '#ffffff';
                donutCtx.fill();
                donutCtx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
                donutCtx.shadowBlur = 0;

                // Center text
                donutCtx.fillStyle = colors.textBold;
                donutCtx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif';
                donutCtx.textAlign = 'center';
                donutCtx.fillText('24', cx, cy - 4);
                donutCtx.fillStyle = colors.text;
                donutCtx.font = '11px "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif';
                donutCtx.fillText('Total Models', cx, cy + 16);
            }

            // ============ UPDATE CHARTS ON THEME CHANGE ============
            function updateChartsTheme() {
                drawMainChart();
                drawDonutChart();
            }

            // ============ INITIAL DRAW ============
            drawMainChart();
            drawDonutChart();

            // ============ REDRAW ON RESIZE ============
            let resizeTimeout;
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
                resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    drawMainChart();
                    drawDonutChart();
                }, 200);
            });

            // ============ SEARCH FUNCTIONALITY ============
            const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
                // Simple highlight - just for visual feedback
                const query = searchInput.value.toLowerCase();
                const tableRows = document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
                tableRows.forEach(row => {
                    const text = row.textContent.toLowerCase();
                    if (query === '' || text.includes(query)) {
                        row.style.display = '';
                    } else {
                        row.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });
            });
        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
