question: dark-mode-dashboard
prompt: Design a sleek admin dashboard UI with light and dark mode toggle, featuring an AI analytics graph. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="dark">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Synapse · Admin Console</title>
<script>
(function(){try{var t=localStorage.getItem('sx-theme');
if(!t)t=window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches?'light':'dark';
document.documentElement.dataset.theme=t;}catch(e){}})();
</script>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Sora:wght@500;600;700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============ TOKENS ============ */
:root{
  --fd:'Sora',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --fb:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --fm:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#0b111e; --surface:#111a2c; --surface2:#182339;
  --border:#243450; --border-soft:#1b2942;
  --text:#e8eefb; --dim:#93a4c0; --faint:#5f7292;
  --c1:#2dd4bf; --c2:#fbbf24; --c3:#fb7185; --c4:#7aa5f8;
  --good:#34d399; --warn:#fbbf24; --bad:#fb7185;
  --shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(2,8,20,.45);
  --shadow-sm:0 3px 10px rgba(2,8,20,.35);
  --dot:rgba(147,164,192,.09);
  --glow1:rgba(45,212,191,.09); --glow2:rgba(251,191,36,.055);
  --btn-ink:#05231c;
}
:root[data-theme="light"]{
  color-scheme:light;
  --bg:#eef1f7; --surface:#ffffff; --surface2:#f3f6fb;
  --border:#dfe4ef; --border-soft:#e9edf5;
  --text:#101b30; --dim:#5c6c86; --faint:#93a1b8;
  --c1:#0d9488; --c2:#d97706; --c3:#e11d48; --c4:#2f6fed;
  --good:#059669; --warn:#d97706; --bad:#e11d48;
  --shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(23,43,77,.09);
  --shadow-sm:0 3px 10px rgba(23,43,77,.07);
  --dot:rgba(16,27,48,.06);
  --glow1:rgba(13,148,136,.10); --glow2:rgba(217,119,6,.07);
  --btn-ink:#ffffff;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font:400 14px/1.55 var(--fb); color:var(--text); background:var(--bg);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; min-height:100vh;
}
/* ambient layered background: dot-grid + two soft radial tints */
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
  background-image:radial-gradient(var(--dot) 1px,transparent 1.4px);background-size:23px 23px;}
body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
  background:radial-gradient(640px 420px at 88% -8%,var(--glow1),transparent 62%),
             radial-gradient(720px 520px at -8% 108%,var(--glow2),transparent 60%);}
body,.card,.sidebar,.topbar,.search,.ranges,.rbtn,.fchip,.nitem,.budget,.userchip,
.pill,.toast,.ctooltip,input,button{
  transition:background-color .35s ease,border-color .35s ease,color .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease;
}
::selection{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 30%,transparent)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 70%,transparent);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
svg{display:block}
.mono{font-family:var(--fm)}

/* ============ APP FRAME ============ */
.app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:246px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:100vh;position:relative;z-index:1}

/* ---- sidebar ---- */
.sidebar{
  position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background:var(--surface);border-right:1px solid var(--border);padding:20px 14px 16px;z-index:60;
}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:2px 8px 20px}
.brand .mark{width:34px;height:34px;flex:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 35%,transparent))}
.brand b{font:800 17px/1 var(--fd);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand .tag{font:600 8.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--c1);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 45%,transparent);
  padding:2.5px 6px;border-radius:5px;margin-left:2px;align-self:flex-start}
.navlabel{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;padding:16px 12px 7px}
.nitem{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:9px 12px 9px 15px;border-radius:9px;
  color:var(--dim);font-weight:500;font-size:13.5px;position:relative;margin-bottom:2px;
}
.nitem svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;transition:transform .25s}
.nitem:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--surface2)}
.nitem:hover svg{transform:translateX(2px) scale(1.06)}
.nitem.active{color:var(--text);background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 15%,transparent),transparent 78%)}
.nitem.active::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:22%;bottom:22%;width:3px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--c1)}
.nitem.active svg{color:var(--c1)}
.nbadge{margin-left:auto;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);padding:2px 7px;border-radius:99px;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c2) 16%,transparent);color:var(--c2)}
.sidefoot{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.budget{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px}
.brow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;color:var(--dim)}
.brow b{font:600 12px var(--fm);color:var(--text)}
.bbar{height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--faint) 22%,transparent);margin:9px 0 8px;overflow:hidden}
.bbar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--c1),var(--c2));
  transition:width 1.3s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.3,1)}
.bnote{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);color:var(--faint)}
.userchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--border-soft);cursor:pointer}
.userchip:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
.avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--c1),var(--c4));color:#07211c;font:700 12px var(--fd)}
.userchip .un{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
.userchip .ur{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)}
.userchip svg{margin-left:auto;width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--faint)}

.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(4,9,18,.55);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s;z-index:55}
body.nav-open .scrim{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}

/* ---- topbar ---- */
.maincol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.topbar{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  padding:11px 26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 86%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(9px);
}
.iconbtn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);display:grid;place-items:center;
  color:var(--dim);background:var(--surface);position:relative;flex:none}
.iconbtn:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 45%,var(--border));transform:translateY(-1px)}
.iconbtn svg{width:17px;height:17px}
#menuBtn{display:none}
.crumb{font-size:13px;color:var(--faint);white-space:nowrap}
.crumb b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.crumb span{margin:0 7px;opacity:.5}
.search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:10px;padding:0 11px;height:36px;width:min(340px,100%);margin-left:auto;cursor:text}
.search:focus-within{border-color:var(--c1);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 18%,transparent);width:min(400px,100%)}
.search svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--faint);flex:none}
.search input{border:none;background:none;outline:none;color:var(--text);font:inherit;font-size:13px;width:100%}
.search input::placeholder{color:var(--faint)}
.search kbd{font:500 10px var(--fm);color:var(--faint);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 6px;flex:none}
.statpill{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:500 11.5px var(--fm);color:var(--dim);
  border:1px solid var(--border-soft);background:var(--surface);border-radius:99px;padding:7px 13px;white-space:nowrap}
.pdot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--good);position:relative;flex:none}
.pdot::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-4px;border-radius:99px;border:1.5px solid var(--good);
  animation:ripple 2.2s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes ripple{0%{transform:scale(.4);opacity:.9}80%,100%{transform:scale(1.25);opacity:0}}
#clock{font:500 12px var(--fm);color:var(--dim);min-width:66px;text-align:center}
.tbtn{overflow:hidden}
.tbtn svg{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:auto;transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1),opacity .3s}
[data-theme="dark"] .tbtn .i-sun{opacity:0;transform:rotate(120deg) scale(.4)}
[data-theme="light"] .tbtn .i-moon{opacity:0;transform:rotate(-120deg) scale(.4)}
.bcount{position:absolute;top:-5px;right:-5px;min-width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--c3);
  color:#fff;font:600 9.5px/16px var(--fm);text-align:center;padding:0 4px;border:2px solid var(--bg)}

/* ---- content ---- */
.content{padding:26px 26px 42px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;max-width:1560px;width:100%;margin:0 auto}
.pagehead{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pagehead h1{font:800 clamp(23px,2.6vw,31px)/1.15 var(--fd);letter-spacing:-.025em}
.pagehead .sub{color:var(--dim);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:6px}
.pagehead .sub b{color:var(--c1);font-weight:600}
.ph-actions{display:flex;gap:10px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:600 13px var(--fb);padding:9px 16px;border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .25s,background-color .3s,border-color .3s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1.5px)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(0)}
.btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.btn.ghost{color:var(--dim)}
.btn.ghost:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--faint)}
.btn.prime{background:var(--c1);border-color:var(--c1);color:var(--btn-ink);box-shadow:0 6px 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 35%,transparent)}
.btn.prime:hover{box-shadow:0 10px 24px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 45%,transparent)}

.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.cardhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;padding:18px 20px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cardhead h3{font:600 15px var(--fd);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.csub{color:var(--dim);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:3px}

/* reveal */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);animation:rise .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) forwards;animation-delay:var(--d,0s)}
@keyframes rise{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ---- KPIs ---- */
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.kpi{padding:16px 18px 13px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .25s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s,background-color .35s}
.kpi:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--kc,var(--c1)) 40%,var(--border))}
.kpi::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--kc,var(--c1)),transparent 70%);opacity:.85}
.kpitop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.klabel{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint)}
.delta{font:600 11px var(--fm);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:99px;display:inline-flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}
.delta.good{color:var(--good);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--good) 13%,transparent)}
.delta.bad{color:var(--bad);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bad) 13%,transparent)}
.kval{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:5px}
.kval .num{font:600 27px/1 var(--fm);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.kval .unit{font:500 13px var(--fm);color:var(--dim)}
.spark{width:100%;height:36px;margin-top:auto}
.sline{transition:stroke-width .25s}
.kpi:hover .sline{stroke-width:2.7}
.minibars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;height:36px;margin-top:auto}
.minibars i{flex:1;border-radius:2.5px 2.5px 0 0;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c3) 30%,transparent);
  animation:barup .7s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.3,1) backwards;animation-delay:calc(var(--i)*45ms)}
.minibars i.hot{background:var(--c3)}
@keyframes barup{from{transform:scaleY(0)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
.minibars i{transform-origin:bottom}
.kpi.ringk{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.kpi.ringk .kcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:0}
.ring{width:74px;height:74px;position:relative;flex:none}
.ring svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.ring .rbg{fill:none;stroke:color-mix(in srgb,var(--faint) 22%,transparent);stroke-width:6.5}
.ring .rfg{fill:none;stroke:var(--c4);stroke-width:6.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:163.4;
  stroke-dashoffset:163.4;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.4s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.3,1)}
.ringtxt{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1px}
.ringtxt .num{font:600 16px var(--fm)}
.ringtxt span{font:500 10px var(--fm);color:var(--dim)}

/* ---- mid grid: chart + side ---- */
.midgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.95fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:stretch}
.chartcard{padding:18px 20px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.chhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.legend{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font:500 12px var(--fb);color:var(--dim);
  border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:99px;padding:4.5px 11px;transition:all .25s}
.lchip i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--sc)}
.lchip:hover{border-color:var(--sc);color:var(--text)}
.lchip.off{opacity:.42}
.lchip.off i{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.6px var(--sc)}
.ranges{display:flex;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:10px;padding:3px;gap:2px}
.rbtn{font:600 11.5px var(--fm);color:var(--faint);padding:5.5px 12px;border-radius:7.5px;border:1px solid transparent}
.rbtn:hover{color:var(--text)}
.rbtn.active{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.ainote{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;margin:14px 2px 6px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);min-height:20px}
.aispark{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--c2);flex:none;margin-top:2px;animation:twirl 5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes twirl{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0) scale(1)}50%{transform:rotate(18deg) scale(1.15)}}
#tw{transition:opacity .4s}
.twcaret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:13px;background:var(--c1);margin-left:2px;vertical-align:-2px;animation:blink 1s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
.chartwrap{position:relative;height:296px;margin-top:4px}
#chart{width:100%;height:100%;cursor:crosshair}
.gl{stroke:var(--border-soft);stroke-dasharray:3 5}
.ylab,.xlab{font:500 10px var(--fm);fill:var(--faint)}
.sg{transition:opacity .45s}
.area{pointer-events:none}
.xhair{stroke:var(--faint);stroke-dasharray:4 4;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s}
.cdot{fill:var(--surface);stroke:var(--sc);stroke-width:2.2;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s}
.anom .aring{fill:none;stroke:var(--c3);stroke-width:1.5;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:aping 2.4s ease-out infinite}
.anom .adot{fill:var(--c3)}
@keyframes aping{0%{transform:scale(.4);opacity:.95}70%,100%{transform:scale(2);opacity:0}}
.ctooltip{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:6;min-width:168px;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);font-size:12px}
.tlab{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:6px}
.trow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:2.5px 0}
.trow i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:99px;flex:none}
.trow span{color:var(--dim)}
.trow b{margin-left:auto;font:600 12px var(--fm)}
.tanom{margin-top:7px;padding-top:7px;border-top:1px dashed var(--border);color:var(--c3);font-size:11.5px;display:flex;gap:6px}
.chartfoot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 2px 6px;font:500 11px var(--fm);color:var(--faint)}
.chartfoot b{color:var(--dim);font-weight:500}

.sidecol{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;gap:16px;min-width:0}
/* donut */
.donutwrap{position:relative;width:164px;margin:16px auto 6px}
.donut{width:164px;height:164px}
.donut circle.seg{fill:none;stroke-width:15;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .3s,stroke-width .3s,stroke-dasharray 1s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.3,1)}
.donut.focus circle.seg{opacity:.28}
.donut.focus circle.seg.on{opacity:1;stroke-width:18.5}
.donutcenter{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;pointer-events:none}
.donutcenter b{font:600 20px var(--fm);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.donutcenter span{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.dlegend{list-style:none;padding:8px 18px 16px}
.dlegend li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s}
.dlegend li:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
.dlegend i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px;flex:none}
.dlegend .dv{margin-left:auto;font:600 12px var(--fm)}
.dlegend .dr{font:400 11px var(--fm);color:var(--faint);width:46px;text-align:right}
/* findings */
.insightcard{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.aihead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:16px 18px 0}
.aihead svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--c2)}
.aihead h3{font:600 14px var(--fd)}
.aihead .live-tag{margin-left:auto;font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--c1);
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 40%,transparent);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:99px}
.findings{list-style:none;padding:12px 18px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.findings li{display:flex;gap:11px;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.5;transition:background-color .2s}
.findings li:hover{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text)}
.fdot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:99px;flex:none;margin-top:5px}
.fdot.good{background:var(--good);box-shadow:0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--good) 60%,transparent)}
.fdot.warn{background:var(--warn);box-shadow:0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--warn) 60%,transparent)}
.fdot.info{background:var(--c4);box-shadow:0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c4) 60%,transparent)}
.findings b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.mini{font:600 11px var(--fb);color:var(--c1);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1) 45%,transparent);
  border-radius:7px;padding:2.5px 9px;margin-left:6px;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .2s}
.mini:hover{background:var(--c1);color:var(--btn-ink)}
.mini.done{color:var(--good);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--good) 45%,transparent);background:none;cursor:default}

/* ---- bottom grid ---- */
.botgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.95fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px}
.tablecard{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.filters{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fchip{font:600 11.5px var(--fm);color:var(--faint);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 12px}
.fchip:hover{color:var(--text)}
.fchip.active{color:var(--text);background:var(--surface2);border-color:var(--faint)}
.fchip .ct{opacity:.6;margin-left:3px}
.tablewrap{overflow-x:auto;margin-top:14px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;min-width:620px}
th{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);text-align:left;
  padding:9px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
th.r,td.r{text-align:right}
td{padding:11.5px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);white-space:nowrap}
tbody tr{transition:background-color .18s;animation:rise .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) backwards;animation-delay:var(--d,0s)}
tbody tr:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
tbody tr.hide{display:none}
td.job{font:500 12.5px var(--fm);color:var(--dim)}
td.num{font:500 12.5px var(--fm)}
.mdot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:0}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:600 11px var(--fm);padding:3.5px 10px;border-radius:99px}
.pill.ok{color:var(--good);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--good) 12%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--good) 28%,transparent)}
.pill.run{color:var(--c4);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c4) 12%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c4) 30%,transparent)}
.pill.run::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:currentColor;animation:blink 1.3s infinite}
.pill.err{color:var(--bad);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bad) 11%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bad) 28%,transparent)}
.pill.q{color:var(--faint);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--faint) 12%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--faint) 26%,transparent)}
.rowact{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--faint);opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s,background-color .2s}
tbody tr:hover .rowact{opacity:1}
.rowact:hover{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text)}
.rowact svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.tfoot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:13px 20px;font-size:12px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:auto}
.tfoot a{color:var(--c1);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.tfoot a:hover{text-decoration:underline}

/* feed */
.feedcard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
.live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font:700 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--bad)}
.live i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--bad);animation:blink 1.4s infinite}
#feed{list-style:none;padding:6px 0;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;max-height:372px}
#feed::-webkit-scrollbar,.tablewrap::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px}
#feed::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,.tablewrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border);border-radius:99px}
#feed li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:12px 1fr auto;gap:11px;align-items:start;padding:11px 20px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim)}
#feed li:last-child{border-bottom:none}
#feed li b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
#feed .ft{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);color:var(--faint);margin-top:2px}
#feed li.in{animation:feedin .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)}
#feed li.out{opacity:0;transform:translateX(10px);transition:.3s}
@keyframes feedin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* toasts */
#toasts{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:99;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.toast{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-left:3px solid var(--c1);border-radius:11px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  font-size:13px;max-width:340px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
.toast svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--c1);flex:none}

/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
@media (max-width:1180px){
  .midgrid,.botgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sidecol{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto}
  .kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media (max-width:1080px){
  .app{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sidebar{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:256px;transform:translateX(-105%);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.3,1);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
  body.nav-open .sidebar{transform:none}
  #menuBtn{display:grid}
  .crumb{display:none}
}
@media (max-width:820px){
  .sidecol{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .statpill,#clock{display:none}
  .content{padding:20px 16px 34px}
  .topbar{padding:10px 16px}
  .chartwrap{height:240px}
}
@media (max-width:600px){
  .kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .search kbd{display:none}
  .ph-actions{width:100%}
  .ph-actions .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="app">
  <!-- ============ SIDEBAR ============ -->
  <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
    <div class="brand">
      <svg class="mark" viewBox="0 0 34 34" aria-hidden="true">
        <defs><linearGradient id="lg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2dd4bf"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#7aa5f8"/>
        </linearGradient></defs>
        <rect width="34" height="34" rx="9.5" fill="url(#lg)"/>
        <path d="M10.2 22.5 17 10l7 10.4-14 2.1z" fill="none" stroke="rgba(6,22,19,.5)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <circle cx="10.2" cy="22.5" r="2.7" fill="#07211c"/><circle cx="17" cy="10" r="2.7" fill="#07211c"/><circle cx="24" cy="20.4" r="2.7" fill="#07211c"/>
      </svg>
      <b>Synapse</b><span class="tag">OPS</span>
    </div>

    <nav aria-label="Primary">
      <p class="navlabel">Main</p>
      <a class="nitem active" href="#" data-name="Overview"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.8"/><rect x="13.5" y="3.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.8"/><rect x="3.5" y="13.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.8"/><rect x="13.5" y="13.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.8"/></svg>Overview</a>
      <a class="nitem" href="#" data-name="Analytics"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3.5 17.5 9 11l3.6 3.4L20.5 6"/><path d="M15.5 6h5v5"/></svg>Analytics</a>
      <a class="nitem" href="#" data-name="Models"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 2.8 20.2 7.4v9.2L12 21.2 3.8 16.6V7.4z"/><path d="M3.8 7.4 12 12l8.2-4.6"/><path d="M12 12v9.2"/></svg>Models</a>
      <a class="nitem" href="#" data-name="Datasets"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><ellipse cx="12" cy="5.5" rx="8" ry="2.8"/><path d="M4 5.5v13c0 1.55 3.58 2.8 8 2.8s8-1.25 8-2.8v-13"/><path d="M4 12c0 1.55 3.58 2.8 8 2.8s8-1.25 8-2.8"/></svg>Datasets</a>

      <p class="navlabel">System</p>
      <a class="nitem" href="#" data-name="Automations"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13 2 3 14h9l-1 8 10-12h-9l1-8z"/></svg>Automations<span class="nbadge">3</span></a>
      <a class="nitem" href="#" data-name="Integrations"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 0l2.12-2.12a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07L11 4.95"/><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.07 0L4.8 13.12a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.13-1.13"/></svg>Integrations</a>
      <a class="nitem" href="#" data-name="Security"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 2.8 19.2 5.6v5.2c0 4.9-3.1 8-7.2 10.2C7.9 18.8 4.8 15.7 4.8 10.8V5.6z"/><path d="m9 11.4 2.1 2.1 4.1-4.9"/></svg>Security</a>
      <a class="nitem" href="#" data-name="Settings"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 6.5h8.6M17.6 6.5H20M4 12h3.4M12.2 12H20M4 17.5h8.6M17.6 17.5H20"/><circle cx="15.2" cy="6.5" r="2.2"/><circle cx="9.8" cy="12" r="2.2"/><circle cx="15.2" cy="17.5" r="2.2"/></svg>Settings</a>
    </nav>

    <div class="sidefoot">
      <div class="budget">
        <div class="brow"><span>Compute budget</span><b>72%</b></div>
        <div class="bbar"><i id="budgetFill"></i></div>
        <p class="bnote">7,214 / 10,000 GPU-hrs</p>
      </div>
      <div class="userchip" tabindex="0">
        <div class="avatar">AO</div>
        <div><div class="un">Amara Osei</div><div class="ur">Platform Admin</div></div>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1.3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1.3" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  </aside>
  <div class="scrim" id="scrim"></div>

  <!-- ============ MAIN ============ -->
  <div class="maincol">
    <header class="topbar">
      <button class="iconbtn" id="menuBtn" aria-label="Toggle navigation"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16"/></svg></button>
      <div class="crumb">Console<span>/</span><b id="crumbLeaf">Overview</b></div>
      <label class="search">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="m20 20-3.8-3.8"/></svg>
        <input id="q" type="text" placeholder="Search models, jobs, docs…" autocomplete="off">
        <kbd>⌘K</kbd>
      </label>
      <div class="statpill"><span class="pdot"></span>All systems nominal</div>
      <div id="clock" class="mono">--:--:--</div>
      <button class="iconbtn tbtn" id="themeBtn" aria-label="Toggle light / dark theme">
        <svg class="i-sun" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.2"/><path d="M12 2.6v2.3M12 19.1v2.3M2.6 12h2.3M19.1 12h2.3M5.1 5.1l1.6 1.6M17.3 17.3l1.6 1.6M18.9 5.1l-1.6 1.6M6.7 17.3l-1.6 1.6"/></svg>
        <svg class="i-moon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20.4 14.2A8.5 8.5 0 1 1 9.8 3.6a7 7 0 1 0 10.6 10.6z"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="iconbtn" id="bellBtn" aria-label="Notifications">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 9a6 6 0 1 0-12 0c0 6-2.5 7-2.5 7h17S18 15 18 9"/><path d="M10.3 20a2 2 0 0 0 3.4 0"/></svg>
        <span class="bcount">3</span>
      </button>
    </header>

    <main class="content">
      <!-- page head -->
      <div class="pagehead reveal" style="--d:.02s">
        <div>
          <h1 id="greeting">Good evening, Amara</h1>
          <p class="sub">Your fleet handled <b>1.28M requests</b> in the last 24h — here's the full picture. <span id="dateline"></span></p>
        </div>
        <div class="ph-actions">
          <button class="btn ghost" id="exportBtn"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 4v10m0 0 4-4m-4 4-4-4"/><path d="M4.5 19.5h15"/></svg>Export</button>
          <button class="btn prime" id="deployBtn"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Deploy model</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- KPIs -->
      <section class="kpis">
        <article class="card kpi reveal" style="--d:.06s;--kc:var(--c1)">
          <div class="kpitop"><span class="klabel">Requests · 24h</span><span class="delta good">↗ 12.4%</span></div>
          <div class="kval"><span class="num" data-target="1.28" data-dec="2">0</span><span class="unit">M</span></div>
          <svg class="spark" id="sp1" preserveAspectRatio="none"></svg>
        </article>
        <article class="card kpi reveal" style="--d:.12s;--kc:var(--c4)">
          <div class="kpitop"><span class="klabel">Median latency</span><span class="delta good">↘ 8.1%</span></div>
          <div class="kval"><span class="num" data-target="212" data-dec="0">0</span><span class="unit">ms</span></div>
          <svg class="spark" id="sp2" preserveAspectRatio="none"></svg>
        </article>
        <article class="card kpi reveal" style="--d:.18s;--kc:var(--c3)">
          <div class="kpitop"><span class="klabel">Error rate</span><span class="delta bad">↗ 0.06pt</span></div>
          <div class="kval"><span class="num" data-target="0.42" data-dec="2">0</span><span class="unit">%</span></div>
          <div class="minibars" id="errbars"></div>
        </article>
        <article class="card kpi ringk reveal" style="--d:.24s;--kc:var(--c4)">
          <div class="kcol">
            <div class="kpitop"><span class="klabel">GPU utilization</span></div>
            <div class="kval"><span class="num" data-target="78" data-dec="0">0</span><span class="unit">%</span></div>
            <span class="klabel" style="letter-spacing:.06em">16 / 20 nodes hot</span>
          </div>
          <div class="ring">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64"><circle class="rbg" cx="32" cy="32" r="26"/><circle class="rfg" id="ringFg" cx="32" cy="32" r="26"/></svg>
            <div class="ringtxt"><b class="num" data-target="78" data-dec="0">0</b><span>%</span></div>
          </div>
        </article>
      </section>

      <!-- chart + side column -->
      <section class="midgrid">
        <article class="card chartcard reveal" style="--d:.28s">
          <div class="chhead">
            <div>

              <button class="rbtn" data-range="90D">90D</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p class="ainote">
            <svg class="aispark" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 4.2 13.7 9.3 18.8 11 13.7 12.7 12 17.8 10.3 12.7 5.2 11 10.3 9.3z"/><path d="M19 3.2v3.6M17.2 5h3.6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/></svg>
            <span><span id="tw"></span><span class="twcaret"></span></span>
          </p>
          <div class="chartwrap" id="chartwrap">
            <svg id="chart" role="img" aria-label="Inference telemetry line chart"></svg>
            <div class="ctooltip" id="ctip"></div>
          </div>
          <footer class="chartfoot">
            <span>prod-1 · us-east + eu-west</span>
            <span>updated <b id="upd">just now</b></span>
          </footer>
        </article>

        <div class="sidecol">
          <article class="card reveal" style="--d:.34s">
            <header class="cardhead"><div><h3>Model mix</h3><p class="csub">Share of inference traffic · 7d</p></div></header>
            <div class="donutwrap">
              <svg class="donut" id="donut" viewBox="0 0 160 160"><g transform="rotate(-90 80 80)" id="donutSegs"></g></svg>
              <div class="donutcenter"><b id="dval">1.28M</b><span id="dlab">requests</span></div>
            </div>
            <ul class="dlegend" id="dlegend"></ul>
          </article>

          <article class="card insightcard reveal" style="--d:.4s">
            <div class="aihead">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 4.2 13.7 9.3 18.8 11 13.7 12.7 12 17.8 10.3 12.7 5.2 11 10.3 9.3z"/></svg>
              <h3>Copilot findings</h3><span class="live-tag">AUTO</span>

              <li><i class="fdot info"></i><p>Rebalance suggestion: shift <b>12% of Orion traffic</b> to us-east to level queue depth. <button class="mini" id="applyBtn">Apply</button></p></li>
            </ul>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- table + feed -->
      <section class="botgrid">
        <article class="card tablecard reveal" style="--d:.44s">
          <header class="cardhead">
            <div><h3>Inference jobs</h3><p class="csub">Last hour · cluster prod-1</p></div>
            <div class="filters" id="filters">
              <button class="fchip active" data-f="all">All<span class="ct">7</span></button>
              <button class="fchip" data-f="run">Running<span class="ct">1</span></button>
              <button class="fchip" data-f="ok">Completed<span class="ct">4</span></button>
              <button class="fchip" data-f="err">Failed<span class="ct">1</span></button>
            </div>
          </header>
          <div class="tablewrap">
            <table>
              <thead><tr><th>Job</th><th>Model</th><th>Status</th><th class="r">Duration</th><th class="r">Tokens</th><th>Started</th><th></th></tr></thead>
              <tbody id="jobs">
                <tr data-status="ok" style="--d:.5s"><td class="job">job-9821</td><td><i class="mdot" style="background:var(--c1)"></i>Nova-70B</td><td><span class="pill ok">Completed</span></td><td class="r num">2m 14s</td><td class="r num">48.2k</td><td class="num">2 min ago</td><td><button class="rowact" aria-label="Row actions"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.5"/><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1.5"/></svg></button></td></tr>

<script>
"use strict";
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));

/* ---------- theme ---------- */
$('themeBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{

/* ---------- clock, greeting, date ---------- */
function tick(){$('clock').textContent=new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB')}
tick();setInterval(tick,1000);
(function(){

/* ---------- sidebar (mobile + nav switching) ---------- */
$('menuBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>document.body.classList.toggle('nav-open'));
$('scrim').addEventListener('click',()=>document.body.classList.remove('nav-open'));
document.querySelectorAll('.nitem').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{

/* ---------- search shortcut ---------- */
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const typing=/INPUT|TEXTAREA/.test(document.activeElement.tagName);
  if((e.key==='/'&&!typing)||((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='k')){e.preventDefault();$('q').focus()}

/* ---------- toasts ---------- */
function toast(msg){
  const t=document.createElement('div');t.className='toast';
  t.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 4.2 13.7 9.3 18.8 11 13.7 12.7 12 17.8 10.3 12.7 5.2 11 10.3 9.3z"/></svg><span>${msg}</span>`;
  $('toasts').appendChild(t);
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>t.classList.add('show')));
  setTimeout(()=>{t.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),420)},3400);
}
$('deployBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>toast('Deployment wizard opening — Nova-70B v2.4 staged.'));
$('exportBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>toast('Report queued. We\u2019ll ping you when the CSV is ready.'));
$('bellBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>toast('3 unread alerts — 1 needs attention.'));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-toast]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',()=>toast(el.dataset.toast)));
$('applyBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  this.textContent='Drafted ✓';this.classList.add('done');

});

/* ---------- count-up numbers ---------- */
function countUp(el){
  const t=parseFloat(el.dataset.target),d=+(el.dataset.dec||0),dur=1300,st=performance.now();
  (function f(now){
    const p=Math.min(1,(now-st)/dur),e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);
    el.textContent=(t*e).toFixed(d);
    if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f);
  })(st);
}
document.querySelectorAll('.num[data-target]').forEach((el,i)=>setTimeout(()=>countUp(el),250+i*120));

/* ---------- smooth path helper ---------- */
function smooth(pts){
  if(pts.length<3)return 'M'+pts.map(p=>p.join(',')).join('L');
  let d=`M${pts[0][0]},${pts[0][1]}`;
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++){
    const p0=pts[Math.max(0,i-1)],p1=pts[i],p2=pts[i+1],p3=pts[Math.min(pts.length-1,i+2)];
    d+=`C${(p1[0]+(p2[0]-p0[0])/6).toFixed(2)},${(p1[1]+(p2[1]-p0[1])/6).toFixed(2)},${(p2[0]-(p3[0]-p1[0])/6).toFixed(2)},${(p2[1]-(p3[1]-p1[1])/6).toFixed(2)},${p2[0]},${p2[1]}`;
  }
  return d;
}

/* ---------- sparklines + mini bars + ring + budget ---------- */
function spark(el,arr,cvar){
  const w=120,h=34,min=Math.min(...arr),max=Math.max(...arr);
  const pts=arr.map((v,i)=>[+(i/(arr.length-1)*w).toFixed(1),+(h-4-((v-min)/((max-min)||1))*(h-9)).toFixed(1)]);
  const d=smooth(pts);
  el.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${w} ${h}`);
  el.innerHTML=`<path d="${d} L${w},${h} L0,${h} Z" fill="color-mix(in srgb,var(${cvar}) 13%,transparent)"/>
  <path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="var(${cvar})" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" class="sline" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>`;
}
spark($('sp1'),[22,28,25,34,31,42,38,47,44,58,52,64,60,72],'--c1');
spark($('sp2'),[70,64,66,58,60,52,55,47,50,44,46,40,42,36],'--c4');
(function(){
  const hs=[34,46,40,52,44,58,47,55,42,48,60,50,72,96],box=$('errbars');
  hs.forEach((h,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('i');b.style.height=h+'%';b.style.setProperty('--i',i);if(i===hs.length-1)b.classList.add('hot');box.appendChild(b)});
})();
setTimeout(()=>{$('ringFg').style.strokeDashoffset=163.4*(1-0.78)},400);
setTimeout(()=>{$('budgetFill').style.width='72%'},500);

/* ---------- donut ---------- */
const MODELS=[
  {name:'Nova-70B', v:38, c:'--c1', req:'486k'},
  {name:'Atlas-7B', v:27, c:'--c4', req:'345k'},
  {name:'Orion-Embed',v:21,c:'--c2', req:'268k'},
  {name:'Legacy-v1',v:14, c:'--c3', req:'179k'},
];
(function(){
  const segs=$('donutSegs'),leg=$('dlegend');let acc=0;
  MODELS.forEach((m,i)=>{
    const c=document.createElementNS(NS,'circle');
    c.setAttribute('cx',80);c.setAttribute('cy',80);c.setAttribute('r',58);
    c.setAttribute('pathLength',100);c.setAttribute('class','seg');
    c.style.stroke=`var(${m.c})`;
    c.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray','0 100');
    c.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset',-(acc+1));
    segs.appendChild(c);
    setTimeout(()=>c.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray',`${m.v-2} ${100-m.v+2}`),450+i*140);
    acc+=m.v;
    const li=document.createElement('li');
    li.innerHTML=`<i style="background:var(${m.c})"></i><span>${m.name}</span><span class="dr mono">${m.req}</span><b class="dv">${m.v}%</b>`;
    leg.appendChild(li);
    const focus=on=>{
      $('donut').classList.toggle('focus',on);
      c.classList.toggle('on',on);
      $('dval').textContent=on?m.v+'%':'1.28M';
      $('dlab').textContent=on?m.name:'requests';
    };
    [li,c].forEach(el=>{el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>focus(true));el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>focus(false))});
  });
})();

/* ================= MAIN CHART ================= */
const SERIES_DEF=[
  {id:'req',name:'Requests',   css:'--c1',area:true, fmt:v=>v.toFixed(1)+'k'},
  {id:'tok',name:'Tokens',     css:'--c2',           fmt:v=>v.toFixed(1)+' M'},
  {id:'lat',name:'p95 latency',css:'--c3',           fmt:v=>Math.round(v*3.4+40)+' ms'},
];
const RANGES={
  '24H':{n:24,seed:7, step:3600e3,   w:1.6,fmt:d=>`${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:00`},
  '7D' :{n:28,seed:21,step:6*3600e3, w:2.4,fmt:d=>`${['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'][d.getDay()]} ${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}h`},
  '30D':{n:30,seed:5, step:86400e3,  w:1.3,fmt:d=>d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'})},
  '90D':{n:32,seed:13,step:2.82*86400e3,w:1,fmt:d=>d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'})},
};
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
function genData(range){
  const cfg=RANGES[range],rnd=mulberry32(cfg.seed),n=cfg.n;
  const mk=(base,vol,amp,ph)=>{let v=0;const a=[];for(let i=0;i<n;i++){v+=(rnd()-.5)*vol;
    a.push(Math.max(10,base+v+Math.sin(i/n*Math.PI*2*cfg.w+ph)*amp))}return a};
  const req=mk(58,6.5,9,1.1),tok=mk(46,7,7,2.6),lat=mk(37,4.5,5,.4);
  const ai=Math.round(n*.62);req[ai]+=16;lat[ai]+=12;
  const now=Date.now();
  const labels=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>cfg.fmt(new Date(now-(n-1-i)*cfg.step)));
  return {req,tok,lat,labels,anomaly:ai};
}
const CH={wrap:$('chartwrap'),svg:$('chart'),tip:$('ctip'),range:'24H',
          visible:{req:true,tok:true,lat:true},data:genData('24H')};

/* legend chips */
SERIES_DEF.forEach(sd=>{
  const b=document.createElement('button');
  b.className='lchip';b.style.setProperty('--sc',`var(${sd.css})`);
  b.innerHTML=`<i></i>${sd.name}`;
  b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    CH.visible[sd.id]=!CH.visible[sd.id];
    b.classList.toggle('off',!CH.visible[sd.id]);
    const g=CH.svg.querySelector(`.sg[data-id="${sd.id}"]`);
    if(g)g.style.opacity=CH.visible[sd.id]?1:0;
    const dot=CH.svg.querySelector(`.cdot[data-id="${sd.id}"]`);
    if(dot&&!CH.visible[sd.id])dot.style.opacity=0;
  });
  $('legend').appendChild(b);
});

function renderChart(animate){
  const W=CH.wrap.clientWidth,H=CH.wrap.clientHeight;
  if(W<60)return;
  CH.W=W;CH.H=H;
  const P={l:48,r:14,t:14,b:28};CH.P=P;
  const iw=W-P.l-P.r,ih=H-P.t-P.b;CH.iw=iw;CH.ih=ih;
  const n=CH.data.req.length;
  const all=[...CH.data.req,...CH.data.tok,...CH.data.lat];
  const lo=Math.min(...all)*.9,hi=Math.max(...all)*1.07;
  const X=i=>P.l+i*iw/(n-1), Y=v=>P.t+(1-(v-lo)/(hi-lo))*ih;
  CH.X=X;CH.Y=Y;

  let s=`<defs><linearGradient id="gReq" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" style="stop-color:var(--c1);stop-opacity:.26"/>
    <stop offset="1" style="stop-color:var(--c1);stop-opacity:0"/></linearGradient></defs>`;
  for(let g=0;g<=4;g++){
    const t=g/4,yy=(P.t+t*ih).toFixed(1),val=hi-(hi-lo)*t;
    s+=`<line class="gl" x1="${P.l}" x2="${W-P.r}" y1="${yy}" y2="${yy}"/>`;
    s+=`<text class="ylab" x="${P.l-10}" y="${+yy+3.5}" text-anchor="end">${Math.round(val)}</text>`;
  }
  const step=Math.max(1,Math.round((n-1)/6));
  for(let i=0;i<n;i+=step)
    s+=`<text class="xlab" x="${X(i).toFixed(1)}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle">${CH.data.labels[i]}</text>`;

  SERIES_DEF.forEach(sd=>{
    const pts=CH.data[sd.id].map((v,i)=>[+X(i).toFixed(2),+Y(v).toFixed(2)]);
    const d=smooth(pts);
    s+=`<g class="sg" data-id="${sd.id}" style="--sc:var(${sd.css});opacity:${CH.visible[sd.id]?1:0}">`;
    if(sd.area)s+=`<path class="area" d="${d} L${X(n-1).toFixed(1)},${P.t+ih} L${P.l},${P.t+ih} Z" fill="url(#gReq)"/>`;
    s+=`<path class="line" d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="var(--sc)" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
    s+=`</g>`;
  });
  const ai=CH.data.anomaly;
  s+=`<g class="anom" transform="translate(${X(ai).toFixed(1)},${Y(CH.data.req[ai]).toFixed(1)})">
      <circle class="aring" r="8"/><circle class="adot" r="3.2"/></g>`;
  s+=`<line class="xhair" id="xh" x1="-9" x2="-9" y1="${P.t}" y2="${P.t+ih}"/>`;
  s+=`<g>`+SERIES_DEF.map(sd=>`<circle class="cdot" data-id="${sd.id}" r="4.2" style="--sc:var(${sd.css})"/>`).join('')+`</g>`;

  CH.svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
  CH.svg.innerHTML=s;

  if(animate){
    CH.svg.querySelectorAll('.line').forEach(p=>{
      const L=p.getTotalLength();
      p.style.strokeDasharray=L;p.style.strokeDashoffset=L;
      p.getBoundingClientRect();
      p.style.transition='stroke-dashoffset 1.15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)';
      p.style.strokeDashoffset=0;
      setTimeout(()=>{p.style.strokeDasharray='none';p.style.transition=''},1300);
    });
    CH.svg.querySelectorAll('.area').forEach(a=>{
      a.style.opacity=0;a.getBoundingClientRect();
      a.style.transition='opacity 1s .35s';a.style.opacity=1;
    });
  }
}
function hideTip(){
  CH.tip.style.opacity=0;
  const xh=$('xh');if(xh)xh.style.opacity=0;
  CH.svg.querySelectorAll('.cdot').forEach(d=>d.style.opacity=0);
}
CH.svg.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  if(!CH.X)return;
  const r=CH.svg.getBoundingClientRect(),px=e.clientX-r.left,{P,iw}=CH,n=CH.data.req.length;
  if(px<P.l-8||px>CH.W-P.r+8){hideTip();return}
  let i=clamp(Math.round((px-P.l)*(n-1)/iw),0,n-1);
  const cx=CH.X(i),xh=$('xh');
  xh.setAttribute('x1',cx);xh.setAttribute('x2',cx);xh.style.opacity=1;
  let topY=1e9,rows='';
  SERIES_DEF.forEach(sd=>{
    const dot=CH.svg.querySelector(`.cdot[data-id="${sd.id}"]`);
    if(!CH.visible[sd.id]){dot.style.opacity=0;return}
    const cy=CH.Y(CH.data[sd.id][i]);
    dot.setAttribute('cx',cx);dot.setAttribute('cy',cy);dot.style.opacity=1;
    topY=Math.min(topY,cy);
    rows+=`<div class="trow"><i style="background:var(${sd.css})"></i><span>${sd.name}</span><b>${sd.fmt(CH.data[sd.id][i])}</b></div>`;
  });
  if(CH.data.anomaly===i)rows+=`<div class="tanom">⚡ Anomaly flagged — autoscaled +3 replicas</div>`;
  CH.tip.innerHTML=`<div class="tlab">${CH.data.labels[i]}</div>${rows}`;
  CH.tip.style.opacity=1;
  const tw=CH.tip.offsetWidth,th=CH.tip.offsetHeight;
  CH.tip.style.left=clamp(cx-tw/2,6,CH.W-tw-6)+'px';
  CH.tip.style.top=(topY-th-14<4?topY+18:topY-th-14)+'px';
});
CH.svg.addEventListener('pointerleave',hideTip);

let lastSync=Date.now();
document.querySelectorAll('.rbtn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(b.classList.contains('active'))return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.rbtn').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));
  b.classList.add('active');
  CH.range=b.dataset.range;CH.data=genData(CH.range);lastSync=Date.now();
  renderChart(true);
}));
setInterval(()=>{
  const s=Math.floor((Date.now()-lastSync)/1000);
  $('upd').textContent=s<5?'just now':s<60?s+'s ago':Math.floor(s/60)+'m ago';
},1000);
let rT;new ResizeObserver(()=>{clearTimeout(rT);rT=setTimeout(()=>renderChart(false),120)}).observe(CH.wrap);
renderChart(true);

/* ---------- typewriter insights ---------- */
const TW=[
  'Inference volume is up 12% week-over-week — capacity headroom looks healthy.',
  'The 09:42 spike correlates with the campaign push. No action needed.',

/* ---------- live feed ---------- */
const POOL=[
  ['ok','Deploy succeeded — <b>nova-70b v2.3.1</b> rolled to prod'],
  ['info','Fine-tune job <b>ft-3312</b> queued on cluster gpu-a100-2'],

let feedPaused=false,pi=0;
function addFeed(type,html,time,fresh){
  const li=document.createElement('li');
  if(fresh)li.className='in';
  li.innerHTML=`<i class="fdot" style="background:${FCOL[type]};box-shadow:0 0 8px ${FCOL[type]};width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:99px;margin-top:5px"></i>

}
[['ok',0,'just now'],['warn',2,'2m'],['ok',3,'7m'],['info',1,'14m'],['err',5,'26m']]

$('feed').addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>feedPaused=false);
setInterval(()=>{

},4200);

/* ---------- table filters ---------- */
document.querySelectorAll('.fchip').forEach(ch=>ch.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('.fchip').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('active'));
  ch.classList.add('active');
  const f=ch.dataset.f;
  document.querySelectorAll('#jobs tr').forEach(tr=>
    tr.classList.toggle('hide',f!=='all'&&tr.dataset.status!==f));
}));
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: dark-mode-dashboard
prompt: Design a sleek admin dashboard UI with light and dark mode toggle, featuring an AI analytics graph. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>AI Analytics Dashboard</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --bg-primary: #f8fafc;
            --bg-secondary: #ffffff;
            --bg-tertiary: #f1f5f9;
            --text-primary: #0f172a;
            --text-secondary: #64748b;
            --text-muted: #94a3b8;
            --accent-primary: #6366f1;
            --accent-secondary: #8b5cf6;
            --accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 100%);
            --border-color: #e2e8f0;
            --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
            --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            --success: #10b981;
            --warning: #f59e0b;
            --danger: #ef4444;
            --info: #3b82f6;
        }

        .dark-mode {
            --bg-primary: #0f172a;
            --bg-secondary: #1e293b;
            --bg-tertiary: #334155;
            --text-primary: #f8fafc;
            --text-secondary: #cbd5e1;
            --text-muted: #64748b;
            --border-color: #334155;
            --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        .dashboard-container {
            display: flex;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Sidebar */
        .sidebar {
            width: 260px;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 24px 0;
            position: fixed;
            height: 100vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .sidebar-header {
            padding: 0 24px 32px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .logo {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            background: var(--accent-gradient);
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: white;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .logo-text {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
            background: var(--accent-gradient);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .sidebar-section {
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .sidebar-section-title {
            padding: 0 24px 12px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .sidebar-nav {
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-item {
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .nav-link {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 10px 24px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            position: relative;
        }

        .nav-link:hover {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
        }

        .nav-link.active {
            color: var(--accent-primary);
            background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
        }

        .nav-link.active::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 3px;
            height: 24px;
            background: var(--accent-gradient);
            border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
        }

        .nav-icon {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        /* Main Content */
        .main-content {
            flex: 1;
            margin-left: 260px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* Header */
        .header {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 16px 32px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 50;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .header-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 24px;
        }

        .search-bar {
            position: relative;
            width: 320px;
        }

        .search-input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px 16px 10px 44px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 14px;
            outline: none;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }

        .search-input:focus {
            border-color: var(--accent-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
        }

        .search-icon {
            position: absolute;
            left: 14px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .header-right {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .header-action {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: none;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            position: relative;
        }

        .header-action:hover {
            background: var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .notification-badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: 6px;
            right: 6px;
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--danger);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        /* Theme Toggle */
        .theme-toggle {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: none;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .theme-toggle:hover {
            background: var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .theme-toggle svg {
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .theme-toggle .sun-icon {
            display: none;
        }

        .dark-mode .theme-toggle .sun-icon {
            display: block;
        }

        .dark-mode .theme-toggle .moon-icon {
            display: none;
        }

        .user-profile {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            padding-left: 16px;
            border-left: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .user-avatar {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent-gradient);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: white;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .user-info {
            text-align: left;
        }

        .user-name {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .user-role {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* Dashboard Content */
        .dashboard-content {
            padding: 32px;
        }

        .page-header {
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .page-title {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .page-subtitle {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* Stats Grid */
        .stats-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 24px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .stat-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
        }

        .stat-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-gradient);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .stat-card:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .stat-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .stat-icon {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 20px;
        }

        .stat-icon.purple {
            background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-primary);
        }

        .stat-icon.green {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
            color: var(--success);
        }

        .stat-icon.orange {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1);
            color: var(--warning);
        }

        .stat-icon.blue {
            background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1);
            color: var(--info);
        }

        .stat-trend {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 4px 8px;
            border-radius: 20px;
        }

        .stat-trend.up {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
            color: var(--success);
        }

        .stat-trend.down {
            background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
            color: var(--danger);
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* Charts Section */
        .charts-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr;
            gap: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .chart-card {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 24px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .chart-card:hover {
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        }

        .chart-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .chart-title {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .chart-subtitle {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .chart-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .chart-btn {
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }

        .chart-btn:hover {
            background: var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .chart-btn.active {
            background: var(--accent-primary);
            color: white;
        }

        .chart-container {
            position: relative;
            height: 320px;
        }

        /* AI Insights */
        .ai-insights {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 24px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .ai-insights-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .ai-badge {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 6px 12px;
            background: var(--accent-gradient);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .ai-badge svg {
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
        }

        .insights-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .insight-card {
            padding: 20px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            border-radius: 12px;
            border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-primary);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .insight-card:hover {
            transform: translateX(4px);
        }

        .insight-card.warning {
            border-left-color: var(--warning);
        }

        .insight-card.success {
            border-left-color: var(--success);
        }

        .insight-title {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .insight-desc {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .insight-confidence {
            margin-top: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .confidence-bar {
            flex: 1;
            height: 4px;
            background: var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .confidence-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--accent-gradient);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .confidence-text {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* Bottom Section */
        .bottom-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr;
            gap: 24px;
        }

        .section-card {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 24px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .section-card:hover {
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        }

        .section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .view-all {
            color: var(--accent-primary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }

        .view-all:hover {
            color: var(--accent-secondary);
        }

        /* Activity List */
        .activity-list {
            list-style: none;
        }

        .activity-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 16px;
            padding: 16px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .activity-item:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
            padding-bottom: 0;
        }

        .activity-avatar {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .activity-avatar.purple {
            background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-primary);
        }

        .activity-avatar.green {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
            color: var(--success);
        }

        .activity-avatar.orange {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1);
            color: var(--warning);
        }

        .activity-avatar.blue {
            background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1);
            color: var(--info);
        }

        .activity-content {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .activity-text {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .activity-text strong {
            color: var(--accent-primary);
        }

        .activity-time {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* Top Models */
        .model-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            padding: 14px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .model-item:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
            padding-bottom: 0;
        }

        .model-rank {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .model-rank.gold {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fbbf24, #f59e0b);
            color: white;
        }

        .model-rank.silver {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #cbd5e1, #94a3b8);
            color: white;
        }

        .model-rank.bronze {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d97706, #b45309);
            color: white;
        }

        .model-info {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .model-name {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .model-category {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .model-usage {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .model-count {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .model-label {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 1200px) {
            .stats-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            
            .charts-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            
            .insights-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            
            .bottom-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .sidebar {
                transform: translateX(-100%);
            }
            
            .sidebar.open {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            
            .main-content {
                margin-left: 0;
            }
            
            .search-bar {
                display: none;
            }
            
            .stats-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            
            .dashboard-content {
                padding: 20px;
            }
            
            .header {
                padding: 16px 20px;
            }
        }

        /* Animations */
        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .stat-card,
        .chart-card,
        .ai-insights,
        .section-card {
            animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease forwards;
        }

        .stat-card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
        .stat-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
        .stat-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
        .stat-card:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

        /* Pulse animation for AI badge */
        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 0.7;
            }
        }

        .ai-badge {
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        /* Mobile menu button */
        .mobile-menu-btn {
            display: none;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: none;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            cursor: pointer;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .mobile-menu-btn {
                display: flex;
            }
        }

        /* Overlay */
        .sidebar-overlay {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            z-index: 99;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .sidebar-overlay.active {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .sidebar-overlay.active {
                display: block;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="dashboard-container">
        <!-- Sidebar Overlay -->
        <div class="sidebar-overlay" id="sidebarOverlay" onclick="toggleSidebar()"></div>
        
        <!-- Sidebar -->
        <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">

        // Load saved theme

        // Sidebar Toggle (Mobile)

        // Chart.js Global Defaults
        Chart.defaults.font.family = "'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif";
        Chart.defaults.font.size = 12;

        function getChartColors() {
            const isDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark-mode');
            return {
                text: isDark ? '#cbd5e1' : '#64748b',
                grid: isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0',
                tooltipBg: isDark ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff',
                tooltipText: isDark ? '#f8fafc' : '#0f172a',
                tooltipBorder: isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0'
            };
        }

        // Analytics Chart
        let analyticsChart;
        function createAnalyticsChart() {
            const ctx = document.getElementById('analyticsChart').getContext('2d');
            const colors = getChartColors();
            
            const gradient1 = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 320);
            gradient1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3)');

            gradient2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)');
            gradient2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0)');

            analyticsChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'],
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: 'Accuracy (%)',

                            pointHoverBackgroundColor: '#10b981',
                            pointHoverBorderColor: '#fff',
                            pointHoverBorderWidth: 2,
                            yAxisID: 'y1'
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    interaction: {
                        mode: 'index',
                        intersect: false
                    },
                    plugins: {
                        legend: {
                            position: 'top',
                            align: 'end',
                            labels: {
                                color: colors.text,
                                usePointStyle: true,
                                pointStyle: 'circle',
                                padding: 20,
                                font: {
                                    size: 12,
                                    weight: 500
                                }

                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: colors.tooltipBg,
                            titleColor: colors.tooltipText,
                            bodyColor: colors.tooltipText,
                            borderColor: colors.tooltipBorder,
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            padding: 12,
                            cornerRadius: 8,
                            titleFont: {
                                size: 13,
                                weight: 600
                            },
                            bodyFont: {
                                size: 12
