                            displayColors: true,
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    let label = context.dataset.label || '';
                                    if (label) {
                                        label += ': ';
                                    }
                                    if (context.datasetIndex === 0) {
                                        label += context.parsed.y + '%';
                                    } else {
                                        label += context.parsed.y + 'ms';
                                    }
                                    return label;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: {
                                display: false
                            },
                            ticks: {
                                color: colors.text,
                                font: {
                                    size: 12
                                }
                            }
                        },
                        y: {
                            type: 'linear',
                            display: true,
                            position: 'left',
                            min: 85,
                            max: 100,
                            grid: {
                                color: colors.grid,
                                drawBorder: false
                            },
                            ticks: {
                                color: colors.text,
                                callback: function(value) {
                                    return value + '%';
                                }
                            }
                        },
                        y1: {
                            type: 'linear',
                            display: true,
                            position: 'right',
                            min: 100,
                            max: 200,
                            grid: {
                                drawOnChartArea: false
                            },
                            ticks: {
                                color: colors.text,
                                callback: function(value) {
                                    return value + 'ms';
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // Usage Doughnut Chart
        let usageChart;
        function createUsageChart() {
            const ctx = document.getElementById('usageChart').getContext('2d');
            const colors = getChartColors();

            usageChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: ['Text Generation', 'Image Generation', 'Embeddings', 'Speech', 'Other'],
                    datasets: [{
                        data: [35, 22, 18, 15, 10],
                        backgroundColor: [
                            '#6366f1',
                            '#8b5cf6',
                            '#10b981',
                            '#f59e0b',
                            '#3b82f6'
                        ],
                        borderWidth: 0,
                        spacing: 2,
                        hoverOffset: 8
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    cutout: '70%',
                    plugins: {
                        legend: {
                            position: 'bottom',
                            labels: {
                                color: colors.text,
                                usePointStyle: true,
                                pointStyle: 'circle',
                                padding: 16,
                                font: {
                                    size: 11,
                                    weight: 500
                                }
                            }
                        },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: colors.tooltipBg,
                            titleColor: colors.tooltipText,
                            bodyColor: colors.tooltipText,
                            borderColor: colors.tooltipBorder,
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            padding: 12,
                            cornerRadius: 8,
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    return context.label + ': ' + context.parsed + '%';
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function updateChartColors() {
            const colors = getChartColors();
            
            if (analyticsChart) {
                analyticsChart.options.plugins.legend.labels.color = colors.text;
                analyticsChart.options.plugins.tooltip.backgroundColor = colors.tooltipBg;
                analyticsChart.options.plugins.tooltip.titleColor = colors.tooltipText;
                analyticsChart.options.plugins.tooltip.bodyColor = colors.tooltipText;
                analyticsChart.options.plugins.tooltip.borderColor = colors.tooltipBorder;
                analyticsChart.options.scales.x.ticks.color = colors.text;
                analyticsChart.options.scales.y.ticks.color = colors.text;
                analyticsChart.options.scales.y.grid.color = colors.grid;
                analyticsChart.options.scales.y1.ticks.color = colors.text;
                analyticsChart.update('none');
            }
            
            if (usageChart) {
                usageChart.options.plugins.legend.labels.color = colors.text;
                usageChart.options.plugins.tooltip.backgroundColor = colors.tooltipBg;
                usageChart.options.plugins.tooltip.titleColor = colors.tooltipText;
                usageChart.options.plugins.tooltip.bodyColor = colors.tooltipText;
                usageChart.options.plugins.tooltip.borderColor = colors.tooltipBorder;
                usageChart.update('none');
            }
        }

        function updateChart(period) {
            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.chart-btn');
            buttons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            event.target.classList.add('active');

            const data = {
                day: {
                    labels: ['00:00', '04:00', '08:00', '12:00', '16:00', '20:00', '23:59'],
                    accuracy: [95.2, 94.8, 96.1, 95.5, 94.9, 95.8, 96.2],
                    latency: [120, 115, 135, 142, 138, 125, 118]
                },
                week: {
                    labels: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'],
                    accuracy: [92.5, 93.2, 94.1, 93.8, 95.2, 94.9, 96.1],
                    latency: [145, 132, 128, 138, 125, 130, 127]
                },
                month: {
                    labels: ['Week 1', 'Week 2', 'Week 3', 'Week 4', 'Week 5', 'Week 6', 'Week 7'],
                    accuracy: [89.2, 90.5, 91.8, 92.4, 93.7, 94.2, 95.1],
                    latency: [165, 158, 148, 142, 135, 130, 125]
                }
            };

            if (analyticsChart) {
                analyticsChart.data.labels = data[period].labels;
                analyticsChart.data.datasets[0].data = data[period].accuracy;
                analyticsChart.data.datasets[1].data = data[period].latency;
                analyticsChart.update();
            }
        }

        // Initialize charts
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            createAnalyticsChart();
            createUsageChart();
        });

        // Add hover effect to nav items
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(l => l.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

.page-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.page-title{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:clamp(24px,2.4vw,32px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.page-sub{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:6px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-2);flex-wrap:wrap}
.page-sub .mono{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.live-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:600 10px 'IBM Plex Mono';letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--green)}
.live-pill i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--green);animation:blink 1.8s infinite}
.dot-sep{color:var(--ink-3)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:600 13px 'IBM Plex Sans';padding:9px 16px;
  border-radius:10px;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;
  transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .2s,filter .2s,border-color .2s,background-color .3s,color .2s;}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}
.btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px -8px var(--accent)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;border-color:var(--border);color:var(--ink-2)}
.btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-1px)}
/* ---- cards ---- */
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-1);
  transition:background-color .35s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s,transform .25s;
  animation:rise .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) both;}
.lift:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--border-strong);box-shadow:var(--shadow-2)}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.card-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:18px 20px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.card-title{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.card-title .muted{color:var(--ink-3);font-weight:500}
.card-sub{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-3);margin-top:3px}
/* ---- KPIs ---- */
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.kpi{padding:18px 20px 16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.kpi-label{font:500 10.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink-3)}
.kpi-value{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:29px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-top:9px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.kpi-lg .kpi-value{font-size:38px}
.kpi-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-top:8px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.delta{font:600 11.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';padding:2.5px 8px;border-radius:6px}
.delta.up{color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft)}
.delta.down{color:var(--red);background:var(--red-soft)}
.spark{position:absolute;right:14px;bottom:14px;width:112px;height:46px}
.chip-live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:600 9.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';letter-spacing:.12em;
  color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft);padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px}
.chip-live::before{content:'';width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);animation:blink 1.6s infinite}
.chip-live.busy{color:var(--amber);background:var(--amber-soft)}
.chip-live.busy::before{background:var(--amber);animation-duration:.6s}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.25}}
.meter{display:inline-flex;gap:3px}
.meter i{width:14px;height:5px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--border)}
.meter i.on{background:var(--accent)}
/* ---- main grid ---- */
.main-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.9fr 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:stretch}
.chips{display:flex;gap:6px}
.chip{font:500 11.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';padding:5px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:transparent;color:var(--ink-2);cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:all .2s}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.chip.active{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}
.mini-badge{font:600 9.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft);
  padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--accent-soft)}
.legend{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:10px 20px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.legend-item{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:500 12px 'IBM Plex Sans';color:var(--ink-2);
  background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:7px;transition:all .2s}
.legend-item:hover{color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface-2)}
.legend-item:not(.on){opacity:.38}
.legend-item:not(.on) .lbl{text-decoration:line-through}
.swatch{width:16px;border-top:2.5px solid var(--accent);display:inline-block}
.swatch.dash{border-top-style:dashed}
.swatch.band{border:0;height:10px;width:16px;background:var(--accent-soft);border-radius:3px}
.swatch.adot{width:8px;height:8px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red)}
.chart-wrap{position:relative;height:340px}
#chart{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;cursor:crosshair}
.pulse-dot{position:absolute;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;z-index:3;transition:opacity .3s}
.pulse-dot::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-7px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--accent);
  animation:ping 1.9s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes ping{0%{transform:scale(.35);opacity:.75}100%{transform:scale(1.7);opacity:0}}
.tooltip{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:10;min-width:158px;background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-2);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s,background-color .35s,border-color .3s;}
.tt-date{font:600 10.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ink-3);margin-bottom:7px;text-transform:uppercase}
.tt-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-2);padding:1.5px 0}
.tt-row b{margin-left:auto;font:600 12px 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--ink)}
.tt-row .sw{width:10px}
.chart-foot{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;padding:14px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.cf-item b{font:600 15px 'Space Grotesk';display:block;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cf-item span{font:500 9.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink-3)}
/* ---- AI panel ---- */
.ai-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ai-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;z-index:2;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--accent),transparent);background-size:200% 100%;
  animation:scan 3.4s linear infinite;opacity:.85}
@keyframes scan{0%{background-position:200% 0}100%{background-position:-200% 0}}
.ai-id{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.ai-orb{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--accent-soft);border:1px solid var(--accent-soft);
  display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--accent);position:relative}
.ai-orb::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-1px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--accent);
  opacity:0;animation:ring 2.6s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes ring{0%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.5}70%,100%{transform:scale(1.35);opacity:0}}
.ai-body{flex:1;padding:16px 20px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.ai-text{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.68;color:var(--ink);min-height:128px}
.cursor{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--accent);margin-left:2px;vertical-align:-2px;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite}
.ai-meta{margin-top:auto;padding-top:14px}
.conf{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.conf-label{font:500 10px 'IBM Plex Mono';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink-3);white-space:nowrap}
.conf-bar{flex:1;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden}
.conf-bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));transition:width 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)}
.conf-val{font:600 12px 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--accent);min-width:38px;text-align:right}
.ai-tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.tag{font:500 10.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';padding:3.5px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--border);
  color:var(--ink-2);background:var(--surface-2);animation:rise .4s both}
.ai-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px 18px}
.tiny{font:400 10.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--ink-3)}
.spin{width:13px;height:13px;border:2px solid var(--on-accent);border-top-color:transparent;border-radius:50%;animation:rot .7s linear infinite;display:none}
.busy .spin{display:block}
@keyframes rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
/* ---- bottom grid ---- */
.bottom-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.link{font:600 11.5px 'IBM Plex Sans';color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;transition:letter-spacing .2s}
.link:hover{letter-spacing:.03em}
.ano-list{padding:6px 0 8px}
.ano{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:12px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  transition:background .2s,padding-left .2s;animation:rise .5s both;}
.ano:hover{background:var(--surface-2);padding-left:24px}
.ano-sev{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
.sev-high{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--red-soft)}
.sev-med{background:var(--amber);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--amber-soft)}
.sev-low{background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--green-soft)}
.ano-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.ano-title{font-weight:600;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ano-meta{font:400 10.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--ink-3);margin-top:2px}
.ano-delta{font:600 12px 'IBM Plex Mono';white-space:nowrap}
.ad-up{color:var(--red)}.ad-ok{color:var(--green)}.ad-dn{color:var(--amber)}
.hrow{padding:13px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.hrow:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.hrow-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-2);margin-bottom:8px}
.hrow-val{font:600 12.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hbar{height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--surface-2);overflow:hidden}
.hbar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:3px;background:var(--accent);width:0;transition:width .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1),background-color .4s}
.src-row{padding:11px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.src-row:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.src-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:7px}
.src-top b{font:600 12px 'IBM Plex Mono'}
.src-bar{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--surface-2);overflow:hidden}
.src-fill{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:3px;width:0;transition:width 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)}
.src-row:hover .src-fill{filter:brightness(1.15)}
/* ---- toast ---- */
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:13px 18px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-2);
  font-size:13px;font-weight:500;transform:translateY(18px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1.25),opacity .3s;}
.toast.show{transform:none;opacity:1}
.toast .tdot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent)}
/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
@media (max-width:1240px){
  .kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .main-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .bottom-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .ai-text{min-height:110px}
}
@media (max-width:1120px){
  .side{width:76px;padding:20px 10px}
  .logo{justify-content:center}
  .logo-text,.nav-label,.nav-item .txt,.nav-badge,.cluster{display:none}
  .nav-item{justify-content:center;padding:11px}
  .nav-item.active::before{left:-10px}
}
@media (max-width:820px){
  .crumb,.search kbd,.clock{display:none}
  .topbar{padding:10px 16px}
  .content{padding:16px 16px 36px}
  .bottom-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .chart-foot{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
  .chart-wrap{height:280px}
}
@media (max-width:640px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr}.side{display:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
}

            <div class="src-row"><div class="src-top"><span>Direct</span><b>8%</b></div><div class="src-bar"><i class="src-fill" data-w="8" style="background:var(--ink-3)"></i></div></div>

<script>
/* ================= HELPERS ================= */
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const RM=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const root=document.documentElement;
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const cssv=n=>getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue(n).trim();
function hexA(hex,a){const h=hex.replace('#','');const f=h.length===3?h.split('').map(c=>c+c).join(''):h;
  const r=parseInt(f.slice(0,2),16),g=parseInt(f.slice(2,4),16),b=parseInt(f.slice(4,6),16);
  return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${a})`;}
const fmtK=v=>v>=1000?(v/1000).toFixed(1)+'k':Math.round(v);
const fmt=v=>Math.round(v).toLocaleString('en-US');
const fmtDate=d=>d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'});
let toastT;function toast(m){const t=$('#toast');$('#toastMsg').textContent=m;t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastT);toastT=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2800);}

/* ================= THEME ================= */
const themeBtn=$('#themeBtn');
function syncThemeBtn(){themeBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',root.getAttribute('data-theme')==='dark');}
themeBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const t=root.getAttribute('data-theme')==='dark'?'light':'dark';
  root.setAttribute('data-theme',t);
  try{localStorage.setItem('neura-theme',t);}catch(e){}
  syncThemeBtn();drawChart();drawSparks();
});
syncThemeBtn();

/* ================= CLOCK + "updated ago" ================= */
let lastUpdate=Date.now();
setInterval(()=>{
  $('#clock').textContent=new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour12:false});
  const s=Math.floor((Date.now()-lastUpdate)/1000);
  $('#updAgo').textContent=s<3?'just now':s+'s ago';
},1000);

/* ================= TITLE SCRAMBLE ================= */
function scramble(el,txt,dur=950){
  if(RM){el.textContent=txt;return;}
  const chars='▓▒░/<>#0123456789';const t0=performance.now();
  (function f(t){const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/dur);const n=Math.floor(p*txt.length);
    let out=txt.slice(0,n);
    for(let i=n;i<txt.length;i++)out+=txt[i]===' '?' ':chars[(Math.random()*chars.length)|0];
    el.textContent=out;if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f);})(t0);
}
scramble($('#pageTitle'),'Analytics Overview');

/* ================= COUNT-UP KPIs ================= */
function countUp(el,target,f,dur=1000){
  if(RM){el.textContent=f(target);return;}
  const t0=performance.now();
  (function g(t){const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/dur);const e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);
    el.textContent=f(target*e);if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(g);})(t0);
}
countUp($('#kpiRevenue'),1.284,v=>'$'+v.toFixed(2)+'M');
countUp($('#kpiSessions'),48213,v=>fmt(v));
countUp($('#kpiScore'),0.34,v=>v.toFixed(2));
countUp($('#kpiAcc'),97.3,v=>v.toFixed(1)+'%');

/* ================= DATA GENERATION ================= */
function genData(days){
  const n=days, split=Math.floor(n*0.72), now=new Date();
  const labels=[],obs=Array(n).fill(null),fc=Array(n).fill(null),
        up=Array(n).fill(null),lo=Array(n).fill(null),anoms=[];
  const base=4200+Math.random()*500, phase=Math.random()*6.28;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const d=new Date(now);d.setDate(d.getDate()-(n-1-i));labels.push(d);
    const t=i/(n-1);
    const wave=Math.sin(i*0.42+phase)*170+Math.sin(i*0.13+phase*2)*360;
    const trend=base+t*days*9;
    if(i<=split)obs[i]=Math.max(800,trend+wave+(Math.random()-0.5)*260);
  }
  const cnt=2+(Math.random()<0.5?1:0);
  for(let k=0;k<cnt;k++){
    const idx=2+Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.max(1,split-6));
    obs[idx]+= (Math.random()<0.5?-1:1)*(500+Math.random()*520);
    if(!anoms.includes(idx))anoms.push(idx);
  }
  let last=0,c=0;for(let i=split-3;i<=split;i++){if(i>=0&&obs[i]!=null){last+=obs[i];c++;}}
  last/=Math.max(1,c);
  const slope=split>5?(obs[split]-obs[split-5])/5:0;
  for(let i=split;i<n;i++){
    const h=i-split;
    fc[i]=Math.max(600,last+slope*h+Math.sin(h*0.8+phase)*40);
    const w=60+h*(42+days*0.35);
    up[i]=fc[i]+w;lo[i]=Math.max(300,fc[i]-w);
  }
  fc[split]=obs[split]??last;
  return{labels,obs,fc,up,lo,anoms,split,mape:+(2.2+Math.random()*1.8).toFixed(1)};
}

/* ================= CHART ================= */
const cv=$('#chart'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d'),wrap=$('#chartWrap'),tt=$('#tt'),pulse=$('#pulseDot');
const state={days:30,series:{obs:true,fc:true,band:true},data:null,progress:1,hover:-1};
const PAD={l:56,r:14,t:18,b:30};
let W=0,H=0,dpr=1,SX=null,SY=null;
function sizeCanvas(){
  dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect();W=r.width;H=r.height;
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
}
function ptsOf(arr,from,to){
  const p=[];for(let i=from;i<=to;i++)if(arr[i]!=null)p.push({x:SX(i),y:SY(arr[i])});return p;
}
function smooth(c,pts){
  c.moveTo(pts[0].x,pts[0].y);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++){const xc=(pts[i].x+pts[i+1].x)/2,yc=(pts[i].y+pts[i+1].y)/2;
    c.quadraticCurveTo(pts[i].x,pts[i].y,xc,yc);}
  c.lineTo(pts[pts.length-1].x,pts[pts.length-1].y);
}
function drawChart(){
  const d=state.data;if(!d)return;
  const acc=cssv('--accent'),red=cssv('--red'),amber=cssv('--amber'),
        gridC=cssv('--chart-grid'),ink3=cssv('--ink-3'),bs=cssv('--border-strong'),surf=cssv('--surface');
  const iw=W-PAD.l-PAD.r, ih=H-PAD.t-PAD.b, n=d.labels.length;
  let vals=[];
  if(state.series.obs)vals.push(...d.obs.filter(v=>v!=null));
  if(state.series.fc)vals.push(...d.fc.filter(v=>v!=null));
  if(state.series.band)vals.push(...d.up.filter(v=>v!=null),...d.lo.filter(v=>v!=null));
  if(!vals.length)vals=d.obs.concat(d.fc).filter(v=>v!=null);
  let mn=Math.min(...vals),mx=Math.max(...vals);
  const pv=(mx-mn)*0.12||1;mn-=pv;mx+=pv;
  const X=i=>PAD.l+(i/(n-1))*iw, Y=v=>PAD.t+(1-(v-mn)/(mx-mn))*ih;
  SX=X;SY=Y;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  /* grid + y labels */
  ctx.font='11px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace';ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  for(let s=0;s<=4;s++){
    const v=mn+(mx-mn)*s/4,y=Y(v);
    ctx.strokeStyle=gridC;ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(PAD.l,y);ctx.lineTo(W-PAD.r,y);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle=ink3;ctx.fillText(fmtK(v),PAD.l-10,y);
  }
  /* x labels */
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='top';
  const tickN=n<=10?5:(n<=40?6:7);
  for(let s=0;s<tickN;s++){
    const i=Math.round(s*(n-1)/(tickN-1));
    ctx.fillStyle=ink3;ctx.fillText(fmtDate(d.labels[i]),X(i),H-PAD.b+9);
  }
  /* forecast zone tint */
  ctx.fillStyle=hexA(acc,.035);
  ctx.fillRect(X(d.split),PAD.t,W-PAD.r-X(d.split),ih);
  /* progress clip */
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(PAD.l-3,0,(iw+6)*state.progress,H);ctx.clip();
  /* confidence band */
  if(state.series.band){
    ctx.beginPath();let st=false;
    for(let i=d.split;i<n;i++){if(d.up[i]==null)continue;
      st?ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(d.up[i])):(ctx.moveTo(X(i),Y(d.up[i])),st=true);}
    for(let i=n-1;i>=d.split;i--){if(d.lo[i]==null)continue;ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(d.lo[i]));}
    ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=hexA(acc,.13);ctx.fill();
  }
  /* observed area + line */
  if(state.series.obs){
    const pts=ptsOf(d.obs,0,d.split);
    if(pts.length>1){
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,PAD.t,0,H-PAD.b);
      g.addColorStop(0,hexA(acc,.22));g.addColorStop(1,hexA(acc,0));
      ctx.beginPath();smooth(ctx,pts);
      ctx.lineTo(pts[pts.length-1].x,H-PAD.b);ctx.lineTo(pts[0].x,H-PAD.b);ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();smooth(ctx,pts);
      ctx.strokeStyle=acc;ctx.lineWidth=2.4;ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  /* forecast dashed */
  if(state.series.fc){
    const pts=ptsOf(d.fc,d.split,n-1);
    if(pts.length>1){
      ctx.save();ctx.setLineDash([6,6]);
      ctx.beginPath();smooth(ctx,pts);
      ctx.strokeStyle=acc;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
    }
  }
  /* now line */
  const nx=X(d.split);
  ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=hexA(acc,.55);ctx.setLineDash([3,4]);ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(nx,PAD.t);ctx.lineTo(nx,H-PAD.b);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle=acc;ctx.font='600 10px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace';ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('NOW',nx+7,PAD.t-12<0?2:PAD.t-12);
  /* anomalies */
  d.anoms.forEach(i=>{
    if(d.obs[i]==null)return;
    const x=X(i),y=Y(d.obs[i]);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,4,0,7);ctx.fillStyle=red;ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,7.5,0,7);ctx.strokeStyle=hexA(red,.45);ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();
  });
  /* hover crosshair */
  if(state.hover>=0){
    const i=state.hover,x=X(i);
    ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=bs;ctx.setLineDash([4,4]);ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,PAD.t);ctx.lineTo(x,H-PAD.b);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
    const dot=(v,col,fill)=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,Y(v),4.5,0,7);
      ctx.fillStyle=fill||surf;ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=2.4;ctx.stroke();};
    if(state.series.obs&&d.obs[i]!=null)dot(d.obs[i],acc);
    if(state.series.fc&&d.fc[i]!=null)dot(d.fc[i],amber);
  }
  ctx.restore();
  placePulse();
}
function placePulse(){
  const d=state.data;
  if(!SX||!SY||!state.series.obs||!d||d.obs[d.split]==null){pulse.style.opacity=0;return;}
  pulse.style.opacity=1;
  pulse.style.left=SX(d.split)+'px';pulse.style.top=SY(d.obs[d.split])+'px';
}
function animateChart(){
  if(RM){state.progress=1;drawChart();return;}
  const t0=performance.now(),dur=900;state.progress=0;
  (function f(t){const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/dur);
    state.progress=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);drawChart();
    if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f);})(t0);
}
/* hover */
function hideHover(){state.hover=-1;tt.style.opacity=0;drawChart();}
cv.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  const d=state.data;if(!d)return;
  const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),x=e.clientX-r.left,n=d.labels.length;
  const iw=r.width-PAD.l-PAD.r;
  if(x<PAD.l-8||x>r.width-PAD.r+8){hideHover();return;}
  const i=clamp(Math.round((x-PAD.l)/iw*(n-1)),0,n-1);
  state.hover=i;drawChart();
  let html=`<div class="tt-date">${fmtDate(d.labels[i])}${i>=d.split?' · forecast':''}</div>`;
  if(state.series.obs&&d.obs[i]!=null)html+=`<div class="tt-row"><i class="swatch sw"></i>Observed<b>${fmt(d.obs[i])}</b></div>`;
  if(state.series.fc&&d.fc[i]!=null)html+=`<div class="tt-row"><i class="swatch dash sw"></i>Forecast<b>${fmt(d.fc[i])}</b></div>`;
  if(d.obs[i]!=null&&d.fc[i]!=null){
    const dl=(d.obs[i]-d.fc[i])/d.fc[i]*100;
    html+=`<div class="tt-row" style="color:var(--ink-3)">Δ vs model<b style="color:${dl>=0?'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}">${dl>=0?'+':''}${dl.toFixed(1)}%</b></div>`;
  }
  tt.innerHTML=html;tt.style.opacity=1;
  const tx=SX(i);
  tt.style.left=(tx>r.width-190?tx-180:tx+14)+'px';
  tt.style.top=clamp(e.clientY-r.top-70,8,r.height-96)+'px';
});
cv.addEventListener('mouseleave',hideHover);

/* range + legend */
function updateSums(){
  const d=state.data;
  const o=d.obs.filter(v=>v!=null),f=d.fc.filter(v=>v!=null);
  $('#sumAvg').textContent=fmt(o.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/o.length);
  $('#sumPeak').textContent=fmt(Math.max(...o));
  $('#sumFcast').textContent=fmt(f.slice(-7).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/Math.min(7,f.length));
  $('#sumMAPE').textContent=d.mape+'%';
  $('#dateRange').textContent=
    `${fmtDate(d.labels[0])} – ${fmtDate(d.labels[n-1])} · ${state.days}d window`;
}
const n=()=>state.data.labels.length;
$$('#rangeChips .chip').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  $$('#rangeChips .chip').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));
  b.classList.add('active');
  state.days=+b.dataset.days;
  state.data=genData(state.days);
  updateSums();lastUpdate=Date.now();
  animateChart();
}));
$$('.legend-item[data-s]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const s=b.dataset.s;state.series[s]=!state.series[s];
  b.classList.toggle('on',state.series[s]);
  drawChart();
}));

/* ================= SPARKLINE ================= */
function drawSpark(el,data,color){
  const c=el.getContext('2d');
  const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
  el.width=r.width*dpr;el.height=r.height*dpr;c.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  const w=r.width,h=r.height,mn=Math.min(...data),mx=Math.max(...data);
  const pts=data.map((v,i)=>({x:2+i/(data.length-1)*(w-4),y:h-4-((v-mn)/((mx-mn)||1))*(h-10)}));
  c.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(p.x,p.y):c.moveTo(p.x,p.y));
  c.strokeStyle=color;c.lineWidth=1.6;c.lineJoin='round';c.stroke();
  c.lineTo(pts[pts.length-1].x,h);c.lineTo(pts[0].x,h);c.closePath();
  const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);
  g.addColorStop(0,hexA(color,.28));g.addColorStop(1,hexA(color,0));
  c.fillStyle=g;c.fill();
}
function drawSparks(){
  drawSpark($('#sparkRev'),sparkData,cssv('--accent'));
}
let sparkData=(()=>{let v=60,a=[];for(let i=0;i<26;i++){v+= (Math.random()-0.42)*14;a.push(v);}return a;})();

/* ================= MODEL HEALTH ================= */
const health={gpu:71,lat:182,tps:4120,q:12};
function renderHealth(){
  const set=(id,v)=>$(id).textContent=v;
  const bar=(id,pct,col)=>{const e=$(id);e.style.width=clamp(pct*100,2,100)+'%';e.style.background=col;};
  set('#hGpuV',Math.round(health.gpu)+'%');
  bar('#bGpu',health.gpu/100,health.gpu>92?'var(--red)':'var(--accent)');
  set('#hLatV',Math.round(health.lat)+' ms');
  bar('#bLat',health.lat/400,health.lat>260?'var(--amber)':'var(--accent)');
  set('#hTpsV',(health.tps/1000).toFixed(1)+'k tok/s');
  bar('#bTps',health.tps/6000,'var(--accent)');
  set('#hQV',health.q);
  bar('#bQ',health.q/50,health.q>30?'var(--amber)':'var(--ink-3)');
}
setInterval(()=>{
  health.gpu=clamp(health.gpu+(Math.random()-0.5)*6,45,96);
  health.lat=clamp(health.lat+(Math.random()-0.5)*24,120,330);
  health.tps=clamp(health.tps+(Math.random()-0.5)*320,2800,5600);
  health.q=Math.max(0,Math.round(health.q+(Math.random()-0.5)*5));
  renderHealth();
},2600);

/* ================= AI INSIGHTS ================= */
const insights=[
 {conf:91,tags:['trend','attribution','action'],
  text:"Throughput is running 12.6% above the seasonal baseline. Attribution weights the v3 router rollout at 68% of the uplift; the remainder tracks the weekly traffic cycle. Recommend pre-scaling the west-coast shard before Friday's forecast peak."},
 {conf:84,tags:['drift','model-health'],
  text:"Churn model (eu-west-2) shows feature drift: KS statistic 0.14 on 'session_depth', accuracy decaying 2.1 pts/week. A 14-day retrain should recover ~1.8 pts — scheduling it for tonight's low-traffic window."},
 {conf:96,tags:['anomaly','contained'],
  text:"The 09:42 UTC anomaly cluster correlates with deploy #4821 (checkout-service). Blast radius contained to us-east-1; auto-rollback threshold not reached. No customer impact detected — monitoring for 24h."},
 {conf:88,tags:['forecast','revenue'],
  text:"30-day revenue forecast revised upward to $1.41M (+10.2%). Primary driver: AI-assist conversion at 4.7%, 1.3 pts above target. Confidence narrows after day 21 — treat week-4 values as directional."}
];
let insIdx=0,typingT,aiHover=false;
const aiCard=$('#aiCard');
aiCard.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>aiHover=true);
aiCard.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>aiHover=false);
function showInsight(i,animate=true){
  const ins=insights[i];
  clearTimeout(typingT);
  const status=$('#aiStatus');status.textContent='ANALYZING';status.classList.add('busy');
  const finish=()=>{
    status.textContent='READY';status.classList.remove('busy');
    const typed=$('#aiTyped');
    if(!animate||RM){typed.textContent=ins.text;}
    else{
      typed.textContent='';let p=0;
      const step=()=>{p+=1+((Math.random()*2)|0);typed.textContent=ins.text.slice(0,p);
        if(p<ins.text.length)typingT=setTimeout(step,13+Math.random()*24);};
      step();
    }
    $('#confFill').style.width=ins.conf+'%';
    $('#confVal').textContent=ins.conf+'%';
    $('#aiTags').innerHTML=ins.tags.map((t,k)=>`<span class="tag" style="animation-delay:${k*70}ms">${t}</span>`).join('');
    $('#aiTime').textContent='last run '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour12:false});
  };
  if(animate&&!RM)setTimeout(finish,750);else finish();
}
$('#regen').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  insIdx=(insIdx+1)%insights.length;
  const b=$('#regen');b.classList.add('busy');$('#regenLbl').textContent='Analyzing…';
  setTimeout(()=>{b.classList.remove('busy');$('#regenLbl').textContent='↻ Regenerate';},900);
  showInsight(insIdx);
});
setInterval(()=>{if(!aiHover&&!document.hidden)showInsight((insIdx=(insIdx+1)%insights.length));},26000);

/* ================= BELL / EXPORT / KEYS ================= */
const bellBtn=$('#bellBtn'),drop=$('#bellDrop');
bellBtn.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  e.stopPropagation();
  drop.classList.toggle('open');
  if(drop.classList.contains('open'))
    setTimeout(()=>$('#bellBadge').classList.add('gone'),900);
});
drop.addEventListener('click',e=>e.stopPropagation());
document.addEventListener('click',()=>drop.classList.remove('open'));
$('#exportBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>toast('Report queued — delivery to Reports in ~2 min'));
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='k'){e.preventDefault();$('#searchInput').focus();}
});

/* ================= LIVE TICK ================= */
let sessions=48213;
setInterval(()=>{
  const d=state.data;if(!d)return;
  const i=d.split;
  d.obs[i]=Math.max(500,d.obs[i]+(Math.random()-0.5)*170);
  if(state.progress>=1){drawChart();updateSums();}
  lastUpdate=Date.now();
  sessions=clamp(sessions+Math.round((Math.random()-0.5)*70),40000,60000);
  $('#kpiSessions').textContent=fmt(sessions);
},3000);

/* ================= STAGGER + INIT ================= */
$$('.card').forEach((c,i)=>c.style.animationDelay=(90+i*70)+'ms');
function init(){
  sizeCanvas();
  state.data=genData(30);
  updateSums();
  animateChart();
  drawSparks();
  renderHealth();
  showInsight(0);
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>
    $$('.src-fill').forEach(el=>el.style.width=el.dataset.w+'%')));
}
let rT;
addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(rT);
  rT=setTimeout(()=>{sizeCanvas();drawChart();drawSparks();},150);});
if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready)
  document.fonts.ready.then(()=>{drawChart();drawSparks();});
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        :root {
            --bg-primary: #f0f2f5;
            --bg-secondary: #ffffff;
            --bg-sidebar: #ffffff;
            --text-primary: #1e293b;
            --text-secondary: #64748b;

            --sidebar-active: #6366f1;

            --sidebar-logo: #1e293b;
            --sidebar-border: #e2e8f0;

            --bg-primary: #0d1117;
            --bg-secondary: #161b22;
            --bg-sidebar: #161b22;
            --text-primary: #e2e8f0;
            --text-secondary: #8b949e;
            --accent: #818cf8;
            --accent-hover: #6366f1;
            --border-color: #21262d;

            --chart-grid: #21262d;
            --sidebar-text: #8b949e;
            --sidebar-active: #818cf8;
            --sidebar-hover: #1a1a2e;

    <script>
        // Theme toggle
        const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
        let myChart = null;

        themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
            if (myChart) {
                myChart.destroy();
            }
            createChart();
        });

        // Create Chart
        function createChart() {
            const ctx = document.getElementById('analyticsChart').getContext('2d');

            const styles = getComputedStyle(document.body);
            const textColor = styles.getPropertyValue('--text-secondary').trim();
            const gridColor = styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-grid').trim();
            const accentColor = styles.getPropertyValue('--accent').trim();

            // Gradients

content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="dark">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<title>Nexus — AI Analytics</title>
<style>
  /* ============ THEME TOKENS ============ */
  :root {
    --bg: #f4f6fb;
    --glow-1: rgba(99, 102, 241, .10);
    --glow-2: rgba(6, 182, 212, .09);
    --surface: #ffffff;
    --surface-2: #f2f4f9;
    --surface-3: #e8ecf5;
    --border: rgba(15, 23, 42, .08);
    --border-strong: rgba(15, 23, 42, .14);
    --text: #0b1220;
    --muted: #64748b;
    --accent: #6366f1;
    --accent-2: #06b6d4;
    --accent-soft: rgba(99, 102, 241, .12);
    --good: #10b981;
    --good-soft: rgba(16, 185, 129, .12);
    --bad: #f43f5e;
    --bad-soft: rgba(244, 63, 94, .12);
    --chart-grid: rgba(15, 23, 42, .07);
    --chart-axis: rgba(15, 23, 42, .20);
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, .04), 0 10px 30px -14px rgba(15, 23, 42, .22);
    --shadow-lg: 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(15, 23, 42, .30);
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] {
    --bg: #080910;
    --glow-1: rgba(99, 102, 241, .20);
    --glow-2: rgba(6, 182, 212, .13);
    --surface: #111320;
    --surface-2: #181b2b;
    --surface-3: #1f2336;
    --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, .07);
    --border-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, .13);
    --text: #eef1f8;
    --muted: #8b93a7;
    --accent: #818cf8;
    --accent-2: #22d3ee;
    --accent-soft: rgba(129, 140, 248, .14);
    --good: #34d399;
    --good-soft: rgba(52, 211, 153, .13);
    --bad: #fb7185;
    --bad-soft: rgba(251, 113, 133, .13);
    --chart-grid: rgba(255, 255, 255, .06);
    --chart-axis: rgba(255, 255, 255, .16);
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4), 0 14px 36px -18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .9);
    --shadow-lg: 0 30px 70px -30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);
  }

  /* ============ BASE ============ */
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }

  html, body { height: 100%; }

  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    background-color: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    transition: background-color .35s ease, color .35s ease;
  }

  body::before {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(900px 520px at 12% -8%, var(--glow-1), transparent 62%),
      radial-gradient(760px 460px at 96% 4%, var(--glow-2), transparent 60%);
    transition: background .35s ease;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  ::selection { background: var(--accent-soft); }

  /* ============ LAYOUT ============ */
  .app {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: flex;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  /* ---- Sidebar ---- */
  .sidebar {
    width: 250px;
    flex: 0 0 250px;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 22px 16px;
    background: var(--surface);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
    transition: background-color .35s ease, border-color .35s ease, transform .32s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1);
    z-index: 60;
  }

  .brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 11px;
    padding: 4px 8px 22px;
  }

  .brand-mark {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -6px var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .brand-name {
    font-size: 15.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -.02em;
  }

  .brand-sub {
    font-size: 10.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
    letter-spacing: .09em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }

  .nav-label {
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;

  .nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    font-weight: 550;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;

  .nav-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 auto; }

  .nav-item:hover {
    background: var(--surface-2);
    color: var(--text);
  }

  .nav-item.active {
    background: var(--accent-soft);

  .nav-item .pill {
    margin-left: auto;

  .sidebar-foot {
    margin-top: auto;
    padding-top: 14px;
  }

  .upgrade {
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 14px;
    background: linear-gradient(150deg, var(--accent-soft), transparent 70%);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .upgrade h4 {
    margin: 0 0 4px;
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: -.01em;
  }

  .upgrade p {
    margin: 0 0 10px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .upgrade button {
    width: 100%;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 9px;
    padding: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 650;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: #fff;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
    transition: filter .2s, transform .2s;
  }

  .upgrade button:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-1px); }

  /* ---- Main ---- */
  .main {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .topbar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 40;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 14px 26px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 78%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(160%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(160%);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    transition: background-color .35s ease, border-color .35s ease;
  }

  .menu-btn {
    display: none;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--surface);
    color: var(--text);
    cursor: pointer;
    place-items: center;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .search {
    position: relative;
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 380px;
  }

  .search svg {
    position: absolute;
    left: 12px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 15px;
    height: 15px;
    color: var(--muted);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .search input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 9px 12px 9px 34px;
    border-radius: 11px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--surface);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-family: inherit;
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s, background-color .35s;
  }

  .search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }

  .search input:focus {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);
  }

  .top-actions {
    margin-left: auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .icon-btn {
    position: relative;
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    border-radius: 11px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--surface);
    color: var(--muted);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: color .2s, border-color .2s, background-color .2s, transform .2s;
  }

  .icon-btn:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--border-strong); transform: translateY(-1px); }

  .icon-btn .dot {
    position: absolute;
    top: 8px;
    right: 9px;
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--bad);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface);
  }

  /* ---- Theme toggle ---- */
  .theme-toggle {
    position: relative;
    width: 62px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 99px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--surface-2);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    color: var(--muted);
    transition: background-color .3s, border-color .3s;
  }

  .theme-toggle svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    transition: color .3s, opacity .3s;
  }

  .theme-toggle .knob {
    position: absolute;
    top: 3px;
    left: 3px;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--surface);

    transition: transform .38s cubic-bezier(.4, 1.5, .5, 1), background-color .3s;
    z-index: 1;

  [data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .knob { transform: translateX(32px); }

  .theme-toggle .sun { color: var(--accent); }
  .theme-toggle .moon { color: var(--muted); opacity: .55; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .sun { color: var(--muted); opacity: .55; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .moon { color: var(--accent-2); opacity: 1; }

  .avatar {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    border-radius: 11px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f472b6, #8b5cf6);

    flex: 0 0 auto;

  /* ---- Content ---- */
  .content {
    padding: 26px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 18px;
    max-width: 1500px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .page-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 16px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .page-head h1 {
    margin: 0 0 5px;
    font-size: 23px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -.028em;
  }

  .page-head p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 13px;

  .btn-primary {
    border: none;
    border-radius: 11px;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 650;
    font-family: inherit;
    color: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));

  .btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1.5px); filter: brightness(1.07); }

  /* ---- Cards ---- */
  .card {

  .stats {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));

  .stat {

    gap: 10px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;

  .stat:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }

  .stat-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;

  .stat-label {

  .stat-icon {

  .spark {

  /* ---- Grid ---- */
  .grid {

    padding: 5px 11px;

  .range:hover { color: var(--text); }

  .range.active {

  .tooltip {

    z-index: 5;
    min-width: 108px;
  }

  .tooltip.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -118%) scale(1); }

  .tt-label {
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .07em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .tt-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    line-height: 1.9;
  }

  .tt-row b {
    margin-left: auto;
    color: var(--text);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .tt-dot {
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .legend {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    padding: 0 20px 18px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
    flex-wrap: wrap;

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ============================================================
     THEME
     ============================================================ */
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const themeToggle = document.getElementById("themeToggle");

  themeToggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
    const next = root.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    root.setAttribute("data-theme", next);
    // Redraw chart with new theme colors
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { draw(); });
  });

  /* ============================================================
     DATA
     ============================================================ */
  const RANGES = {
    "7D": {
      labels: ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"],
      actual: [62, 74, 68, 88, 95, 84, 102],
      forecast: [null, null, null, null, null, 84, 118],
      max: 140
    },
    "30D": {
      labels: ["W1", "W2", "W3", "W4", "W5", "W6", "W7", "W8"],
      actual: [48, 58, 52, 72, 66, 88, 82, 98],
      forecast: [null, null, null, null, null, null, 82, 112],
      max: 130
    },
    "12M": {
      labels: ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"],
      actual: [42, 55, 48, 68, 62, 84, 78, 96, 88],
      forecast: [null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, 88, 118, 130, 148],
      max: 160
    }
  };

  let current = RANGES["12M"];

  /* ============================================================
     CANVAS SETUP
     ============================================================ */
  const wrap = document.getElementById("chartWrap");
  const canvas = document.getElementById("chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const tooltip = document.getElementById("tooltip");

  const PAD = { l: 46, r: 18, t: 22, b: 34 };
  let progress = 0;
  let hoverIndex = -1;
  let animId = null;

  /* ---- helpers ---- */
  function cssVar(name) {
    return getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
  }

  function withAlpha(color, a) {
    if (!color) return "rgba(0,0,0,0)";
    let c = color.trim();
    if (c.startsWith("#")) {
      let h = c.slice(1);
      if (h.length === 3) h = h.split("").map(function (x) { return x + x; }).join("");
      const n = parseInt(h, 16);
      return "rgba(" + ((n >> 16) & 255) + "," + ((n >> 8) & 255) + "," + (n & 255) + "," + a + ")";
    }
    if (c.startsWith("rgb")) {
      return c.replace(/rgba?\(([^)]+)\)/, function (_, inner) {
        const parts = inner.split(",").map(function (s) { return s.trim(); }).slice(0, 3);
        return "rgba(" + parts.join(",") + "," + a + ")";
      });
    }
    return c;
  }

  function buildPoints(w, h) {
    const iw = w - PAD.l - PAD.r;
    const ih = h - PAD.t - PAD.b;
    const n = current.labels.length;
    return {
      iw: iw,
      ih: ih,
      x: function (i) { return PAD.l + (n > 1 ? (iw * i) / (n - 1) : iw / 2); },
      y: function (v) { return PAD.t + ih - (v / current.max) * ih; }
    };
  }

  function curvePath(c, pts) {
    if (!pts.length) return;
    c.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
      const p0 = pts[i - 1] || pts[i];
      const p1 = pts[i];
      const p2 = pts[i + 1];
      const p3 = pts[i + 2] || p2;
      const c1x = p1.x + (p2.x - p0.x) / 6;
      const c1y = p1.y + (p2.y - p0.y) / 6;
      const c2x = p2.x - (p3.x - p1.x) / 6;
      const c2y = p2.y - (p3.y - p1.y) / 6;
      c.bezierCurveTo(c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, p2.x, p2.y);
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     DRAW
     ============================================================ */
  function draw() {
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const w = wrap.clientWidth;
    const h = wrap.clientHeight;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

    if (canvas.width !== Math.round(w * dpr) || canvas.height !== Math.round(h * dpr)) {
      canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
    }
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    const accent = cssVar("--accent") || "#818cf8";
    const accent2 = cssVar("--accent-2") || "#22d3ee";
    const gridColor = cssVar("--chart-grid");
    const axisColor = cssVar("--chart-axis");
    const mutedColor = cssVar("--muted");
    const surfaceColor = cssVar("--surface");

    const P = buildPoints(w, h);
    const n = current.labels.length;

    /* ---- grid + y labels ---- */
    ctx.font = "11px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    const ticks = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1];
    for (let i = 0; i < ticks.length; i++) {
      const val = current.max * ticks[i];
      const yy = P.y(val);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(PAD.l, yy);
      ctx.lineTo(w - PAD.r, yy);
      ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = mutedColor;
      ctx.fillText(Math.round(val), PAD.l - 10, yy);
    }

    /* ---- x labels ---- */
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    const step = w < 520 ? 2 : 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (i % step !== 0 && i !== n - 1) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = mutedColor;
      ctx.fillText(current.labels[i], P.x(i), h - PAD.b + 12);
    }

    /* ---- animated clip ---- */
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(0, 0, PAD.l + P.iw * progress + 4, h);
    ctx.clip();

    /* ---- actual series ---- */
    const actualPts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (current.actual[i] != null) actualPts.push({ x: P.x(i), y: P.y(current.actual[i]) });
    }

    if (actualPts.length > 1) {
      // area fill
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, PAD.t, 0, PAD.t + P.ih);
      grad.addColorStop(0, withAlpha(accent, 0.34));
      grad.addColorStop(0.65, withAlpha(accent, 0.08));
      grad.addColorStop(1, withAlpha(accent, 0));

      ctx.beginPath();
      curvePath(ctx, actualPts);
      ctx.lineTo(actualPts[actualPts.length - 1].x, PAD.t + P.ih);
      ctx.lineTo(actualPts[0].x, PAD.t + P.ih);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fill();

      // line
      ctx.beginPath();
      curvePath(ctx, actualPts);
      ctx.strokeStyle = accent;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.6;
      ctx.lineJoin = "round";
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.shadowColor = withAlpha(accent, 0.55);
      ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    }

    /* ---- forecast series ---- */
    const fcPts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (current.forecast[i] != null) fcPts.push({ x: P.x(i), y: P.y(current.forecast[i]) });
    }

    if (fcPts.length > 1) {
      // soft area under forecast
      const fgrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, PAD.t, 0, PAD.t + P.ih);
      fgrad.addColorStop(0, withAlpha(accent2, 0.20));
      fgrad.addColorStop(1, withAlpha(accent2, 0));

      ctx.beginPath();
      curvePath(ctx, fcPts);
      ctx.lineTo(fcPts[fcPts.length - 1].x, PAD.t + P.ih);
      ctx.lineTo(fcPts[0].x, PAD.t + P.ih);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = fgrad;
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.beginPath();
      curvePath(ctx, fcPts);
      ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = accent2;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.6;
      ctx.lineJoin = "round";
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.shadowColor = withAlpha(accent2, 0.5);
      ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }

    ctx.restore();

    /* ---- hover crosshair ---- */
    if (hoverIndex >= 0 && progress > 0.98) {
      const hx = P.x(hoverIndex);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hx, PAD.t);
      ctx.lineTo(hx, PAD.t + P.ih);
      ctx.strokeStyle = axisColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);

      const marks = [];
      if (current.actual[hoverIndex] != null) marks.push({ v: current.actual[hoverIndex], c: accent });
      if (current.forecast[hoverIndex] != null) marks.push({ v: current.forecast[hoverIndex], c: accent2 });

      for (let i = 0; i < marks.length; i++) {
        const my = P.y(marks[i].v);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(hx, my, 5.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = marks[i].c;
        ctx.shadowColor = withAlpha(marks[i].c, 0.7);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.strokeStyle = surfaceColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     ANIMATION
     ============================================================ */
  function animateIn() {
    if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
    const start = performance.now();
    const dur = 1000;

    function frame(now) {
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / dur);
      progress = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
      draw();
      if (t < 1) {
        animId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      } else {
        animId = null;
      }
    }
    animId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     TOOLTIP
     ============================================================ */
  function updateTooltip(i, w, h) {
    const P = buildPoints(w, h);
    const a = current.actual[i];
    const f = current.forecast[i];

    let rows = "";
    if (a != null) {
      rows += '<div class="tt-row"><span class="tt-dot" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>Actual<b>' + a + '</b></div>';
    }
    if (f != null) {
      rows += '<div class="tt-row"><span class="tt-dot" style="background:var(--accent-2)"></span>Forecast<b>' + f + '</b></div>';
    }

    tooltip.innerHTML = '<div class="tt-label">' + current.labels[i] + "</div>" + rows;

    const px = Math.min(Math.max(P.x(i), 62), w - 62);
    const py = P.y(a != null ? a : f);

    tooltip.style.left = px + "px";
    tooltip.style.top = py + "px";
    tooltip.classList.add("show");
  }

  function hideTooltip() {
    tooltip.classList.remove("show");
  }

  /* ============================================================
     EVENTS
     ============================================================ */
  function onMove(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const P = buildPoints(rect.width, rect.height);
    const n = current.labels.length;

    let best = 0;
    let bestDist = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const d = Math.abs(P.x(i) - mx);
      if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = i; }
    }

    hoverIndex = best;
    draw();
    updateTooltip(best, rect.width, rect.height);
  }

  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", onMove);
  canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () {
    hoverIndex = -1;
    hideTooltip();
    draw();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", function (e) {
    if (e.touches.length) onMove(e.touches[0]);
  }, { passive: true });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchend", function () {
    hoverIndex = -1;
    hideTooltip();
    draw();
  });

  /* ---- range pills ---- */
  const rangesEl = document.getElementById("ranges");
  rangesEl.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    const btn = e.target.closest(".range");
    if (!btn) return;

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(rangesEl.querySelectorAll(".range"), function (b) {
      b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn);
    });

    current = RANGES[btn.dataset.range] || RANGES["12M"];
    hoverIndex = -1;
    hideTooltip();
    progress = 0;
    animateIn();
  });

  /* ---- resize ---- */
  let resizeTimer = null;
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
    new ResizeObserver(function () {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () { draw(); }, 60);
    }).observe(wrap);
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () { draw(); }, 60);
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     SPARKLINES
     ============================================================ */
  function sparkPath(data, w, h) {
    const min = Math.min.apply(null, data);
    const max = Math.max.apply(null, data);
    const range = (max - min) || 1;
    const pts = data.map(function (v, i) {
      return {
        x: (i * w) / (data.length - 1),
        y: h - ((v - min) / range) * (h - 8) - 4
      };
    });

    let d = "M " + pts[0].x.toFixed(2) + " " + pts[0].y.toFixed(2);
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
      const p0 = pts[i - 1] || pts[i];
      const p1 = pts[i];
      const p2 = pts[i + 1];
      const p3 = pts[i + 2] || p2;
      const c1x = p1.x + (p2.x - p0.x) / 6;
      const c1y = p1.y + (p2.y - p0.y) / 6;
      const c2x = p2.x - (p3.x - p1.x) / 6;
      const c2y = p2.y - (p3.y - p1.y) / 6;
      d += " C " + c1x.toFixed(2) + " " + c1y.toFixed(2) + ", " +
        c2x.toFixed(2) + " " + c2y.toFixed(2) + ", " +
        p2.x.toFixed(2) + " " + p2.y.toFixed(2);
    }
    return d;
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-spark]").forEach(function (el) {
    let data;
    try { data = JSON.parse(el.dataset.spark); } catch (err) { return; }
    const color = el.dataset.color || "var(--accent)";
    const d = sparkPath(data, 100, 32);

    el.innerHTML =
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 100 32" preserveAspectRatio="none">' +
        '<path d="' + d + '" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="2" ' +
        'stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>' +
      "</svg>";
  });

  /* ============================================================
     PROGRESS BARS
     ============================================================ */
  requestAnimationFrame(function () {
    setTimeout(function () {
      document.querySelectorAll(".bar > i").forEach(function (bar) {
        bar.style.width = bar.dataset.w + "%";
      });
    }, 220);
  });

  /* ============================================================
     MOBILE SIDEBAR
     ============================================================ */
  const sidebar = document.getElementById("sidebar");
  const backdrop = document.getElementById("backdrop");
  const menuBtn = document.getElementById("menuBtn");

  function openSidebar() {
    sidebar.classList.add("open");
    backdrop.classList.add("show");
  }
  function closeSidebar() {
    sidebar.classList.remove("open");
    backdrop.classList.remove("show");
  }

  menuBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (sidebar.classList.contains("open")) closeSidebar();
    else openSidebar();
  });
  backdrop.addEventListener("click", closeSidebar);

  /* ============================================================
     INIT
     ============================================================ */
  // Wait a tick so layout settles before measuring.
  requestAnimationFrame(function () {
    draw();
    animateIn();
  });

  window.addEventListener("load", function () {
    draw();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
