question: dark-mode-dashboard
prompt: Design a sleek admin dashboard UI with light and dark mode toggle, featuring an AI analytics graph. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nova AI — Admin Dashboard</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');

  :root {
    --bg-primary: #f0f2f5;
    --bg-secondary: #ffffff;
    --bg-tertiary: #f8f9fb;
    --bg-card: #ffffff;
    --bg-sidebar: #1a1d23;
    --bg-sidebar-hover: #2a2d35;
    --bg-sidebar-active: rgba(99,102,241,0.15);
    --text-primary: #1a1d23;
    --text-secondary: #6b7280;
    --text-tertiary: #9ca3af;
    --text-sidebar: #a0a4ab;
    --text-sidebar-active: #818cf8;
    --accent: #6366f1;
    --accent-light: #818cf8;
    --accent-glow: rgba(99,102,241,0.12);
    --accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #8b5cf6);
    --success: #10b981;
    --success-bg: rgba(16,185,129,0.1);
    --warning: #f59e0b;
    --warning-bg: rgba(245,158,11,0.1);
    --danger: #ef4444;
    --danger-bg: rgba(239,68,68,0.1);
    --info: #06b6d4;
    --info-bg: rgba(6,182,212,0.1);
    --border: #e5e7eb;
    --border-light: #f3f4f6;
    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
    --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
    --shadow-lg: 0 10px 25px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
    --shadow-xl: 0 20px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
    --chart-line1: #6366f1;
    --chart-line2: #8b5cf6;
    --chart-line3: #06b6d4;
    --chart-fill1: rgba(99,102,241,0.08);
    --chart-fill2: rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
    --chart-grid: rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    --chart-label: #9ca3af;
    --toggle-bg: #e5e7eb;
    --toggle-icon: #f59e0b;
    --scrollbar: #d1d5db;
    --hover-card: #f9fafb;
    --tooltip-bg: #1a1d23;
    --tooltip-text: #ffffff;
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] {
    --bg-primary: #0f1117;
    --bg-secondary: #1a1d27;
    --bg-tertiary: #151822;
    --bg-card: #1e2130;
    --bg-sidebar: #12141c;
    --bg-sidebar-hover: #1e2130;
    --bg-sidebar-active: rgba(99,102,241,0.12);
    --text-primary: #f1f2f5;
    --text-secondary: #8b8fa3;
    --text-tertiary: #5c6078;
    --text-sidebar: #6b7084;
    --text-sidebar-active: #818cf8;
    --accent: #818cf8;
    --accent-light: #a5b4fc;
    --accent-glow: rgba(99,102,241,0.15);
    --accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #8b5cf6);
    --success: #34d399;
    --success-bg: rgba(52,211,153,0.1);
    --warning: #fbbf24;
    --warning-bg: rgba(251,191,36,0.1);
    --danger: #f87171;
    --danger-bg: rgba(248,113,113,0.1);
    --info: #22d3ee;
    --info-bg: rgba(34,211,238,0.1);
    --border: #2a2d3a;
    --border-light: #22252f;
    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    --shadow-lg: 0 10px 25px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    --shadow-xl: 0 20px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    --chart-line1: #818cf8;
    --chart-line2: #a78bfa;
    --chart-line3: #22d3ee;
    --chart-fill1: rgba(129,140,248,0.1);
    --chart-fill2: rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
    --chart-grid: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    --chart-label: #5c6078;
    --toggle-bg: #2a2d3a;
    --toggle-icon: #a78bfa;
    --scrollbar: #3a3d4a;
    --hover-card: #22252f;
    --tooltip-bg: #2a2d3a;
    --tooltip-text: #e5e7eb;
  }

  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }

  body {
    font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    overflow-x: hidden;
    transition: background 0.4s ease, color 0.4s ease;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar { width:6px; height:6px; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background:transparent; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:var(--scrollbar); border-radius:3px; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background:var(--accent); }

  /* ===== SIDEBAR ===== */
  .sidebar {
    position: fixed; left:0; top:0; bottom:0;
    width: 260px;
    background: var(--bg-sidebar);
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
  }

  .sidebar-logo {
    padding: 28px 24px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  }
  .sidebar-logo .logo-icon {
    width: 40px; height: 40px;
    background: var(--accent-gradient);
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 18px; color: #fff; font-weight: 700;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(99,102,241,0.35);
  }
  .sidebar-logo .logo-text {
    font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  }
  .sidebar-logo .logo-text span { color: var(--accent-light); }

  .sidebar-nav { flex:1; padding: 8px 12px; overflow-y: auto; }
  .nav-section-title {
    padding: 20px 12px 10px;
    font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: var(--text-sidebar);
    font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.6;
  }
  .nav-item {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
    padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 10px;
    color: var(--text-sidebar); font-size: 13.5px;
    font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .nav-item:hover {
    background: var(--bg-sidebar-hover);
    color: #fff;
  }
  .nav-item.active {
    background: var(--bg-sidebar-active);
    color: var(--text-sidebar-active);
  }
  .nav-item.active::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; left: -12px; top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 3px; height: 24px;
    background: var(--accent);
    border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
  }
  .nav-item svg {
    width: 20px; height: 20px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    opacity: 0.85;
  }
  .nav-item .badge {
    margin-left: auto;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    border-radius: 10px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .sidebar-footer {
    padding: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }
  .sidebar-user {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  .sidebar-user:hover { background: var(--bg-sidebar-hover); }
  .sidebar-user .avatar {
    width: 36px; height: 36px;
    background: var(--accent-gradient);
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 13px; color: #fff; font-weight: 600;
  }
  .sidebar-user .user-info .name {
    font-size: 13px; color: #fff; font-weight: 500;
  }
  .sidebar-user .user-info .role {
    font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-sidebar);
  }

  /* ===== MAIN ===== */
  .main-wrapper {
    margin-left: 260px;
    min-height: 100vh;
    transition: margin 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
  }

  /* ===== TOPBAR ===== */
  .topbar {
    position: sticky; top: 0;
    height: 72px;
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    display: flex; align-items: center;
    padding: 0 32px;
    gap: 20px;
    z-index: 50;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    transition: background 0.4s ease, border-color 0.4s ease;
  }

  .topbar-search {
    flex: 1; max-width: 480px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .topbar-search input {
    width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px 10px 42px;
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    font-family: inherit;
    outline: none;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .topbar-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
  .topbar-search input:focus {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-glow);
  }
  .topbar-search .search-icon {
    position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    width: 16px; height: 16px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .topbar-actions {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    margin-left: auto;
  }

  .topbar-btn {
    width: 40px; height: 40px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    position: relative;
  }
  .topbar-btn:hover {
    background: var(--hover-card);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    border-color: var(--accent);
  }
  .topbar-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
  .topbar-btn .notif-dot {
    position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px;
    width: 7px; height: 7px;
    background: var(--danger);
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid var(--bg-secondary);
  }

  /* Theme Toggle */
  .theme-toggle {
    display: flex; align-items: center;
    padding: 4px;
    background: var(--toggle-bg);
    border-radius: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    gap: 2px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .theme-toggle .toggle-opt {
    width: 34px; height: 34px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
  }
  .theme-toggle .toggle-opt.active {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    color: var(--toggle-icon);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  }
  .theme-toggle .toggle-opt svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

  /* ===== CONTENT ===== */
  .content {
    padding: 28px 32px;
  }

  .page-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .page-title h1 {
    font-size: 26px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  }
  .page-title p {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-top: 4px;
  }
  .page-actions {
    display: flex; gap: 10px;
  }
  .btn {
    padding: 10px 20px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-family: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    border: none;
  }
  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--accent-gradient);
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(99,102,241,0.3);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(99,102,241,0.4);
  }
  .btn-secondary {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .btn-secondary:hover {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-glow);
  }
  .btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

  /* ===== STATS GRID ===== */
  .stats-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }
  .stat-card {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 22px 24px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .stat-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    border-color: var(--accent);
  }
  .stat-card::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; right: 0;
    width: 100px; height: 100px;
    border-radius: 0 16px 0 100%;
    opacity: 0.04;
  }
  .stat-card:nth-child(1)::after { background: var(--accent); }
  .stat-card:nth-child(2)::after { background: var(--success); }
  .stat-card:nth-child(3)::after { background: var(--warning); }
  .stat-card:nth-child(4)::after { background: var(--info); }

  .stat-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .stat-icon {
    width: 42px; height: 42px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .stat-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
  .stat-icon.purple { background: var(--accent-glow); color: var(--accent); }
  .stat-icon.green { background: var(--success-bg); color: var(--success); }
  .stat-icon.orange { background: var(--warning-bg); color: var(--warning); }
  .stat-icon.blue { background: var(--info-bg); color: var(--info); }

  .stat-trend {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
  }
  .stat-trend.up { color: var(--success); background: var(--success-bg); }
  .stat-trend.down { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-bg); }
  .stat-trend svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

  .stat-value {
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -1px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .stat-label {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* ===== CHART SECTION ===== */
  .chart-section {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 28px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    transition: background 0.4s, border-color 0.4s;
  }
  .chart-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .chart-title-group .chart-title {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .chart-title .ai-badge {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    background: var(--accent-gradient);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .ai-badge svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
  .chart-title-group .chart-subtitle {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .chart-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .chart-legend {
    display: flex;
    gap: 16px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .legend-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    opacity: 1;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
  }
  .legend-item:hover { opacity: 0.7; }
  .legend-dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
  }
  .legend-dot.purple { background: var(--chart-line1); }
  .legend-dot.violet { background: var(--chart-line2); }
  .legend-dot.cyan { background: var(--chart-line3); }

  .time-range {
    display: flex;
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 3px;
  }
  .time-range button {
    padding: 6px 12px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font-size: 11.5px;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-family: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 6px;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .time-range button:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
  .time-range button.active {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(99,102,241,0.3);
  }

  .chart-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 340px;
  }
  .chart-wrapper canvas {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    border-radius: 8px;
  }

  .chart-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    background: var(--tooltip-bg);
    color: var(--tooltip-text);
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
    z-index: 10;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    white-space: nowrap;
    transform: translate(-50%, -110%);
  }
  .chart-tooltip .tooltip-date {
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .chart-tooltip .tooltip-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 2px;
    font-size: 11px;
    opacity: 0.9;
  }
  .chart-tooltip .tooltip-dot {
    width: 6px; height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* ===== BOTTOM GRID ===== */
  .bottom-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }

  .panel {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 24px;
    transition: background 0.4s, border-color 0.4s;
  }
  .panel-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .panel-title {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .panel-title svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--accent); }
  .panel-link {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--accent);
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .panel-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

  /* AI Insights */
  .insight-item {
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 14px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  }
  .insight-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }
  .insight-icon {
    width: 38px; height: 38px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .insight-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
  .insight-icon.purple { background: var(--accent-glow); color: var(--accent); }
  .insight-icon.green { background: var(--success-bg); color: var(--success); }
  .insight-icon.orange { background: var(--warning-bg); color: var(--warning); }
  .insight-icon.red { background: var(--danger-bg); color: var(--danger); }
  .insight-content .insight-title {
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
  }
  .insight-content .insight-desc {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .insight-content .insight-time {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  /* Activity */
  .activity-item {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 12px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    position: relative;
  }
  .activity-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .activity-avatar {
    width: 34px; height: 34px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .activity-content .activity-text {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }
  .activity-content .activity-text strong {
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .activity-content .activity-time {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    margin-top: 3px;
  }

  /* Progress Bars in panels */
  .progress-list { margin-top: 4px; }
  .progress-item {
    padding: 10px 0;
  }
  .progress-label {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .progress-label .label { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 500; }
  .progress-label .value { color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 600; }
  .progress-bar {
    height: 6px;
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: width 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    width: 0;
  }
  .progress-fill.purple { background: var(--accent-gradient); }
  .progress-fill.green { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #10b981, #34d399); }
  .progress-fill.orange { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f59e0b, #fbbf24); }
  .progress-fill.cyan { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #06b6d4, #22d3ee); }

  /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
  @media (max-width: 1200px) {
    .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .bottom-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .sidebar {
      transform: translateX(-100%);
    }
    .sidebar.open {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
    .main-wrapper {
      margin-left: 0;
    }
    .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
    .content { padding: 20px 16px; }
    .topbar { padding: 0 16px; }
    .topbar-search { display: none; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 480px) {
    .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .page-actions { display: none; }
    .chart-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
    .chart-legend { display: none; }
    .time-range { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
    .time-range button { flex: 1; }
    .chart-wrapper { height: 250px; }
    .stat-value { font-size: 22px; }
    .page-title h1 { font-size: 20px; }
  }

  /* Overlay for mobile sidebar */
  .sidebar-overlay {
    display: none;
    position: fixed; inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    z-index: 99;
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  }
  .sidebar-overlay.active { display: block; }

  /* Animation keyframes */
  @keyframes fadeInUp {
    from { opacity:0; transform: translateY(20px); }
    to { opacity:1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }
  .animate-in {
    animation: fadeInUp 0.5s ease forwards;
    opacity: 0;
  }
  .animate-in:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
  .animate-in:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
  .animate-in:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
  .animate-in:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }

  /* Sparkline mini-charts inside stat cards */
  .stat-sparkline {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 12px;
    right: 16px;
    width: 80px;
    height: 32px;
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
</style>

<script>
  // ===== THEME TOGGLE =====
  function setTheme(theme) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
    const lightBtn = document.getElementById('lightBtn');
    const darkBtn = document.getElementById('darkBtn');
    if (theme === 'dark') {
      darkBtn.classList.add('active');
      lightBtn.classList.remove('active');
    } else {
      lightBtn.classList.add('active');
      darkBtn.classList.remove('active');
    }
    // Redraw chart
    drawChart();
  }

  // Load saved theme
  (function() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    if (saved) setTheme(saved);
    else if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) setTheme('dark');
  })();

  // ===== SIDEBAR TOGGLE (Mobile) =====
  function toggleSidebar() {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
    sidebar.classList.toggle('open');
    overlay.classList.toggle('active');
  }

  function checkMobile() {
    const menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
      menuBtn.style.display = 'flex';
    } else {
      menuBtn.style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('open');
      document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay').classList.remove('active');
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
  checkMobile();

  // ===== NAV ITEM CLICK =====
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', function() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('active'));
      this.classList.add('active');
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) toggleSidebar();
    });
  });

  // ===== TIME RANGE =====
  let currentRange = '30d';
  function setTimeRange(btn, range) {
    btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    currentRange = range;
    drawChart();
  }

  // ===== CHART DATA =====
  const chartData = {
    '24h': {
      labels: ['00:00','02:00','04:00','06:00','08:00','10:00','12:00','14:00','16:00','18:00','20:00','22:00'],
      accuracy: [82,84,83,87,89,92,91,94,93,95,96,94],
      throughput: [65,68,62,72,78,85,82,88,86,90,92,88],
      efficiency: [70,72,68,75,80,84,81,86,83,88,90,87]
    },
    '7d': {
      labels: ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'],
      accuracy: [85,88,86,91,93,90,95],
      throughput: [70,75,72,80,82,78,85],
      efficiency: [72,76,74,82,85,80,88]
    },
    '30d': {
      labels: ['Day 1','Day 5','Day 10','Day 15','Day 20','Day 25','Day 30'],
      accuracy: [78,82,85,88,91,93,96],
      throughput: [60,66,72,76,82,86,90],
      efficiency: [65,70,75,78,84,87,91]
    },
    '90d': {
      labels: ['Wk 1','Wk 3','Wk 5','Wk 7','Wk 9','Wk 11','Wk 13'],
      accuracy: [72,78,82,86,90,93,97],
      throughput: [55,62,70,75,80,85,92],
      efficiency: [58,65,72,77,82,88,94]
    }
  };

  // ===== DRAW CHART =====
  function drawChart() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('mainChart');
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('chartWrapper');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
    canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
    canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

    const W = rect.width;
    const H = rect.height;

    const data = chartData[currentRange];
    const labels = data.labels;

    const styles = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
    const color1 = styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-line1').trim();
    const color2 = styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-line2').trim();
    const color3 = styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-line3').trim();
    const gridColor = styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-grid').trim();
    const labelColor = styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-label').trim();
    const fill1 = styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-fill1').trim();
    const fill2 = styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-fill2').trim();

    // Chart area
    const padTop = 30;
    const padBottom = 40;
    const padLeft = 50;
    const padRight = 20;
    const chartW = W - padLeft - padRight;
    const chartH = H - padTop - padBottom;

    // Clear
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Find min/max
    const allData = [...data.accuracy, ...data.throughput, ...data.efficiency];
    const minVal = Math.floor(Math.min(...allData) / 10) * 10 - 5;
    const maxVal = Math.ceil(Math.max(...allData) / 10) * 10 + 5;
    const range = maxVal - minVal;

    // Grid lines
    const gridCount = 5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.font = '11px Inter, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    for (let i = 0; i <= gridCount; i++) {
      const y = padTop + (chartH / gridCount) * i;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padLeft, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W - padRight, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      const val = maxVal - (range / gridCount) * i;
      ctx.fillStyle = labelColor;
      ctx.fillText(Math.round(val) + '%', padLeft - 12, y);
    }

    // X labels
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    labels.forEach((label, i) => {
      const x = padLeft + (chartW / (labels.length - 1)) * i;
      ctx.fillStyle = labelColor;
      ctx.fillText(label, x, padTop + chartH + 14);
    });

    // Draw smooth curves
    function getPoints(values) {
      return values.map((v, i) => ({
        x: padLeft + (chartW / (values.length - 1)) * i,
        y: padTop + chartH - ((v - minVal) / range) * chartH
      }));
    }

    function drawSmoothLine(points, color, lineWidth, fillGradient) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);
      for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
        const xc = (points[i].x + points[i + 1].x) / 2;
        const yc = (points[i].y + points[i + 1].y) / 2;
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(points[i].x, points[i].y, xc, yc);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(points[points.length - 1].x, points[points.length - 1].y);
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      ctx.stroke();

      // Fill area
      ctx.lineTo(points[points.length - 1].x, padTop + chartH);
      ctx.lineTo(points[0].x, padTop + chartH);
      ctx.closePath();

      if (fillGradient) {
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, padTop, 0, padTop + chartH);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, fillGradient);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // Draw data points
    function drawPoints(points, color) {
      points.forEach(p => {
        // Outer glow
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = color + '30';
        ctx.fill();

        // Inner dot
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        ctx.fill();

        // White border
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--bg-card').trim();
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
      });
    }

    // Convert hex colors to rgba for fills
    function hexToRgba(hex, alpha) {
      hex = hex.trim();
      if (hex.startsWith('#')) {
        const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3), 16);
        const g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5), 16);
        const b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7), 16);
        return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha})`;
      }
      return hex;
    }

    // Draw each line
    const pts1 = getPoints(data.accuracy);
    const pts2 = getPoints(data.throughput);
    const pts3 = getPoints(data.efficiency);

    // Fill areas first (back to front)
    drawSmoothLine(pts3, color3, 2, hexToRgba(color3, 0.08));
    drawSmoothLine(pts2, color2, 2, hexToRgba(color2, 0.08));
    drawSmoothLine(pts1, color1, 2.5, hexToRgba(color1, 0.12));

    // Draw points on top
    drawPoints(pts3, color3);
    drawPoints(pts2, color2);
    drawPoints(pts1, color1);

    // Store points for tooltip
    canvas._chartPoints = { pts1, pts2, pts3, labels, data, padLeft, chartW, labels };
  }

  // ===== TOOLTIP =====
  (function() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('mainChart');
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('chartTooltip');

    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
      const points = canvas._chartPoints;
      if (!points) return;

      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;

      // Find nearest data point
      let minDist = Infinity;
      let nearestIdx = 0;

      points.pts1.forEach((p, i) => {
        const dist = Math.abs(p.x - mouseX);
        if (dist < minDist) {
          minDist = dist;
          nearestIdx = i;
        }
      });

      if (minDist < 60) {
        const p1 = points.pts1[nearestIdx];
        tooltip.style.opacity = '1';
        tooltip.style.left = p1.x + 'px';
        tooltip.style.top = Math.min(p1.y, points.pts2[nearestIdx].y, points.pts3[nearestIdx].y) + 'px';

        const styles = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
        tooltip.innerHTML = `
          <div class="tooltip-date">${points.labels[nearestIdx]}</div>
          <div class="tooltip-row">
            <div class="tooltip-dot" style="background:${styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-line1').trim()}"></div>
            Accuracy: ${points.data.accuracy[nearestIdx]}%
          </div>
          <div class="tooltip-row">
            <div class="tooltip-dot" style="background:${styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-line2').trim()}"></div>
            Throughput: ${points.data.throughput[nearestIdx]}%
          </div>
          <div class="tooltip-row">
            <div class="tooltip-dot" style="background:${styles.getPropertyValue('--chart-line3').trim()}"></div>
            Efficiency: ${points.data.efficiency[nearestIdx]}%
          </div>
        `;
      } else {
        tooltip.style.opacity = '0';
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
      tooltip.style.opacity = '0';
    });
  })();

  // ===== PROGRESS BARS ANIMATION =====
  function animateProgressBars() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.progress-fill').forEach(bar => {
      const width = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
      setTimeout(() => {
        bar.style.width = width + '%';
      }, 300);
    });
  }

  // ===== INITIALIZE =====
  window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    drawChart();
    animateProgressBars();
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    clearTimeout(window._resizeTimer);
    window._resizeTimer = setTimeout(drawChart, 150);
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>

  border-right:1px solid var(--line);
}
.brand{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;
  background:conic-gradient(from 210deg,var(--accent),var(--mint),var(--violet),var(--accent));
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line),0 8px 22px -8px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.6);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:3px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel);
  clip-path:polygon(50% 12%,88% 34%,88% 66%,50% 88%,12% 66%,12% 34%)}
.brand b{position:relative;z-index:2;font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:800;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink)}
.brand:hover{animation:spin 3.2s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;position:relative;width:100%;align-items:center}
.nav-pill{position:absolute;left:9px;width:3px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--accent);
  box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.9);transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1),height .3s}
.nb{width:46px;height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink3);border-radius:12px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;position:relative;transition:color .2s,background .2s,transform .2s}
.nb svg{width:19px;height:19px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.nb:hover{color:var(--ink);background:var(--accent-soft);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.nb.on{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}
.nb::after{content:attr(data-tip);position:absolute;left:calc(100% + 14px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(-6px);
  background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:5px 10px;border-radius:7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s;letter-spacing:.02em}
.nb:hover::after{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(0)}
.rail-foot{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.rail-live{width:46px;padding:7px 0;border-radius:10px;text-align:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;
  color:var(--mint);border:1px dashed rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.4);background:rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.07)}

.main{flex:1;margin-left:78px;min-width:0}

/* ─────────────────────────────  TOPBAR  ───────────────────────────── */
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:35;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;
  padding:14px 26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 76%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.5)}
.crumb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink3);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.crumb b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.crumb i{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink3);display:inline-block}
.h1{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:800;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;margin:0}
.envchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:6px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mint);background:rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.1);border:1px solid rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.28)}
.dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;position:relative}
.dot::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-4px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;opacity:.35;animation:ping 1.9s cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1) infinite}
@keyframes ping{70%,100%{transform:scale(2.4);opacity:0}}
.search{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 12px;min-width:220px;border-radius:10px;
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink3);cursor:pointer;font-size:12.5px;transition:.2s}
.search:hover{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.5);color:var(--ink2);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}
.search svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8}
kbd{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:10px;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--panel2);
  border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink2);margin-left:auto}
.clock{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap}
.clock b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.iconbtn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink2);
  display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;position:relative;transition:.2s}
.iconbtn:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.5);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.iconbtn svg{width:17px;height:17px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round}
.badge{position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;min-width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--ember);color:#150a04;
  font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg)}
/* theme toggle */
.tt{width:62px;height:32px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);position:relative;cursor:pointer;
  padding:0;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .3s}
.tt:hover{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.55)}
.tt-knob{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--accent),var(--violet));box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.5);
  transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.7,-.35,.25,1.5)}
html[data-theme="light"] .tt-knob{transform:translateX(30px);background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--ember),var(--mint))}
.tt svg{position:absolute;width:13px;height:13px;stroke:var(--bg);fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;top:9px;transition:.4s}
.tt .s1{left:8px;opacity:1}.tt .s2{right:8px;opacity:.55}
html[data-theme="light"] .tt .s1{opacity:.4}html[data-theme="light"] .tt .s2{opacity:1}
.avatar{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:var(--bg);background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--mint),var(--accent));cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.avatar:hover{transform:translateY(-1px) scale(1.04);box-shadow:0 8px 18px -6px rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.6)}

/* ─────────────────────────────  CONTENT  ───────────────────────────── */
.shell{padding:20px 26px 40px;max-width:1680px}
.eyebrow{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3)}

/* telemetry strip */
.strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.cell{grid-column:span 2;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:14px 15px 12px;border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s}
.cell:nth-child(1),.cell:nth-child(5){grid-column:span 3}
.cell:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.42)}
.cell::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s;
  background:radial-gradient(300px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%),var(--accent-soft),transparent 66%)}
.cell:hover::after{opacity:1}
.cell-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.cell-lab{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3)}
.delta{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono'}
.up{color:var(--mint);background:rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.11)}
.dn{color:var(--ember);background:rgba(var(--ember-rgb),.11)}
.val{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(22px,2.1vw,29px);letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1;
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:5px;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 88}
.val u{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:11px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink3);letter-spacing:0}
.spark{width:100%;height:26px;margin-top:7px;display:block;overflow:visible}
.cell.flash{animation:cellflash .7s ease}
@keyframes cellflash{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.45)}100%{box-shadow:var(--shadow)}}

/* grid */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:14px}
.panel{position:relative;border-radius:16px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  padding:16px 18px 18px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1),border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.panel:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.32)}
.panel::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s;
  background:radial-gradient(420px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%),var(--accent-soft),transparent 62%)}
.panel:hover::before{opacity:1}
.panel::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:14%;right:14%;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.55),transparent);opacity:.6}
.p8{grid-column:span 8}.p4{grid-column:span 4}.p7{grid-column:span 7}.p5{grid-column:span 5}
.phead{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.ptitle{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.028em;margin:3px 0 0;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 94}
.psub{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink3);margin:4px 0 0}

/* chart */
.tabs{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:4px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap}
.tab{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink3);font:600 11.5px/1 'IBM Plex Sans';padding:7px 11px;border-radius:7px;
  cursor:pointer;transition:.22s;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.01em}
.tab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.tab.on{background:var(--panel);color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 2px 10px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
html[data-theme="light"] .tab.on{box-shadow:0 2px 8px -4px rgba(20,35,70,.25),inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
.chartwrap{position:relative;height:322px;margin:-6px -6px 0}
.chart-svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;cursor:crosshair}
.gridline{stroke:var(--line2);stroke-width:1}
.axlab{fill:var(--ink3);font:500 10px 'IBM Plex Mono';letter-spacing:-.02em}
.nowline{stroke:rgba(var(--violet-rgb),.5);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:3 4}
.chline{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
#mainLine{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.4;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 12px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.45))}
#fcLine{stroke:var(--violet);stroke-width:2;stroke-dasharray:5 5;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 10px rgba(var(--violet-rgb),.35))}
#secLine{stroke:rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.62);stroke-width:1.5;stroke-dasharray:1 4}
#baseLine{stroke:var(--ink3);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:6 6;opacity:.55}
#area{fill:url(#areaGrad)}
#band{fill:url(#bandGrad);opacity:.85}
.hidden{display:none}
.marker{fill:none;stroke:var(--ember);stroke-width:1.6}
.marker-halo{fill:rgba(var(--ember-rgb),.18);animation:halo 2.4s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes halo{0%{r:5;opacity:.75}100%{r:15;opacity:0}}
#cross line{stroke:var(--ink2);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:2 3;opacity:.75}
#cross .pt{fill:var(--panel);stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.4}
#cross .pt2{fill:var(--panel);stroke:var(--violet);stroke-width:2}
#cross .pt3{fill:var(--panel);stroke:var(--mint);stroke-width:2}
.legend{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.lg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:.2s;padding:2px 0}
.lg:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.lg.off{opacity:.35;text-decoration:line-through}
.lg i{width:14px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block}
.insight{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:12px;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:11px;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(var(--violet-rgb),.1),rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.05));border:1px solid rgba(var(--violet-rgb),.24)}
.insight svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;margin-top:1px;stroke:var(--violet);fill:none;stroke-width:1.7}
.insight p{margin:0;font-size:12.3px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.55}
.insight b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.insight .tag{font:700 9.5px/1 'IBM Plex Mono';letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--violet);text-transform:uppercase}
.chips{display:flex;gap:5px}
.chip{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--ink3);font:600 10.5px/1 'IBM Plex Mono';
  padding:6px 9px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;letter-spacing:.02em}
.chip:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.5)}
.chip.on{background:var(--accent);color:var(--bg);border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 5px 16px -6px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.85)}

/* anomaly stream */
.stream{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;max-height:400px;overflow:auto;padding-right:4px}
.stream::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}.stream::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--line);border-radius:4px}
.ev{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:start;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:11px;
  background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line2);cursor:pointer;transition:.25s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ev:hover{transform:translateX(3px);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4)}
.ev.new{animation:slidein .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)}
@keyframes slidein{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.97);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.16)}}
.ev.gone{opacity:0;transform:translateX(26px);height:0;padding:0;margin:-4px 0;border-width:0}
.sev{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-top:5px;flex:none}
.s-crit{background:var(--ember);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(var(--ember-rgb),.85)}
.s-warn{background:var(--violet);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(var(--violet-rgb,.7))}
.s-warn{box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(var(--violet-rgb),.7)}
.s-info{background:var(--mint);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.6)}
.ev h4{margin:0;font-size:12.4px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.ev p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.45}
.ev .cf{font:600 10px/1 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--ink2);padding:3px 6px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.ev em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:10.5px}

/* heatmap */
.hm{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.hm-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.hm-lab{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;font:500 9.5px/16.6px 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--ink3)}
.hm-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(24,1fr);gap:3px}
.hm-cell{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:3px;transition:transform .16s,box-shadow .16s;cursor:pointer}
.hm-cell:hover{transform:scale(1.42);box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--ink);z-index:5;position:relative}
.hm-x{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(24,1fr);gap:3px;margin-top:8px;font:500 9px 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--ink3);text-align:center}
.hm-legend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;font:500 10px 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--ink3)}
.hm-bar{height:7px;flex:1;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1b2740,var(--mint),var(--ember))}
html[data-theme="light"] .hm-bar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#cfd8ea,var(--mint),var(--ember))}

/* donut */
.donut-wrap{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.donut{position:relative;width:190px;height:190px;flex:none}
.donut svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.donut circle{fill:none;stroke-linecap:butt;cursor:pointer;transition:stroke-width .28s,opacity .28s}
.donut circle:hover{stroke-width:24}
.donut.dim circle{opacity:.28}
.donut.dim circle.hot{opacity:1}
.donut-c{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-content:center;text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
.donut-c b{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:800;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.045em;display:block;line-height:1.1}
.donut-c span{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3);font-weight:600}
.dlist{flex:1;min-width:150px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.di{display:grid;grid-template-columns:9px 1fr auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;padding:3px 5px;border-radius:7px;transition:.2s}
.di:hover{background:var(--panel2)}
.di i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px}
.di span{font-size:11.8px;font-weight:500}
.di u{font:600 11px 'IBM Plex Mono';text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink2)}

/* fleet */
.fleet{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.fi{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 62px;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:11px;
  background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line2);transition:.25s;cursor:pointer}
.fi:hover{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.45);transform:translateX(3px)}
.fi-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.fi-name{font:600 12.2px 'IBM Plex Mono';letter-spacing:-.02em}
.fi-v{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--ink3);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.st{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;margin-left:auto}
.st.ok{background:var(--mint);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.8)}
.st.deg{background:var(--ember);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(var(--ember-rgb),.8)}
.st.sched{background:var(--ink3)}
.bar{height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line);overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--mint));
  transition:width 1.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1)}
.fi-r{text-align:right}
.fi-r b{font:700 13px 'Bricolage Grotesque';display:block;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.fi-r span{font-size:9px;color:var(--ink3);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}

/* log */
.term{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;height:224px;overflow:auto;
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:11.3px;line-height:1.75;position:relative}
.term::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}.term::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--line);border-radius:4px}
.term .ln{display:grid;grid-template-columns:66px 52px 1fr;gap:10px;opacity:0;animation:fadein .4s forwards}
@keyframes fadein{to{opacity:1}}
.term .t{color:var(--ink3)}
.term .lv{font-weight:600}
.lv.INFO{color:var(--accent)}.lv.WARN{color:var(--ember)}.lv.OK{color:var(--mint)}.lv.TRACE{color:var(--violet)}
.term .m{color:var(--ink2);word-break:break-all}
.term .m b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.cur{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:13px;background:var(--mint);animation:blink 1.05s steps(2) infinite;vertical-align:-2px}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
.termbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.tbtn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--ink2);border-radius:7px;padding:5px 10px;
  font:600 10.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.tbtn:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb,.5))}
.tbtn:hover{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.5)}
.tbtn.on{color:var(--mint);border-color:rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.4);background:rgba(var(--mint-rgb),.08)}

/* gauge */
.gauge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.gring{position:relative;width:118px;height:118px;flex:none}
.gring svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(135deg)}
.gring circle{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round}
.gtrack{stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:9}
.gval{stroke:url(#gGrad);stroke-width:9;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.gring-c{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-content:center;text-align:center}
.gring-c b{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:800;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.05em;display:block;line-height:1}
.gring-c span{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--ink3);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.gstats{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.gs{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line2)}
.gs:last-child{border:0;padding:0}
.gs span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
.gs b{font:700 14px 'Bricolage Grotesque';letter-spacing:-.03em}

/* float tooltip */
#tip{position:fixed;z-index:80;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-118%) scale(.94);
  transition:opacity .14s,transform .14s;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:9px 11px;border-radius:9px;
  box-shadow:0 18px 40px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.7);min-width:150px}
#tip.on{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-112%) scale(1)}
#tip .h{font:700 9.5px/1 'IBM Plex Mono';letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.6;margin-bottom:6px}
#tip .r{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.7}
#tip .r b{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-weight:600}
#tip .r i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block;margin-right:5px}

/* command palette */
.cmdk{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;display:none;place-items:start center;padding-top:14vh}
.cmdk.on{display:grid}
.cmdk-bd{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(2,4,9,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);animation:fadein .2s}
.cmdk-box{position:relative;width:min(560px,92vw);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;
  box-shadow:0 40px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.8);overflow:hidden;animation:pop .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2)}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.97)}}
.cmdk-in{width:100%;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:500 15px 'IBM Plex Sans';padding:17px 18px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.cmdk-in::placeholder{color:var(--ink3)}
.cmdk-list{max-height:290px;overflow:auto;padding:7px}
.ci{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;transition:.12s}
.ci.sel{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.35)}
.ci svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:var(--ink3);fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;flex:none}
.ci kbd{margin-left:auto}
.cmdk-foot{padding:9px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;gap:14px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink3)}

/* reveal */
.has-js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}
.has-js .rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:opacity .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1),transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)}

.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-top:22px;padding-top:16px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);font:500 10.5px 'IBM Plex Mono';color:var(--ink3);flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot b{color:var(--ink2);font-weight:500}

/* view transition */
::view-transition-old(root),::view-transition-new(root){animation:none;mix-blend-mode:normal}
::view-transition-old(root){z-index:1}::view-transition-new(root){z-index:9}

@media(max-width:1320px){.p8,.p7{grid-column:span 12}.p4,.p5{grid-column:span 6}.cell:nth-child(1),.cell:nth-child(5){grid-column:span 3}}
@media(max-width:960px){.strip{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}.cell,.cell:nth-child(1),.cell:nth-child(5){grid-column:span 3}
 .p4,.p5{grid-column:span 12}.chartwrap{height:260px}.search{min-width:auto}.search kbd{display:none}.crumb{display:none}}
@media(max-width:680px){.rail{width:58px}.main{margin-left:58px}.shell,.topbar{padding-left:14px;padding-right:14px}
 .clock,.envchip{display:none}.nb{width:42px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
</style>
</head>

              <g id="cross" class="hidden"><line id="cv"></line><circle id="cp1" class="pt" r="4.5"></circle><circle id="cp2" class="pt2" r="4"></circle><circle id="cp3" class="pt3" r="3.5"></circle></g>

              <p class="psub">Darker cells = elevated tail latency against the rolling baseline</p>
            </div>
            <div class="chips"><button class="chip on">p95</button><button class="chip">p50</button><button class="chip">p99</button></div>
          </div>
          <div class="hm">
            <div class="hm-lab" id="hmLab"></div>
            <div>
              <div class="hm-rows"><div class="hm-grid" id="hmGrid"></div></div>

        <!-- DONUT -->

                <circle class="gval" id="gval" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" stroke-dasharray="235.6 314.2" stroke-dashoffset="235.6"/>

              <div class="gs"><span>Guardrail blocks</span><b class="mono" style="color:var(--ember)">1,206</b></div>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const RM = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const cssv = n => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(n).trim();
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}

/* ─── THEME ─── */
const root=document.documentElement;
function applyTheme(t){root.setAttribute('data-theme',t);try{localStorage.setItem('nexus-theme',t)}catch(e){}}
$('#themeToggle').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const next = root.getAttribute('data-theme')==='dark'?'light':'dark';
  const x=e.clientX||innerWidth-60, y=e.clientY||40;
  if(document.startViewTransition && !RM){
    const vt=document.startViewTransition(()=>applyTheme(next));
    vt.ready.then(()=>{
      const r=Math.hypot(Math.max(x,innerWidth-x),Math.max(y,innerHeight-y));
      root.animate({clipPath:[`circle(0px at ${x}px ${y}px)`,`circle(${r}px at ${x}px ${y}px)`]},
        {duration:620,easing:'cubic-bezier(.5,0,.2,1)',pseudoElement:'::view-transition-new(root)'});
    });
  } else applyTheme(next);
  setTimeout(()=>{Chart.recolor();HM.paint();Donut.build();paintSparks()},60);
});

/* ─── CLOCK ─── */
setInterval(()=>{const d=new Date();$('#clock').innerHTML=d.toISOString().slice(11,19)+' <b>UTC</b>'},1000);

/* ─── CURSOR SPOTLIGHT ─── */
document.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  const p=e.target.closest('.panel,.cell'); if(!p)return;
  const r=p.getBoundingClientRect();
  p.style.setProperty('--mx',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100)+'%');
  p.style.setProperty('--my',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100)+'%');
},{passive:true});

/* ─── NAV PILL ─── */
const navBtns=$$('.nb'), pill=$('#pill');
function movePill(b){const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(),pr=b.parentNode.getBoundingClientRect();
  pill.style.height=r.height*0.55+'px';pill.style.transform=`translateY(${r.top-pr.top+(r.height*0.225)}px)`;}
navBtns.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{navBtns.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));b.classList.add('on');movePill(b)}));
requestAnimationFrame(()=>movePill($('.nb.on'))); addEventListener('resize',()=>movePill($('.nb.on')));

/* ═══════════════  CHART ENGINE  ═══════════════ */
const METRICS={
  accuracy:{label:'Eval accuracy',unit:'%',dec:2,base:96.4,vol:.32,drift:-.014,lo:86,hi:99.6,lower:false,
    insight:(d)=>`Forecast detects a <b>${d.toFixed(2)}σ downward drift</b> on <b>llama-405b-instruct</b> beginning 14:00 UTC. Eval set v7 shows −0.41% against control. Recommend re-alignment sweep.`},
  latency:{label:'p95 latency',unit:'ms',dec:0,base:312,vol:22,drift:.55,lo:120,hi:780,lower:true,
    insight:(d)=>`Tail latency is trending <b>+${Math.round(d)}ms</b> over 48h. Correlated with <b>kv-cache eviction spikes</b> on node pool <b>gpu-a3</b>. Autoscaler projected to engage in 3h 40m.`},
  cost:{label:'Cost / 1K tokens',unit:'$',dec:4,base:.0412,vol:.0031,drift:.00004,lo:.018,hi:.082,lower:true,
    insight:(d)=>`Blended unit cost rose <b>${(d*100).toFixed(1)}%</b>. Spot preemption of <b>8×H200</b> forced on-demand fallback for 11% of traffic.`},
  throughput:{label:'Token throughput',unit:' tok/s',dec:0,base:18400,vol:900,drift:12,lo:9000,hi:27000,lower:false,
    insight:(d)=>`Throughput holding at <b>${Math.round(18400+d).toLocaleString()} tok/s</b> aggregate. Speculative decoding acceptance improved 2.6 pts after the draft-model swap.`},
  halluc:{label:'Hallucination rate',unit:'%',dec:2,base:1.34,vol:.14,drift:.006,lo:.2,hi:4.2,lower:true,
    insight:(d)=>`Judge-model score crept <b>+${d.toFixed(2)}pt</b>. Long-context retrieval failures cluster in the <b>>64K window</b> cohort — grounding pipeline flagged.`}
};
const TOTAL=60, HIST=46, FC=TOTAL-HIST;
const RANGES={24:{step:'h',unit:'h',seed:11},7:{step:'h',unit:'h',seed:23},30:{step:'d',unit:'d',seed:37},90:{step:'d',unit:'d',seed:59}};

const Chart=(()=>{
  const svg=$('#chart'),g=$('#gridG'),yG=$('#yLabG'),xG=$('#xLabG'),mkG=$('#markers');
  const P={area:$('#area'),band:$('#band'),main:$('#mainLine'),fc:$('#fcLine'),sec:$('#secLine'),base:$('#baseLine')};
  let W=0,H=0,padL=8,padR=58,padT=18,padB=26;
  let key='accuracy',days=7,vis={main:true,fc:true,band:true,sec:true,base:true};
  let cur=null,tgt=null,anim=null,markers=[];

  function gen(k,d){
    const m=METRICS[k],rnd=mulberry32(RANGES[d].seed+k.length*7+m.base);
    const v=[],b=[],s=[],hi=[],lo=[]; let x=m.base, xs=m.base*.97, scale=(m.hi-m.lo);
    for(let i=0;i<TOTAL;i++){
      x += (rnd()-.5)*m.vol*1.6 + m.drift + (m.base-x)*.045;
      if(i>28&&i<36) x += (m.lower?1:-1)*scale*.035*Math.sin((i-28)/7*Math.PI);
      v.push(clamp(x,m.lo,m.hi));
      xs += (rnd()-.5)*m.vol*1.1 + (m.base*.97-xs)*.05; s.push(clamp(xs,m.lo,m.hi));
      b.push(m.base + Math.sin(i/9)*m.vol*.35);
    }
    let f=v[TOTAL-1];
    for(let i=0;i<TOTAL;i++){
      const t=i-(TOTAL-1);
      if(i>=HIST-1){ if(i>HIST-1) f += (m.base-f)*.06 + m.drift*2.4 + (rnd()-.5)*m.vol*.5;
        const spread = m.vol*(1.1+Math.max(0,t)*.26);
        hi.push(f+spread); lo.push(f-spread);
      } else { hi.push(v[i]); lo.push(v[i]); }
    }
    return {v,s,b,hi,lo};
  }
  const X=i=>padL+(W-padL-padR)*(i/(TOTAL-1));
  function domain(){
    let mn=Infinity,mx=-Infinity;

    if(vis.band){for(let i=HIST-1;i<TOTAL;i++){if(cur.hi[i]>mx)mx=cur.hi[i];if(cur.lo[i]<mn)mn=cur.lo[i];}}
    const p=(mx-mn)*.14||1; return [mn-p,mx+p*.06];
  }
  let D=[0,1]; const Y=v=>padT+(H-padT-padB)*(1-(v-D[0])/(D[1]-D[0]));

  function smooth(pts,t=.19){
    if(pts.length<2)return'';
    let d=`M${pts[0][0].toFixed(2)},${pts[0][1].toFixed(2)}`;
    for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++){
      const p0=pts[i-1]||pts[i],p1=pts[i],p2=pts[i+1],p3=pts[i+2]||p2;
      d+=`C${(p1[0]+(p2[0]-p0[0])*t).toFixed(2)},${(p1[1]+(p2[1]-p0[1])*t).toFixed(2)} ${(p2[0]-(p3[0]-p1[0])*t).toFixed(2)},${(p2[1]-(p3[1]-p1[1])*t).toFixed(2)} ${p2[0].toFixed(2)},${p2[1].toFixed(2)}`;
    } return d;
  }
  const slice=(a,i,j)=>a.slice(i,j).map((v,k)=>[X(i+k),Y(v)]);

  function paint(){
    if(!W)return;
    D=domain();
    const v=cur.v;
    P.main.setAttribute('d',smooth(slice(v,0,HIST)));
    P.area.setAttribute('d',smooth(slice(v,0,HIST))+`L${X(HIST-1)},${H-padB}L${X(0)},${H-padB}Z`);
    P.fc.setAttribute('d',smooth(slice(v,HIST-1,TOTAL)));
    P.sec.setAttribute('d',smooth(slice(cur.s,0,TOTAL)));
    P.base.setAttribute('d',smooth(slice(cur.b,0,TOTAL)));
    P.band.setAttribute('d',smooth(slice(cur.hi,HIST-1,TOTAL)).replace('M','M')+
      'L'+slice(cur.lo,HIST-1,TOTAL).reverse().map(p=>p[0].toFixed(2)+','+p[1].toFixed(2)).join('L')+'Z');
    Object.keys(vis).forEach(k=>{ if(k!=='main')P[k].classList.toggle('hidden',!vis[k]); });
    // grid + axes
    g.innerHTML='';yG.innerHTML='';xG.innerHTML='';
    const m=METRICS[key];
    for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){
      const val=D[0]+(D[1]-D[0])*(i/4), y=Y(val);
      g.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<line class="gridline" x1="${padL}" x2="${W-padR+8}" y1="${y.toFixed(1)}" y2="${y.toFixed(1)}"/>`);
      yG.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<text class="axlab" x="${W-padR+13}" y="${(y+3.5).toFixed(1)}">${fmt(val,m)}</text>`);
    }
    const span=(TOTAL-1)*(days*24/60);
    for(let i=0;i<TOTAL;i+=10){
      const back=Math.round((HIST-1-i)*(days*24/(TOTAL-1)));
      const lab = i<HIST-1 ? (back===0?'now':'-'+back+'h') : '+'+Math.round((i-(HIST-1))*(days*24/(TOTAL-1)))+'h';
      xG.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<text class="axlab" x="${X(i).toFixed(1)}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle">${lab}</text>`);
    }
    const nx=X(HIST-1);
    $('#nowLine').setAttribute('x1',nx);$('#nowLine').setAttribute('x2',nx);
    $('#nowLine').setAttribute('y1',padT-6);$('#nowLine').setAttribute('y2',H-padB);
    $('#clipRect').setAttribute('x',padL-2);$('#clipRect').setAttribute('y',0);
    $('#clipRect').setAttribute('width',W-padL-padR+12);$('#clipRect').setAttribute('height',H);
    // markers
    mkG.innerHTML=markers.map(i=>`<circle class="marker-halo" cx="${X(i)}" cy="${Y(v[i])}" r="5"/><circle class="marker" cx="${X(i)}" cy="${Y(v[i])}" r="4"/>`).join('');
    $('#insight').innerHTML=METRICS[key].insight(Math.abs(cur.v[TOTAL-1]-cur.v[HIST-1])/(METRICS[key].vol||1));
  }
  function fmt(v,m){
    if(m.unit==='$')return '$'+v.toFixed(m.dec);
    if(m.unit.includes('tok'))return (v/1000).toFixed(1)+'k';
    return v.toFixed(m.dec)+(m.unit==='%'?'%':'');
  }
  function tween(to){
    if(!cur){cur=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(to));paint();return}
    const from=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cur)); tgt=to; const t0=performance.now(),dur=RM?0:760;
    cancelAnimationFrame(anim);
    (function step(t){
      const p=dur?clamp((t-t0)/dur,0,1):1, e=p<.5?4*p*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,3)/2;
      ['v','s','b','hi','lo'].forEach(k=>{cur[k]=from[k].map((x,i)=>x+(tgt[k][i]-x)*e)});
      paint(); if(p<1)anim=requestAnimationFrame(step);
    })(t0);
  }
  function set(k,d){
    key=k; days=d||days;
    const to=gen(key,days);
    markers=[12+Math.floor(mulberry32(days+k.length)()*4), 24, 31].filter(i=>i<HIST-2);
    tween(to);
  }
  function measure(){
    const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect(); W=r.width;H=r.height; paint();
  }
  new ResizeObserver(measure).observe(svg);

  /* hover */
  const cross=$('#cross'),tip=$('#tip');
  svg.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(!W)return;
    const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const i=clamp(Math.round(((e.clientX-r.left)-padL)/(W-padL-padR)*(TOTAL-1)),0,TOTAL-1);
    const x=X(i),y=Y(cur.v[i]);
    cross.classList.remove('hidden');
    $('#cv').setAttribute('x1',x);$('#cv').setAttribute('x2',x);$('#cv').setAttribute('y1',padT-6);$('#cv').setAttribute('y2',H-padB);
    $('#cp1').setAttribute('cx',x);$('#cp1').setAttribute('cy',y);
    $('#cp2').setAttribute('cx',x);$('#cp2').setAttribute('cy',Y(cur.s[i]));
    $('#cp3').setAttribute('cx',x);$('#cp3').setAttribute('cy',Y(cur.b[i]));
    const m=METRICS[key],future=i>=HIST-1;
    const back=Math.round((HIST-1-i)*(days*24/(TOTAL-1)));
    const when = future?`forecast +${Math.round((i-(HIST-1))*(days*24/(TOTAL-1)))}h`:(back===0?'now':`${back}h ago`);
    tip.innerHTML=`<div class="h">${m.label} · ${when}</div>
      <div class="r"><span><i style="background:var(--accent)"></i>${future?'predicted':'observed'}</span><b>${fmt(cur.v[i],m)}</b></div>
      <div class="r"><span><i style="background:var(--mint)"></i>control</span><b>${fmt(cur.s[i],m)}</b></div>
      <div class="r"><span><i style="background:var(--ink3)"></i>baseline</span><b>${fmt(cur.b[i],m)}</b></div>
      ${future?`<div class="r"><span><i style="background:var(--violet)"></i>90% CI</span><b>${fmt(cur.lo[i],m)} – ${fmt(cur.hi[i],m)}</b></div>`:''}`;
    tip.classList.add('on');
    tip.style.left=clamp(r.left+x,120,innerWidth-120)+'px';
    tip.style.top=(r.top+y)+'px';
  });
  svg.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{cross.classList.add('hidden');tip.classList.remove('on')});

  function recolor(){paint()}
  return {set,recolor,vis,key:()=>key,days:()=>days};
})();

$('#pauseBtn').onclick=e=>{paused=!paused;e.currentTarget.classList.toggle('on',!paused);
  e.currentTarget.textContent=paused?'▶ resume':'❚❚ pause stream'};
$('#clearBtn').onclick=()=>{term.innerHTML='';lines=0;$('#logCount').textContent='0 lines'};

/* ═══════════════  REVEAL + GAUGE + BARS  ═══════════════ */
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.08});
$$('.rv').forEach((p,i)=>{p.style.transitionDelay=(i%6)*60+'ms';io.observe(p)});
const bio=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){
  $$('.bar i',e.target).forEach(b=>b.style.width=b.dataset.u+'%');
  $$('.bar i').forEach(b=>{if(b.closest('.fi')===e.target)b.style.width=b.dataset.u+'%'});
  bio.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.3});
$$('.fi').forEach(f=>bio.observe(f));
setTimeout(()=>{
  const pct=94.2,circ=235.6;
  $('#gval').setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset',circ*(1-pct/100));
  const el=$('#gv');let n=0;const iv=setInterval(()=>{n+=1.4;if(n>=pct){n=pct;clearInterval(iv)}el.textContent=n.toFixed(1)},18);
},700);

/* ═══════════════  COMMAND PALETTE  ═══════════════ */
const CMDS=[
  ['Switch to light theme','⇧T',()=>$('#themeToggle').click()],
  ['Open model registry','',()=>toast('Model registry · 42 models')],
  ['Inspect latest eval run','',()=>toast('eval-suite v7-mmlu-pro · 96.41%')],
  ['Rollback nexus-405b','',()=>toast('Rollback queued · v3.0 ← v3.1')],
  ['Create alert rule','',()=>toast('New alert: p95 > 600ms / 5m')],
  ['Export trace waterfall','',()=>toast('trace_8f2ac41.nexus exported')],
  ['Scale gpu-a3 pool','',()=>toast('Scaling group gpu-a3 → 24 replicas')],
  ['View cost attribution','',()=>Chart.set('cost')]
];
const cmdk=$('#cmdk'),list=$('#cmdkList'),inp=$('#cmdkIn');let sel=0;
function renderList(q=''){
  const f=CMDS.filter(c=>c[0].toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));
  list.innerHTML=f.map((c,i)=>`<div class="ci${i===sel?' sel':''}" data-i="${CMDS.indexOf(c)}">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>${c[0]}${c[1]?`<kbd>${c[1]}</kbd>`:''}</div>`).join('')||
    '<div style="padding:18px;color:var(--ink3);font-size:12.5px">No matches</div>';
  [...list.children].forEach(el=>{el.onmouseenter=()=>{sel=+el.dataset.i;renderList(inp.value)};
    el.onclick=()=>{CMDS[+el.dataset.i][2]();close()}});
}
function open(){cmdk.classList.add('on');inp.value='';sel=0;renderList();setTimeout(()=>inp.focus(),30)}
function close(){cmdk.classList.remove('on')}
$('#searchBtn').onclick=open;
$$('[data-close]').forEach(e=>e.onclick=close);
inp.oninput=()=>{sel=0;renderList(inp.value)};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='k'){e.preventDefault();cmdk.classList.contains('on')?close():open()}
  if(!cmdk.classList.contains('on'))return;
  const items=[...list.children];
  if(e.key==='Escape')close();
  if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();
    sel=clamp(sel+(e.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1),0,Math.max(0,items.length-1));renderList(inp.value);
    list.children[sel]?.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'})}
  if(e.key==='Enter'&&CMDS[+items[sel]?.dataset.i]){CMDS[+items[sel].dataset.i][2]();close()}
});
function toast(m){
  const t=document.createElement('div');
  t.textContent=m;t.style.cssText='position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);z-index:120;'+
    'background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:11px 18px;border-radius:11px;font:600 12.5px "IBM Plex Sans";'+
    'box-shadow:0 20px 44px -16px rgba(0,0,0,.6);opacity:0;transition:.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2)';
  document.body.appendChild(t);requestAnimationFrame(()=>{t.style.opacity=1;t.style.transform='translateX(-50%) translateY(0)'});
  setTimeout(()=>{t.style.opacity=0;t.style.transform='translateX(-50%) translateY(12px)';setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),400)},2200);
}
$('#bell').onclick=()=>toast('7 active alerts · 2 critical, 3 warning');
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<style>
/* ============================== TOKENS ============================== */
:root{
