.stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}

[data-reveal]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);transition:opacity .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);transition-delay:var(--d,0ms)}
[data-reveal].is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ============================== HERO CHART ============================== */
.hero{grid-column:span 8;background:
  radial-gradient(34rem 20rem at var(--mx,60%) var(--my,0%),var(--accent-soft),transparent 70%),
  var(--surface)}
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:linear-gradient(var(--grid-line) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:100% 60px;opacity:.6}
.hero-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px;padding:18px 20px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative}
.hero-h h2{font-size:clamp(20px,2.3vw,27px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.05;margin-top:5px}
.hero-h h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent)}
.legend{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--surface-2);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-3);transition:.22s;user-select:none}
.chip i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--c);opacity:.3;transition:.22s}
.chip.on{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line-2);background:var(--surface)}
.chip.on i{opacity:1}
.chip:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.chip span{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:10px;color:var(--ink-3)}

.statband{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--surface-2);position:relative;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stat{padding:14px 20px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);flex:1 1 auto;min-width:120px}
.stat:last-child{border-right:none}
.stat.lead{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:210px;background:var(--surface)}
.stat .k{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3);display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.stat .v{font-family:var(--ff-d);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stat.lead .v{font-size:clamp(34px,4.2vw,48px)}
.stat:not(.lead) .v{font-size:22px}
.stat .v small{font-size:.45em;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--ink-3);margin-left:3px}
.delta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;
  padding:2px 6px;border-radius:5px;margin-top:6px}
.delta.up{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}
.delta.dn{color:var(--coral);background:var(--coral-soft)}
.delta.flat{color:var(--ink-3);background:var(--surface-3)}
.stat .note{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink-3);margin-top:5px}

.chart-wrap{position:relative;padding:6px 4px 0}
#chart{display:block;width:100%;height:326px;touch-action:none}
#chart .gl{stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:1}
#chart .gl.zero{stroke:var(--line-2)}
#chart text{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9.5px;fill:var(--ink-3);letter-spacing:.06em}
.series-line{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:opacity .35s}
.series-area{transition:opacity .45s}
.cross-l{stroke:var(--ink-3);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:2 3;opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s}
.cross-d{opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s}
.hovering .cross-l,.hovering .cross-d{opacity:1}
.tip{position:absolute;top:10px;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px);transition:opacity .16s,transform .16s;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:11px;padding:9px 11px;min-width:158px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift);z-index:5}
.tip.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
.tip .t-h{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3);
  padding-bottom:6px;margin-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tip .t-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11.5px;padding:2px 0}
.tip .t-r i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--c);flex:none}
.tip .t-r b{margin-left:auto;font-family:var(--ff-m);font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tip .t-r span{color:var(--ink-2)}
.anot{position:absolute;font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--coral);background:var(--coral-soft);border:1px solid var(--coral-soft);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:5px;
  pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.anot.show{opacity:1}
.chart-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:8px 20px 16px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap}
.chart-foot .fm{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:10px;color:var(--ink-3);letter-spacing:.06em}
.chart-foot .fm b{color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:600}

/* ============================== SIDE PANELS ============================== */
.donut-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.donut{width:132px;height:132px;flex:none}
.donut circle{fill:none;stroke-width:13;stroke-linecap:butt;transition:stroke-dasharray 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),opacity .2s,stroke-width .2s}
.donut circle:hover{stroke-width:16}
.donut-c{font-family:var(--ff-d);font-size:19px;font-weight:700;fill:var(--ink);text-anchor:middle}
.donut-s{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:7.4px;letter-spacing:.18em;fill:var(--ink-3);text-anchor:middle}
.rlist{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;min-width:0}
.rlist li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:6px 7px;border-radius:8px;list-style:none;transition:.2s;font-size:12.4px}
.rlist li:hover{background:var(--surface-2);transform:translateX(2px)}
.rlist i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2.5px;background:var(--c);flex:none}
.rlist .nm{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:11.5px;flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.rlist .pc{font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:12.5px}
.rlist .rq{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:10px;color:var(--ink-3);width:52px;text-align:right}

.bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.bar-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:76px 1fr 54px;align-items:center;gap:11px}
.bar-row .rg{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink-2);letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap}
.bar-tr{height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surface-3);overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.bar-fl{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:0;border-radius:99px;background:var(--c);transition:width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.bar-fl::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.45),transparent);
  transform:translateX(-100%);animation:sheen 3.4s infinite}
@keyframes sheen{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}55%,100%{transform:translateX(220%)}}
.bar-row .vl{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:10.5px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink-2)}

.media{position:relative;margin:0 18px 18px;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface-3);aspect-ratio:16/9}
.media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.08);
  animation:kb 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate;filter:saturate(.7) contrast(1.06)}
[data-theme="dark"] .media img{filter:saturate(.85) contrast(1.08) brightness(.86)}
@keyframes kb{0%{transform:scale(1.06) translate(0,0)}100%{transform:scale(1.19) translate(-2.5%,-2%)}}
.media .scan{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--accent),transparent);
  box-shadow:0 0 14px 2px var(--accent-soft);animation:scan 4.6s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.4,1) infinite}
@keyframes scan{0%{top:6%;opacity:0}12%{opacity:1}88%{opacity:1}100%{top:94%;opacity:0}}
.media .ov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 40%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 88%,transparent));
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding:12px}
.media .ov b{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-2)}
.media .ov span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.box-tag{position:absolute;top:11px;left:11px;font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:3px 7px;border-radius:5px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 76%,transparent);border:1px solid var(--line);
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);color:var(--accent)}

/* ============================== EVENTS ============================== */
.feed{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0 8px 10px}
.ev{display:grid;grid-template-columns:15px 1fr auto;gap:11px;padding:10px 10px;border-radius:10px;align-items:start;
  transition:background .2s,opacity .4s,transform .45s;position:relative}
.ev:hover{background:var(--surface-2)}
.ev.new{animation:evIn .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
@keyframes evIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px) scale(.98);background:var(--accent-soft)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.ev .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;margin-top:6px;background:var(--c);position:relative}
.ev .dot::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-4px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--c);opacity:0;animation:ring 2.6s infinite}
@keyframes ring{0%{opacity:.6;transform:scale(.6)}70%,100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.5)}}
.ev .tx{font-size:12.6px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink-2)}
.ev .tx b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.ev .tx code{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:11px;background:var(--surface-3);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;color:var(--ink)}
.ev .ts{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9.5px;color:var(--ink-3);white-space:nowrap;padding-top:3px}

/* ============================== BUDGET ============================== */
.budget{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:9px;margin-bottom:3px}
.budget b{font-family:var(--ff-d);font-size:30px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.budget span{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.btrack{height:7px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surface-3);position:relative;margin:11px 0 6px;overflow:hidden}
.btrack i{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:0;border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--amber));transition:width 1.5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) .3s}
.btrack .mark{position:absolute;top:-3px;bottom:-3px;width:2px;background:var(--coral);left:78%}
.sstack{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:78px;margin-top:14px}
.sstack .col{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;justify-content:flex-end;height:100%;border-radius:3px;
  overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s,filter .25s;cursor:default}
.sstack .col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);filter:brightness(1.12)}
.sstack .segm{width:100%;background:var(--c);height:0;transition:height .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.slabels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9px;color:var(--ink-3);margin-top:6px}
.keys{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:11px;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.keys span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.keys i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--c)}

/* ============================== TEAM ============================== */
.team{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:0 10px 12px}
.tm{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px;border-radius:10px;transition:.22s}
.tm:hover{background:var(--surface-2);transform:translateX(3px)}
.tm img{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px}
.tm .info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.tm .info b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600}
.tm .info span{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-3);display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.tm .st{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);flex:none}

/* ============================== TABLE ============================== */
.tbl-tools{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;padding:0 18px 12px}
.fchip{padding:5px 11px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-3);transition:.2s;background:var(--surface-2)}
.fchip:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.fchip.on{background:var(--ink);color:var(--surface);border-color:var(--ink)}
[data-theme="dark"] .fchip.on{background:var(--accent);color:#0B1113;border-color:var(--accent)}
.fchip b{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9.5px;opacity:.7;margin-left:4px}
.tscroll{overflow-x:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.7px}
th{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3);
  text-align:left;padding:9px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--surface-2);white-space:nowrap;position:sticky;top:0}
th[data-sort]{cursor:pointer;transition:color .2s;user-select:none}
th[data-sort]:hover{color:var(--ink)}
th .ar{opacity:0;font-size:8px;margin-left:3px;transition:.2s}
th.sorted .ar{opacity:1}
td{padding:11px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:middle}
tbody tr{transition:background .18s,box-shadow .18s}
tbody tr:hover{background:var(--surface-2);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent)}
tbody tr.out{animation:rowOut .3s ease forwards}
@keyframes rowOut{to{opacity:0}}
td.num{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right;color:var(--ink-2)}
td.id{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink)}
.mdl{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:11px;padding:2.5px 8px;
  border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface-3);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.mdl i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--c)}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--c);color:var(--c);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 10%,transparent)}
.pill i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c)}
.spark{display:block}
.empty{padding:34px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink-3);font-size:13px}
.empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--ff-d);font-size:16px;color:var(--ink-2);margin-bottom:4px}

/* ============================== TICKER ============================== */
.ticker{grid-column:span 12;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--surface-2);padding:9px 14px;overflow:hidden}
.ticker .tag{font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);
  flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.ticker .tag i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);animation:blip 2s infinite}
.tk-view{overflow:hidden;flex:1;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 4%,#000 96%,transparent)}
.tk-run{display:flex;gap:34px;width:max-content;animation:run 46s linear infinite;font-family:var(--ff-m);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.tk-run b{color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:500}
.tk-run em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent)}
.tk-run .w{color:var(--amber)}
.tk-run .c{color:var(--coral)}
@keyframes run{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

.scrim{display:none}
/* ============================== RESPONSIVE ============================== */
@media(max-width:1240px){
  .hero,.col-8{grid-column:span 12}
  .col-4{grid-column:span 6}
  .col-5{grid-column:span 12}
  .side-2{grid-column:span 6}
}
@media(max-width:980px){
  .shell{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .rail{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:262px;z-index:200;transform:translateX(-104%);
    transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.15,1);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift)}
  body.nav-open .rail{transform:none}
  body.nav-open .scrim{display:block;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:150;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg-2) 70%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
  .col-4,.side-2,.col-3{grid-column:span 12}
  .stat.lead{min-width:100%;border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .content{padding:16px 14px 30px;gap:14px}
  .topbar{padding:12px 14px}
  .search{display:none}
  #chart{height:250px}
  .donut-row{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .donut{align-self:center}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}
  [data-reveal]{opacity:1;transform:none}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="ambient" id="ambient"></div>
<div class="grain"></div>
<div class="scrim" id="scrim"></div>

<div class="shell" id="shell">
  <!-- ======================= RAIL ======================= -->
  <aside class="rail">
    <div class="brand">
      <div class="mark" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M5 4c0 6 14 4 14 10S5 18 5 20" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M19 4c0 6-14 4-14 10s14 4 14 6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".5"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="brand-txt"><b>helix</b><span>console</span></div>
      <button class="icon-btn" id="railToggle" title="Collapse navigation" style="margin-left:auto">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h10M4 18h16"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>

    <button class="ws" title="Switch workspace">
      <span class="ws-dot"></span>
      <span class="ws-txt"><b>Atlas Research</b><small>prod · us-east</small></span>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>
    </button>

    <nav>
      <div class="nav-group"><span>Monitor</span>
        <button class="nav-item on"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 13h4l3 8 4-16 3 8h4"/></svg><span class="lbl">Overview</span></button>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 20V10M10 20V4M16 20v-7M22 20H2"/></svg><span class="lbl">Analytics</span><span class="badge">L2</span></button>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v4M12 18v4M2 12h4M18 12h4M5 5l2.5 2.5M16.5 16.5L19 19M19 5l-2.5 2.5M7.5 16.5L5 19"/></svg><span class="lbl">Models</span><span class="badge">7</span></button>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h16M4 9h10M4 13h16M4 17h7"/></svg><span class="lbl">Inference logs</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="nav-group"><span>Build</span>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><ellipse cx="12" cy="6" rx="8" ry="3"/><path d="M4 6v12c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3V6M4 12c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3"/></svg><span class="lbl">Datasets</span></button>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3l7 4v10l-7 4-7-4V7z"/><path d="M12 12l7-4M12 12v9M12 12L5 8"/></svg><span class="lbl">Fine-tunes</span><span class="badge">3</span></button>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 11l3 3 6-7"/><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/></svg><span class="lbl">Evals</span></button>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h11M4 17h6"/><circle cx="19" cy="17" r="2"/></svg><span class="lbl">Prompts</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="nav-group"><span>Operate</span>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3v13M7 11l5 5 5-5"/><path d="M4 20h16"/></svg><span class="lbl">Deployments</span></button>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M2 10h20M6 15h4"/></svg><span class="lbl">Billing</span></button>
        <button class="nav-item"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.2"/><path d="M3 20c0-3.3 2.7-6 6-6s6 2.7 6 6"/><path d="M17 11l2 2 3-3.5"/></svg><span class="lbl">Access</span></button>
      </div>
    </nav>

    <div class="rail-foot">
      <div class="meter-wrap">
        <div class="meter-top"><span>Context cache</span><span>68.4%</span></div>
        <div class="meter"><i id="cacheMeter"></i></div>

<script>
(() => {
'use strict';
const RM = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const $ = (s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s), $$=(s,r=document)=>[...r.querySelectorAll(s)];
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const SVGNS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

/* ---------------- deterministic noise ---------------- */
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
const hash=s=>{let h=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){h^=s.charCodeAt(i);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return h>>>0};

/* ---------------- theme ---------------- */
const root=document.documentElement;
try{const saved=localStorage.getItem('helix-theme');
  root.dataset.theme = saved || (matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches?'dark':'light');
}catch(e){}
const sw=$('#themeSw');
const syncTheme=()=>sw.setAttribute('aria-checked', root.dataset.theme==='dark');
syncTheme();
sw.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  root.dataset.theme = root.dataset.theme==='dark'?'light':'dark';
  try{localStorage.setItem('helix-theme',root.dataset.theme)}catch(e){}
  syncTheme(); drawChart(false);
});

/* ---------------- rail ---------------- */
$('#railToggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  $('#shell').classList.toggle('rail-collapsed');
  setTimeout(()=>drawChart(false),400);
});
const mq=matchMedia('(max-width:980px)');
function navMode(){ $('#menuBtn').style.display = mq.matches?'grid':'none'; if(!mq.matches) document.body.classList.remove('nav-open'); }
mq.addEventListener('change',navMode); navMode();
$('#menuBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>document.body.classList.toggle('nav-open'));
$('#scrim').addEventListener('click',()=>document.body.classList.remove('nav-open'));
$$('.nav-item').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{$$('.nav-item').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));b.classList.add('on')}));

/* ---------------- condensed topbar ---------------- */
const topbar=$('#topbar');
addEventListener('scroll',()=>topbar.classList.toggle('condensed',scrollY>10),{passive:true});

/* ---------------- ambient parallax + hero spotlight ---------------- */
if(!RM){
  let raf=0;
  addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(raf) return;
    raf=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
      raf=0;
      const x=(e.clientX/innerWidth-.5), y=(e.clientY/innerHeight-.5);
      $('#ambient').style.transform=`translate(${x*-16}px,${y*-12}px)`;
      const hero=$('#hero'), r=hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(e.clientY>r.top&&e.clientY<r.bottom){
        hero.style.setProperty('--mx',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100).toFixed(1)+'%');
        hero.style.setProperty('--my',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100).toFixed(1)+'%');
      }
    });
  },{passive:true});
}

/* ================= CHART DATA MODEL ================= */
const RANGES={
  '24h':{n:48, step:30*60e3, label:'last 24 hours', every:6, fmt:'clock', live:true},
  '7d' :{n:42, step:4*3600e3, label:'last 7 days',   every:6, fmt:'day'},
  '30d':{n:30, step:24*3600e3,label:'last 30 days',  every:5, fmt:'date'},
  '90d':{n:45, step:2*864e5,  label:'last 90 days',  every:7, fmt:'date'}
};
const SERIES=[
  {id:'tokens', name:'Tokens',      c:'var(--accent)', unit:'M',  primary:true, w:2.5, area:true},
  {id:'latency',name:'p50 latency', c:'var(--amber)',  unit:'ms', w:1.7, dash:'6 5'},
  {id:'spend',  name:'Spend',       c:'var(--sky)',    unit:'$K', w:1.7},
  {id:'errors', name:'Error rate',  c:'var(--coral)',  unit:'%',  w:1.5}
];
const state={ range:'24h', active:new Set(['tokens','latency']), data:null, anomaly:0, liveOn:true, hovering:false, timer:null };

function shape(key,p,i,n){
  let tok,lat,spd,err;
  if(key==='24h'){ tok=46+21*Math.sin(p*Math.PI*2-1.15)+p*9; lat=232+58*Math.sin(p*Math.PI*2+.7)-p*24; spd=tok*.0335; err=.28+.14*Math.sin(p*9); }
  else if(key==='7d'){ const d=Math.floor(p*7), wknd=(d%7>=5)?-17:0;
    tok=54+wknd+9*Math.sin(p*Math.PI*2*3.4)+p*13; lat=248-wknd*1.1+22*Math.sin(p*Math.PI*2*1.7); spd=tok*.0345; err=.3+.2*Math.sin(p*13); }
  else if(key==='30d'){ tok=38+11*Math.sin(p*Math.PI*2*4.1)+p*40; lat=312-p*72+18*Math.sin(p*8); spd=tok*.036-p*.004; err=.55-p*.28+.12*Math.sin(p*17); }
  else { const sig=1/(1+Math.exp(-(p-.42)*8.5)); tok=20+62*sig+5*Math.sin(p*Math.PI*2*6.5); lat=395-148*sig+16*Math.sin(p*10); spd=tok*.038-.006*sig*10; err=1.15-.72*sig+.14*Math.sin(p*21); }
  return {tok,lat,spd,err};
}
function genData(key){
  const R=RANGES[key], n=R.n, rnd=mulberry32(hash(key+'v9'));
  const now=Date.now(), t=[],tokens=[],latency=[],spend=[],errors=[],rps=[];
  const anom=Math.floor(n*0.63); state.anomaly=anom;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const p=i/(n-1), s=shape(key,p,i,n);
    let tk=s.tok+(rnd()*2-1)*4.2, lt=s.lat+(rnd()*2-1)*16, er=s.err+rnd()*.1, sp=s.spd;
    if(i>=anom&&i<=anom+2){ tk*= (i===anom+1?.62:.82); lt*= (i===anom+1?2.35:1.5); er+= (i===anom+1?2.1:.7); }
    if(i===n-4) tk*=1.14;
    tk=Math.max(4,tk); lt=Math.max(90,lt); er=Math.max(.04,er);
    t.push(now-(n-1-i)*R.step); tokens.push(+tk.toFixed(2)); latency.push(Math.round(lt));
    spend.push(+(sp*1.02).toFixed(3)); errors.push(+er.toFixed(2));
    rps.push(Math.round(tk*13.4+(rnd()*2-1)*40));
  }
  return {t,tokens,latency,spend,errors,rps};
}
const FMT={
  clock:d=>new Date(d).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:false}),
  day:d=>new Date(d).toLocaleDateString([], {weekday:'short'})+' '+new Date(d).getHours()+':00',
  date:d=>new Date(d).toLocaleDateString([], {month:'short',day:'numeric'})
};
const axisFmt={
  tokens:v=>v.toFixed(0)+'M', latency:v=>Math.round(v)+'ms', spend:v=>'$'+v.toFixed(1)+'K', errors:v=>v.toFixed(1)+'%'
};
const tipFmt={
  tokens:v=>v.toFixed(1)+'M tok', latency:v=>Math.round(v)+' ms', spend:v=>'$'+(v*1000).toFixed(0), errors:v=>v.toFixed(2)+'%'
};

/* ---------------- smooth path (monotone cubic) ---------------- */
function pathFrom(pts){
  const n=pts.length; if(n<2) return '';
  const dx=[],dy=[],m=[];
  for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){dx[i]=pts[i+1].x-pts[i].x;dy[i]=pts[i+1].y-pts[i].y;m[i]=dy[i]/(dx[i]||1)}
  const t=[m[0]];
  for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++){
    if(m[i-1]*m[i]<=0)t[i]=0;
    else{const w1=2*dx[i]+dx[i-1],w2=dx[i]+2*dx[i-1];t[i]=(w1+w2)/(w1/m[i-1]+w2/m[i])}
  }
  t[n-1]=m[n-2];
  let d=`M${pts[0].x.toFixed(2)},${pts[0].y.toFixed(2)}`;
  for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){const h=dx[i];
    d+=`C${(pts[i].x+h/3).toFixed(2)},${(pts[i].y+t[i]*h/3).toFixed(2)} ${(pts[i+1].x-h/3).toFixed(2)},${(pts[i+1].y-t[i+1]*h/3).toFixed(2)} ${pts[i+1].x.toFixed(2)},${pts[i+1].y.toFixed(2)}`}
  return d;
}

/* ---------------- chart rendering ---------------- */
const svg=$('#chart'), wrap=$('#chartWrap'), tip=$('#tip');
const M={t:14,r:54,b:56,l:54};
let geo=null, scroller=null, firstDraw=true;

function drawChart(fromTick){
  const key=state.range, R=RANGES[key], d=state.data;
  if(!d) return;
  const W=wrap.clientWidth-8, H=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(svg).height)||326;
  const live=R.live&&state.active.size>0;
  const len=d.tokens.length;
  const vis=len-((R.live)?1:0);
  const pw=W-M.l-M.r, ph=H-M.t-M.b;
  const step=pw/(vis-1);
  const barsH=30, barsY=M.t+ph+12;
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
  geo={W,H,pw,ph,step,barsY,barsH,vis,live:!!R.live};

  const scales={};
  SERIES.forEach(s=>{
    const arr=d[s.id]; let mn=Math.min(...arr), mx=Math.max(...arr);
    const pad=(mx-mn)*.16||1; scales[s.id]={mn:mn-pad*.9, mx:mx+pad};
  });
  const yOf=(v,id)=>{const sc=scales[id];return M.t+ph-((v-sc.mn)/(sc.mx-sc.mn))*ph};
  const xOf=i=>M.l+i*step;
  const prim=SERIES.find(s=>s.id==='tokens'&&state.active.has('tokens'))||SERIES.find(s=>state.active.has(s.id))||SERIES[0];

  let g='';
  /* defs */
  g+=`<defs>
    <linearGradient id="ag" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:var(--accent);stop-opacity:.30"/>
      <stop offset="55%" style="stop-color:var(--accent);stop-opacity:.10"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:var(--accent);stop-opacity:0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <clipPath id="cpPlot"><rect x="${M.l}" y="${M.t-6}" width="${pw}" height="${ph+8}"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="cpBars"><rect x="${M.l}" y="${barsY-4}" width="${pw}" height="${barsH+28}"/></clipPath>
    <filter id="glow" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>
  </defs>`;
  /* grid + left axis (primary) */
  const sc=scales[prim.id];
  for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){
    const v=sc.mn+(sc.mx-sc.mn)*i/4, y=yOf(v,prim.id);
    g+=`<line class="gl${i===0?' zero':''}" x1="${M.l}" y1="${y.toFixed(1)}" x2="${M.l+pw}" y2="${y.toFixed(1)}"/>`;
    g+=`<text x="${M.l-9}" y="${(y+3.5).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="end">${axisFmt[prim.id](v)}</text>`;
  }
  /* right axis (second active series) */
  const sec=SERIES.find(s=>s.id!==prim.id&&state.active.has(s.id));
  if(sec){ const s2=scales[sec.id];
    for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){ const v=s2.mn+(s2.mx-s2.mn)*i/4, y=yOf(v,sec.id);
      g+=`<text x="${M.l+pw+9}" y="${(y+3.5).toFixed(1)}" style="fill:${sec.c}">${axisFmt[sec.id](v)}</text>`;}
  }
  /* scroller (lines + bars + x labels) */
  g+=`<g class="scroller">`;
  SERIES.forEach(s=>{
    if(!state.active.has(s.id)) return;
    const pts=d[s.id].map((v,i)=>({x:xOf(i),y:yOf(v,s.id)}));
    const dd=pathFrom(pts);
    if(s.area) g+=`<g clip-path="url(#cpPlot)"><path class="series-area" d="${dd} L${xOf(len-1)},${M.t+ph} L${M.l},${M.t+ph} Z" fill="url(#ag)"/></g>`;
    g+=`<g clip-path="url(#cpPlot)"><path class="series-line" data-sid="${s.id}" d="${dd}" style="stroke:${s.c};stroke-width:${s.w}" ${s.dash?`stroke-dasharray="${s.dash}"`:''} ${s.primary?'filter="url(#glow)"':''}/></g>`;
  });
  /* rps bars */
  const rb=d.rps, mxr=Math.max(...rb);
  let bars=`<g clip-path="url(#cpBars)">`;
  for(let i=0;i<len;i++){
    const bh=Math.max(1.5,(rb[i]/mxr)*barsH);
    const isA=i===state.anomaly;

/* scramble-decode */
function scramble(el,val,suffix){
  if(RM){el.innerHTML=val+suffix;return}
  const chars='0123456789·▚▞█▓';let f=0;const total=16;
  clearInterval(el._sc);
  el._sc=setInterval(()=>{
    f++;
    const p=f/total;
    const out=val.split('').map((c,i)=> (i < Math.floor(val.length*p) || c==='.') ? c : chars[Math.floor(Math.random()*chars.length)]).join('');
    el.innerHTML=out+suffix;
    if(f>=total){clearInterval(el._sc);el.innerHTML=val+suffix}
  },34);
}

const TICK=2600;
function tick(){
  const d=state.data, R=RANGES['24h'];
  const i=d.tokens.length + 1;
  const p=(i%(R.n-1))/(R.n-1);
  const s=shape('24h',p,i,R.n);
  const rnd=Math.random;
  const tk=Math.max(4,+(s.tok+(rnd()*2-1)*4.6).toFixed(2));
  d.tokens.shift(); d.tokens.push(tk);
  d.latency.shift(); d.latency.push(Math.max(90,Math.round(s.lat+(rnd()*2-1)*18)));
  d.spend.shift(); d.spend.push(+(s.spd*1.02).toFixed(3));
  d.errors.shift(); d.errors.push(+Math.max(.04,(s.err+rnd()*.12)).toFixed(2));
  d.rps.shift(); d.rps.push(Math.round(tk*13.4+(rnd()*2-1)*40));
  d.t.shift(); d.t.push(Date.now());
  drawChart(true); updateStats();
  if(scroller){
    scroller.style.transition='none'; scroller.style.transform='translateX(0)';
    void scroller.getBoundingClientRect();

const TICK_ITEMS=['<b>api-gateway</b> <em>nominal</em>','<b>router-v9</b> <em>nominal</em>','<b>kv-cache</b> 68.4% hit','<b>gpu-prod-a</b> 18/20 online','<b>queue.depth</b> <span class="w">rising</span>','<b>sa-east-1</b> <span class="c">p99 breach</span>','<b>eval-runner</b> <em>3 jobs</em>','<b>billing</b> 78% of commit','<b>detector-v4</b> <em>healthy</em>','<b>weights.sync</b> last 04:12 UTC','<b>pii-redactor</b> <em>enabled</em>','<b>fallback.lane</b> 6% traffic'];
$('#tkRun').innerHTML=[...TICK_ITEMS,...TICK_ITEMS].map(t=>`<span>${t}</span>`).join('');

/* ---------------- reveals ---------------- */
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(en=>{
  if(en.isIntersecting){en.target.classList.add('is-in');io.unobserve(en.target)}
}),{threshold:.08,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px'});
$$('[data-reveal]').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
const io2=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(en=>{
  if(en.isIntersecting){
    $$('.bar-fl',en.target).forEach((b,i)=>setTimeout(()=>b.style.width=b.dataset.w+'%',i*70));
    $$('.segm',en.target).forEach((b,i)=>setTimeout(()=>b.style.height=b.dataset.h+'%',i*14));
    const m=$('#cacheMeter'); if(m) m.style.width='68.4%';
    const sb=$('#spendBar'); if(sb) sb.style.width='76%';
    io2.unobserve(en.target);
  }
}),{threshold:.25});
$$('.panel,.rail').forEach(el=>io2.observe(el));

/* ---------------- keyboard ---------------- */
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.target.matches('input,textarea')) { if(e.key==='Escape') e.target.blur(); return }
  if(e.key==='/'){e.preventDefault();$('#q').focus()}
  if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='t'){sw.click()}
  const map={'1':'24h','2':'7d','3':'30d','4':'90d'};
  if(map[e.key]) setRange(map[e.key]);
});

/* ---------------- resize ---------------- */
let rt; addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(rt);rt=setTimeout(()=>drawChart(),140)});

/* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
setRange('24h');
renderTable();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .sidebar-profile {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 9px;
    }

    .avatar {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 35px;
      height: 35px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, #f0b891, #b86d59);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 750;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
    }

    .profile-copy {
      min-width: 0;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .profile-copy strong,
    .profile-copy small {
      display: block;
    }

    .profile-copy strong {
      margin-bottom: 3px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .profile-copy small {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .sidebar-profile .icon {
      width: 16px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    /* Main area */
    .main {
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      height: 74px;
      padding: 0 32px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .menu-button {
      display: none !important;
    }

    .search {
      position: relative;
      width: min(360px, 38vw);
    }

    .search .icon {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 13px;
      width: 17px;
      color: var(--muted);
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .search input {
      width: 100%;
      height: 39px;
      padding: 0 56px 0 40px;
      outline: none;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 12px;
      transition: 0.2s ease;
    }

    .search input::placeholder {
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .search input:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
    }

    .search kbd {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      right: 10px;
      padding: 3px 6px;
      background: var(--panel-soft);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 5px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 9px;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
    }

    .topbar-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      margin-left: auto;
    }

    .icon-button {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      padding: 0;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      transition: 0.18s ease;
    }

    .icon-button:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-strong);
      color: var(--text);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .notification-dot {
      position: absolute;
      top: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--red);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--panel);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .theme-toggle .moon,
    html[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .sun {
      display: none;
    }

    html[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .moon {
      display: block;
    }

    .topbar-divider {
      width: 1px;
      height: 25px;
      margin: 0 3px;
      background: var(--border);
    }

    .content {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1580px;
      padding: 30px 32px 38px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .page-heading {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 26px;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: 1.2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0 0 7px;
      font-size: clamp(24px, 2.3vw, 31px);
      font-weight: 720;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
    }

    .page-heading p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .heading-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      min-height: 39px;
      padding: 0 15px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--panel);
      color: var(--text-soft);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 620;
      transition: 0.18s ease;
    }

    .button:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-strong);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .button .icon {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
    }

    .button.primary {
      background: var(--primary);
      border-color: var(--primary);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 7px 17px rgba(109, 93, 252, 0.2);
    }

    .button.primary:hover {
      background: var(--primary-dark);
    }

    /* Metric cards */
    .metrics {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .card {
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 15px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .metric {
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 19px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .metric-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 15px;
    }

    .metric-icon {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 35px;
      height: 35px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--primary-soft);
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .metric-icon.cyan {
      background: var(--cyan-soft);
      color: var(--cyan);
    }

    .metric-icon.green {
      background: var(--green-soft);
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .metric-icon.amber {
      background: var(--amber-soft);
      color: var(--amber);
    }

    .metric-icon .icon {
      width: 17px;
      height: 17px;
    }

    .trend {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 3px;
      padding: 4px 7px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--green-soft);
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .trend.down {
      background: var(--red-soft);
      color: var(--red);
    }

    .trend .icon {
      width: 11px;
      height: 11px;
      stroke-width: 2.2;
    }

    .metric-label {
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 520;
    }

    .metric-value {
      font-size: 25px;
      font-weight: 720;
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }

    .metric-value small {
      margin-left: 3px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0;
    }

    .sparkline {
      position: absolute;
      right: 14px;
      bottom: 17px;
      width: 70px;
      height: 32px;
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    /* Dashboard panels */
    .primary-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.95fr) minmax(270px, 0.75fr);
      gap: 18px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .analytics-panel {
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 21px 22px 15px;
    }

    .panel-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .panel-title {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 680;
      letter-spacing: -0.25px;
    }

    .live-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 4px 7px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--green-soft);
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: 0.7px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .live-badge::before {
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      background: currentColor;
      border-radius: 50%;
      content: "";
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 15%, transparent);
      animation: pulse 2s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      50% { opacity: 0.45; }
    }

    .panel-subtitle {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .model-select {
      height: 34px;
      padding: 0 29px 0 11px;
      outline: none;
      background: var(--panel-soft);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--text-soft);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .chart-summary {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-top: 22px;
    }

    .chart-total {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .chart-total strong {
      font-size: 25px;
      letter-spacing: -0.7px;
    }

    .chart-legend {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .chart-legend span {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .legend-line {
      width: 15px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--primary);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .legend-line.forecast {
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan) 0 4px, transparent 4px 6px);
    }

    .segmented {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      padding: 3px;
      background: var(--panel-soft);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 9px;
    }

    .segmented button {
      min-width: 38px;
      height: 26px;
      padding: 0 8px;
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 6px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .segmented button.active {
      background: var(--panel);
      color: var(--text);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(20, 25, 40, 0.08);
    }

    .chart-wrap {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 274px;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    #analyticsChart {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      outline: none;
    }

    .chart-tooltip {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 5;
      display: none;
      width: 146px;
      padding: 10px 11px;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tooltip-label {
      padding-bottom: 7px;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .tooltip-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 5px;
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .tooltip-row span:first-child {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .tooltip-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .health-panel {
      padding: 21px;
    }

    .health-panel .panel-header {
      align-items: center;
    }

    .more-button {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 29px;
      height: 29px;
      padding: 0;
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 7px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .more-button:hover {
      background: var(--panel-soft);
    }

    .health-score {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 22px 0 20px;
    }

    .score-ring {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 88px;
      height: 88px;
      background: conic-gradient(var(--primary) 0 96%, var(--border) 96% 100%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      transform: rotate(-35deg);
    }

    .score-ring::before {
      position: absolute;
      width: 70px;
      height: 70px;
      background: var(--panel);
      border-radius: 50%;
      content: "";
    }

    .score-ring strong {
      position: relative;
      font-size: 20px;
      letter-spacing: -0.6px;
      transform: rotate(35deg);
    }

    .score-ring strong small {
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .health-score-copy strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .health-score-copy p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .model-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .model-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .model-symbol {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--panel-soft);
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 750;
    }

    .model-info {
      min-width: 0;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .model-info strong,
    .model-info small {
      display: block;
    }

    .model-info strong {
      margin-bottom: 3px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 620;
    }

    .model-info small {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
    }

    .status {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .status::before {
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      background: currentColor;
      border-radius: 50%;
      content: "";
    }

    .status.warning {
      color: var(--amber);
    }

    /* Bottom section */
    .secondary-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.65fr) minmax(280px, 0.85fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .activity-panel,
    .insight-panel {
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 20px 21px;
    }

    .text-link {
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .table-wrap {
      margin: 14px -21px -5px;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    th {
      padding: 10px 21px;
      background: var(--panel-soft);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 650;
      letter-spacing: 0.35px;
      text-align: left;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    td {
      padding: 13px 21px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-soft);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    tbody tr:last-child td {
      border-bottom: 0;
    }

    tbody tr:hover {
      background: var(--panel-soft);
    }

    .event-cell {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
    }

    .event-icon {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 27px;
      height: 27px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      background: var(--primary-soft);
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .event-icon .icon {
      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
    }

    .event-cell strong {
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 620;
    }

    .table-status {
      display: inline-flex;
      padding: 4px 7px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--green-soft);
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .table-status.processing {
      background: var(--amber-soft);
      color: var(--amber);
    }

    .insight-panel {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0, var(--primary-soft), transparent 47%),
        var(--panel);
    }

    .insight-icon {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      margin: 20px 0 13px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), #9287ff);
      border-radius: 11px;
      color: white;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(109, 93, 252, 0.2);
    }

    .insight-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
    }

    .insight-panel > p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .insight-panel > p strong {
      color: var(--text-soft);
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .insight-action {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 0;
      background: none;
      border: 0;
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .insight-action .icon {
      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
    }

    .toast {
      position: fixed;
      right: 24px;
      bottom: 24px;
      z-index: 100;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      background: var(--text);
      border-radius: 11px;
      color: var(--panel);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      font-size: 11px;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transform: translateY(15px);
      transition: 0.25s ease;
    }

    .toast.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .overlay {
      display: none;
    }

    button:focus-visible,
    a:focus-visible,
    select:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--primary-soft);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1200px) {
      .metrics {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }

      .primary-grid,
      .secondary-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .health-score {
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .model-list {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 12px;
      }

      .model-row {
        align-items: flex-start;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .app {
        display: block;
      }

      .sidebar {
        position: fixed;
        left: 0;
        width: 244px;
        transform: translateX(-102%);
        transition: transform 0.25s ease;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      }

      .sidebar.open {
        transform: translateX(0);
      }

      .overlay {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 35;
        display: block;
        background: rgba(4, 7, 14, 0.48);
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
        backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
      }

      .overlay.show {
        opacity: 1;
        pointer-events: auto;
      }

      .menu-button {
        display: grid !important;
      }

      .topbar,
      .content {
        padding-left: 22px;
        padding-right: 22px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 620px) {
      .topbar {
        height: 66px;
        padding: 0 16px;
      }

      .content {
        padding: 23px 16px 28px;
      }

      .search,
      .topbar-divider,
      .topbar-actions > .avatar {
        display: none;
      }

      .page-heading {
        align-items: flex-start;
        flex-direction: column;
      }

      .heading-actions {
        width: 100%;
      }

      .heading-actions .button {
        flex: 1;
      }

      .metrics {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 12px;
      }

      .metric {
        padding: 17px;
      }

      .analytics-panel,
      .health-panel,
      .activity-panel,
      .insight-panel {
        padding: 17px;
      }

      .panel-header {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }

      .chart-summary {
        align-items: flex-start;
        flex-direction: column;
      }

      .segmented {
        width: 100%;
      }

      .segmented button {
        flex: 1;
      }

      .chart-wrap {
        height: 245px;
      }

      .model-list {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .model-row {
        align-items: center;
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
      }

      .table-wrap {
        margin-right: -17px;
        margin-left: -17px;
      }

      th,
      td {
        padding-right: 17px;
        padding-left: 17px;
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *,
      *::before,
      *::after {
        scroll-behavior: auto !important;
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div class="app">
    <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar" aria-label="Main navigation">
      <a class="brand" href="#" aria-label="Nexus dashboard">
        <span class="brand-mark">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7">
            <path d="M12 3 4.5 7.3v9.4L12 21l7.5-4.3V7.3L12 3Z" />
            <path d="m8.5 14.5 2-5 3 5 2-5" />
          </svg>
        </span>
        <span class="brand-name">nexus<span>.</span></span>
      </a>

      <div class="workspace">
        <div class="workspace-avatar">AC</div>
        <div class="workspace-copy">
          <strong>Acme Corporation</strong>
          <small>Enterprise workspace</small>
        </div>
        <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m8 10 4 4 4-4" /></svg>
      </div>

      <div class="nav-label">Workspace</div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const root = document.documentElement;
      const themeToggle = document.getElementById("themeToggle");
      const sidebar = document.getElementById("sidebar");
      const overlay = document.getElementById("overlay");
      const menuButton = document.getElementById("menuButton");
      const canvas = document.getElementById("analyticsChart");
      const chartWrap = document.getElementById("chartWrap");
      const tooltip = document.getElementById("chartTooltip");
      const totalRequests = document.getElementById("totalRequests");
      const requestDelta = document.getElementById("requestDelta");
      const rangeButtons = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-range]")];
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      /* Theme */
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("nexus-theme");
      const preferredTheme = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light";

      function applyTheme(theme) {
        root.dataset.theme = theme;
        const dark = theme === "dark";
        themeToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(dark));
        themeToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", `Switch to ${dark ? "light" : "dark"} mode`);
        localStorage.setItem("nexus-theme", theme);
        requestAnimationFrame(drawChart);
      }

      applyTheme(savedTheme || preferredTheme);
      themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        applyTheme(root.dataset.theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
      });

      /* Mobile navigation */
      function setMenu(open) {
        sidebar.classList.toggle("open", open);
        overlay.classList.toggle("show", open);
        menuButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
        document.body.style.overflow = open ? "hidden" : "";
      }

      menuButton.addEventListener("click", () => setMenu(!sidebar.classList.contains("open")));
      overlay.addEventListener("click", () => setMenu(false));
      sidebar.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(link => link.addEventListener("click", () => setMenu(false)));
      window.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
        if (event.key === "Escape") setMenu(false);
        if (event.key === "/" && document.activeElement.tagName !== "INPUT") {
          event.preventDefault();
          document.getElementById("searchInput").focus();
        }
      });

      /* Toast notifications */
      const toast = document.getElementById("toast");
      let toastTimer;
      function showToast(message) {
        clearTimeout(toastTimer);
        toast.textContent = message;
        toast.classList.add("show");
        toastTimer = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove("show"), 2600);
      }

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-toast]").forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => showToast(button.dataset.toast));
      });

      /* Analytics data */
      function series(count, base, spread, phase = 0) {
        const actual = [];
        const forecast = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const wave = Math.sin((i + phase) * 0.82) * spread;
          const detail = Math.cos((i + phase) * 0.39) * spread * 0.32;
          actual.push(Math.round(base + wave + detail + i * 1.3));
          forecast.push(Math.round(base + 4 + Math.sin((i + phase + 0.3) * 0.82) * spread * 0.88 + i * 1.5));
        }
        return { actual, forecast };
      }

      const ranges = {
        "24H": {
          labels: ["00:00", "02:00", "04:00", "06:00", "08:00", "10:00", "12:00", "14:00", "16:00", "18:00", "20:00", "22:00"],
          ...series(12, 42, 12, 1),
          delta: "+8.4%"
        },
        "7D": {
          labels: ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"],
          ...series(7, 91, 21, 0),
          delta: "+12.8%"
        },
        "30D": {
          labels: ["May 1", "May 3", "May 5", "May 7", "May 9", "May 11", "May 13", "May 15", "May 17", "May 19", "May 21", "May 23", "May 25", "May 27", "May 29"],
          ...series(15, 104, 25, 2),
          delta: "+16.2%"
        },
        "90D": {
          labels: ["Mar 1", "Mar 9", "Mar 17", "Mar 25", "Apr 2", "Apr 10", "Apr 18", "Apr 26", "May 4", "May 12", "May 20", "May 28"],
          ...series(12, 125, 31, 3),
          delta: "+21.5%"
        }
      };

      let activeRange = "7D";
      let hoverIndex = null;
      let animationProgress = 1;
      let animationFrame = null;
      let pointLayout = [];
      let chartBounds = null;

      function css(variable) {
        return getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue(variable).trim();
      }

      function formatTotal(values) {
        const total = values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
        return total >= 1000 ? `${(total / 1000).toFixed(2)}M` : `${total}K`;
      }

      function roundedRect(context, x, y, width, height, radius) {
        context.beginPath();
        context.roundRect(x, y, width, height, radius);
      }

      function traceSmoothLine(context, points) {
        if (!points.length) return;
        context.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);
        for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
          const previous = points[i - 1];
          const current = points[i];
          const midX = (previous.x + current.x) / 2;
          const midY = (previous.y + current.y) / 2;
          if (i === 1) context.lineTo(midX, midY);
          else context.quadraticCurveTo(previous.x, previous.y, midX, midY);
        }
        const last = points[points.length - 1];
        context.lineTo(last.x, last.y);
      }

      function drawChart() {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

        const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        const pixelWidth = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
        const pixelHeight = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);

        if (canvas.width !== pixelWidth || canvas.height !== pixelHeight) {
          canvas.width = pixelWidth;
          canvas.height = pixelHeight;
        }

        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);

        const data = ranges[activeRange];
        const width = rect.width;
        const height = rect.height;
        const margin = {
          top: 14,
          right: width < 480 ? 8 : 16,
          bottom: 31,
          left: width < 480 ? 35 : 43
        };
        const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
        const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
        const maxValue = Math.max(...data.actual, ...data.forecast);
        const yMax = Math.ceil((maxValue + 12) / 20) * 20;
        const xStep = plotWidth / Math.max(data.labels.length - 1, 1);
        const yFor = value => margin.top + plotHeight - (value / yMax) * plotHeight;
        const xFor = index => margin.left + index * xStep;

        chartBounds = { ...margin, plotWidth, plotHeight, xStep, width, height };

        /* Grid and Y-axis labels */
        ctx.font = '10px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;

        for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
          const value = (yMax / 4) * i;
          const y = yFor(value);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.strokeStyle = css("--grid");
          ctx.moveTo(margin.left, Math.round(y) + 0.5);
          ctx.lineTo(width - margin.right, Math.round(y) + 0.5);
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.fillStyle = css("--muted");
          ctx.textAlign = "right";
          ctx.fillText(`${Math.round(value)}k`, margin.left - 9, y);
        }

        /* X-axis labels */
        const maxLabels = Math.max(3, Math.floor(plotWidth / 66));
        const labelStep = Math.ceil(data.labels.length / maxLabels);
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.textBaseline = "top";
        ctx.fillStyle = css("--muted");

        data.labels.forEach((label, index) => {
          const isLast = index === data.labels.length - 1;
          if (index % labelStep === 0 || isLast) {
            ctx.textAlign = index === 0 ? "left" : isLast ? "right" : "center";
            ctx.fillText(label, xFor(index), height - margin.bottom + 13);
          }
        });

        const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - animationProgress, 3);
        const baseline = margin.top + plotHeight;

        function animatedPoints(values) {
          return values.map((value, index) => {
            const targetY = yFor(value);
            return {
              x: xFor(index),
              y: baseline + (targetY - baseline) * ease
            };
          });
        }

        const actualPoints = animatedPoints(data.actual);
        const forecastPoints = animatedPoints(data.forecast);
        pointLayout = actualPoints;

        /* Forecast line */
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        traceSmoothLine(ctx, forecastPoints);
        ctx.strokeStyle = css("--cyan");
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
        ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.82;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();

        /* Actual area */
        const areaGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, margin.top, 0, baseline);
        areaGradient.addColorStop(0, root.dataset.theme === "dark" ? "rgba(138,125,255,.28)" : "rgba(109,93,252,.20)");
        areaGradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(109,93,252,0)");

        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        traceSmoothLine(ctx, actualPoints);
        ctx.lineTo(actualPoints[actualPoints.length - 1].x, baseline);
        ctx.lineTo(actualPoints[0].x, baseline);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = areaGradient;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        /* Actual line */
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        traceSmoothLine(ctx, actualPoints);
        ctx.strokeStyle = css("--primary");
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
        ctx.lineCap = "round";
        ctx.lineJoin = "round";
        ctx.shadowColor = root.dataset.theme === "dark" ? "rgba(138,125,255,.18)" : "rgba(109,93,252,.18)";
        ctx.shadowBlur = 7;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();

        /* Latest point */
        const lastPoint = actualPoints[actualPoints.length - 1];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(lastPoint.x, lastPoint.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = css("--panel");
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.strokeStyle = css("--primary");
        ctx.stroke();

        /* Hover state */
        if (hoverIndex !== null && animationProgress === 1) {
          const actualPoint = actualPoints[hoverIndex];
          const forecastPoint = forecastPoints[hoverIndex];

          ctx.save();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.setLineDash([3, 4]);
          ctx.strokeStyle = css("--border-strong");
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.moveTo(actualPoint.x, margin.top);
          ctx.lineTo(actualPoint.x, baseline);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.restore();

          [
            { point: actualPoint, color: css("--primary") },
            { point: forecastPoint, color: css("--cyan") }
          ].forEach(({ point, color }) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(point.x, point.y, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = css("--panel");
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
            ctx.stroke();
          });
        }
      }

      function updateSummary() {
        const data = ranges[activeRange];
        totalRequests.textContent = formatTotal(data.actual);
        requestDelta.textContent = data.delta;
        canvas.setAttribute(
          "aria-label",
          `${activeRange} AI analytics: ${formatTotal(data.actual)} total inference requests, with actual and forecast volume lines.`
        );
      }

      function animateChart() {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
        const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
        const start = performance.now();
        const duration = reduceMotion ? 0 : 480;
        hoverIndex = null;
        tooltip.style.display = "none";

        function frame(now) {
          animationProgress = duration === 0 ? 1 : Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
          drawChart();
          if (animationProgress < 1) animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }
        animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      rangeButtons.forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          activeRange = button.dataset.range;
          rangeButtons.forEach(item => item.classList.toggle("active", item === button));
          updateSummary();
          animateChart();
        });
      });

      document.getElementById("modelSelect").addEventListener("change", event => {
        showToast(`${event.target.value} analytics loaded`);
        animateChart();
      });

      function showChartTooltip(event) {
        if (!chartBounds || animationProgress < 1) return;
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
        const { left, right, top, bottom, xStep } = chartBounds;

        if (x < left - xStep / 2 || x > chartBounds.width - right + xStep / 2 || y < top || y > chartBounds.height - bottom + 8) {
          hoverIndex = null;
          tooltip.style.display = "none";
          drawChart();
          return;
        }

        const data = ranges[activeRange];
        const index = Math.max(0, Math.min(data.labels.length - 1, Math.round((x - left) / xStep)));
        if (hoverIndex !== index) {
          hoverIndex = index;
          drawChart();
        }

        tooltip.innerHTML = `
          <div class="tooltip-label">${data.labels[index]} · ${activeRange}</div>
          <div class="tooltip-row">
            <span><i class="tooltip-dot" style="background:${css("--primary")}"></i>Actual</span>
            <strong>${data.actual[index]}K</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="tooltip-row">
            <span><i class="tooltip-dot" style="background:${css("--cyan")}"></i>Forecast</span>
            <strong>${data.forecast[index]}K</strong>
          </div>
        `;
        tooltip.style.display = "block";

        const pointX = pointLayout[index].x;
        const tooltipWidth = 146;
        const proposedLeft = pointX + 13;
        tooltip.style.left = `${proposedLeft + tooltipWidth > rect.width - 5 ? pointX - tooltipWidth - 13 : proposedLeft}px`;
        tooltip.style.top = `${Math.max(5, Math.min(event.clientY - rect.top - 45, rect.height - 115))}px`;
      }

      canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", showChartTooltip);
      canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        hoverIndex = null;
        tooltip.style.display = "none";
        drawChart();
      });

      /* CSV export */
      document.getElementById("exportButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
        const data = ranges[activeRange];
        const rows = ["Period,Actual Volume (K),Forecast Volume (K)"];
        data.labels.forEach((label, index) => {
          rows.push(`${label},${data.actual[index]},${data.forecast[index]}`);
        });
        const blob = new Blob([rows.join("\n")], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const link = document.createElement("a");
        link.href = url;
        link.download = `nexus-ai-analytics-${activeRange.toLowerCase()}.csv`;
        link.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        showToast("Analytics exported successfully");
      });

      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => requestAnimationFrame(drawChart));
      resizeObserver.observe(chartWrap);

      updateSummary();
      animateChart();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
